二维层流 Navier–Stokes 方程的离散伴随：格心格式

Discrete adjoints for two-dimensional laminar Navier–Stokes: cell-centred

从二维标量的同一张非结构混合网格出发，加入四个守恒量、完整黏性应力和热传导。逐步推导并执行原始、前向与伴随计算，检查物性、边界与坐标对目标的完整影响。面向学过微积分、线性代数和数值方法的读者，先研究无激波层流。

Start with the scalar lesson’s unstructured hybrid mesh and add four conserved quantities, full viscous stress and heat conduction. Derive and execute primal, tangent and adjoint computations, checking complete transport, boundary and coordinate effects on objectives. Calculus, linear algebra and numerical methods are the prerequisites; begin with shock-free laminar flow.

制造解算例的入口／出口数据来自解析解，内圈是开口边界，因此来流 Mach 数、方向和固壁热学三项在该算例中不起作用，已禁用；参考黏度、物性、对流阶数和目标仍会改变结果。切换到“层流绕流”后这三项可用。改变选项后点击“重新计算”，局部导数都在该次基准上定义。第 14 节随页保存的加密表使用 μ_ref = 0.15（不在下拉选项中），该节按钮按当前物性重算前两级。

In the manufactured case the inflow/outflow data are analytic and the inner boundary is open, so inflow Mach number, direction and wall thermal condition have no effect there and are disabled; reference viscosity, transport, convection order and objective still change the result. They become available for laminar flow. After changing options click Recompute; local derivatives are defined at that baseline. The saved refinement table of Section 14 uses μ_ref = 0.15 (not a header option); its button recomputes the first two levels with the current transport.

网格与守恒量

Mesh and conservative states

先选一个状态，再选相邻面。说明哪些值存储在网格上，哪些量要到面上计算。

Select one state and an adjacent face. Identify stored quantities and quantities evaluated at the face.

图 1.1：控制体收支Figure 1.1: Control-volume balance

从已经认识的二维网格出发

Start with the familiar two-dimensional mesh

本页沿用二维标量的混合 O 型网格：24 个原始节点、8 个四边形和 16 个三角形。一个标量现在换成四个守恒量；我们增加分子黏性、剪应力和热传导，不增加湍流模型。默认制造解用于检查方程与导数；另一个选项是有限外边界内的低速层流绕流。两者不是同一个边值问题。

The hybrid O-grid is the scalar lesson's mesh: 24 original vertices, eight quadrilaterals and sixteen triangles. Replace one scalar by four conserved quantities and add molecular viscosity, shear and heat conduction, without a turbulence model. The default manufactured case checks equations and derivatives; the other option is low-speed laminar flow in a truncated exterior domain. They are distinct boundary-value problems.

Ui=(ρi,mx,i,my,i,ei)⊤,Uh∈R4N,u=mxρ,v=myρ,T=e/ρ−(u2+v2)/2cv.U_i=(\rho_i,m_{x,i},m_{y,i},e_i)^{\top},\quad \mathbf U_h\in\mathbb R^{4N},\qquad u=\frac{m_x}{\rho},\quad v=\frac{m_y}{\rho},\quad T=\frac{e/\rho-(u^2+v^2)/2}{c_v}.

本页把 UiU_i 定义为守恒量单元平均。基网格有 24 个控制体、48 个面、96 个状态自由度。数值重构中心使用面积质心，不是顶点的算术平均；二次重构还使用单元中心二阶矩。

Store conservative cell averages UiU_i. The base mesh has 24 volumes, 48 faces and 96 unknowns. Reconstruction uses area centroids rather than vertex averages, and includes central second moments for quadratic reconstruction.

nf=(Δy,−Δx)sf,sf=Δx2+Δy2,∑f⊂∂Visfnif=0.n_f=\frac{(\Delta y,-\Delta x)}{s_f},\quad s_f=\sqrt{\Delta x^2+\Delta y^2},\qquad\sum_{f\subset\partial V_i}s_fn_{if}=0.

面法向从左控制体指向右控制体，边界指向流体域外。面长 sfs_f 与单位法向分开存储，求积中只乘一次面长。点击或选择面可查看左右编号、梯度邻域及实际状态；颜色和数值均来自当前求解。数组和编号从 0 开始。

Normals point from left to right volumes, or out of the fluid domain at a boundary. Store length sfs_f separately from the unit normal and include length exactly once in quadrature. Select a face to inspect indices, reconstruction stencils and actual state values. All arrays and indices start at zero.

从“每单位体积”到“一个控制体内有多少”

From density to the amount inside a control volume

先把四个量的物理含义分开。ρ\rho 是质量密度，mx=ρu,my=ρvm_x=\rho u,m_y=\rho v 是两个动量密度，e=ρEe=\rho E 是总能量密度；这里 ee 不是比内能。理想气体的比总能量由比内能与比动能组成。先减去动能，再除以 cvc_v，才得到温度：

Separate the four physical quantities first. ρ\rho is mass density, mx=ρu,my=ρvm_x=\rho u,m_y=\rho v are momentum densities, and e=ρEe=\rho E is total energy per volume; ee is not specific internal energy. Subtract specific kinetic energy from specific total energy, then divide by cvc_v to recover temperature:

E=cvT+u2+v22,e=ρcvT+mx2+my22ρ,p=ρT=(γ−1)[e−mx2+my22ρ].E=c_vT+\frac{u^2+v^2}{2},\quad e=\rho c_vT+\frac{m_x^2+m_y^2}{2\rho},\quad p=\rho T=(\gamma-1)\left[e-\frac{m_x^2+m_y^2}{2\rho}\right].

本页采用单位厚度二维模型，因此控制体“体积”数值上等于平面面积。格心存储平均值时，控制体内四种总量就是 ViUiV_iU_i。格点版存储节点点值，围绕节点积分控制方程；不能把这个点值直接说成对偶体的精确平均值。

The planar model has unit depth, so volume equals area numerically. For stored cell averages, the four amounts in a cell are ViUiV_iU_i. The nodal scheme stores point values and integrates equations around a vertex; a nodal value is not the exact average over its dual volume.

Uicell=1Vi∫ViU(x,y) dA,Uinode≈U(Xi),Uh=(U0⊤,U1⊤,…,UN−1⊤)⊤.U_i^{\rm cell}=\frac1{V_i}\int_{V_i}U(x,y)\,dA,\qquad U_i^{\rm node}\approx U(X_i),\qquad \mathbf U_h=(U_0^{\top},U_1^{\top},\ldots,U_{N-1}^{\top})^{\top}.

第 2 节Section 2

通量、重构与黏性梯度

Fluxes, reconstruction and viscous gradients

选择内部面，依次查看两个求积点。先核对左右迹，再核对应力和净通量。

Select an interior face and visit both Gauss points. Check traces, stress and net flux in that order.

图 2.1：面上的应力与热流Figure 2.1: Stress and heat on a face · 图 2.2：重构与两侧迹Figure 2.2: Reconstruction and traces

物理张量怎样成为面上的四分量通量

From physical tensors to a four-component face flux

采用无量纲气体常数 1，γ=1.4,cv=2.5,cp=3.5\gamma=1.4,c_v=2.5,c_p=3.5。压力 p=ρTp=\rho T。上标 c、v 分别代表对流和黏性，不能把黏性应力当成四个互不相关的标量扩散项。

Use nondimensional gas constant one and γ=1.4,cv=2.5,cp=3.5\gamma=1.4,c_v=2.5,c_p=3.5, with p=ρTp=\rho T. Superscripts c and v denote convection and viscosity. Viscous stress is not four independent scalar diffusion terms.

un=unx+vny,Fnc=[ρunmxun+pnxmyun+pny(e+p)un],Fnv=[0(τn)x(τn)y(u,v)⋅τn−qn].u_n=un_x+vn_y,\quad F_n^c=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\m_xu_n+pn_x\\m_yu_n+pn_y\\(e+p)u_n\end{bmatrix},\quad F_n^v=\begin{bmatrix}0\\(\tau n)_x\\(\tau n)_y\\(u,v)\cdot\tau n-q_n\end{bmatrix}.
div⁡f=Gxu+Gyv,τxx=μ(2Gxu−23div⁡f),τyy=μ(2Gyv−23div⁡f),τxy=μ(Gyu+Gxv),qn=−κGT⋅n.\operatorname{div}_f=G_x^u+G_y^v,\quad\tau_{xx}=\mu(2G_x^u-\tfrac23\operatorname{div}_f),\quad\tau_{yy}=\mu(2G_y^v-\tfrac23\operatorname{div}_f),\quad\tau_{xy}=\mu(G_y^u+G_x^v),\quad q_n=-\kappa G^T\cdot n.
μ=μreforμ=μref1.4T3/2T+0.4,κ=cpμPr.\mu=\mu_{\rm ref}\quad\text{or}\quad \mu=\mu_{\rm ref}\frac{1.4T^{3/2}}{T+0.4},\qquad\kappa=\frac{c_p\mu}{Pr}.

这里 GG 专指下面定义的离散梯度；2/32/3 来自三维 Newton 应力在平面二维运动下的限制。黏性功与热流都进入能量方程。面上的总通量为对流减黏性，热流在总能量通量中以正号出现。

Here GG denotes the discrete gradients defined below. The factor 2/32/3 restricts three-dimensional Newtonian stress to plane motion. Both viscous work and heat enter energy. Net flux is convection minus viscosity, so heat enters net energy with a plus sign.

展开守恒通量：质量、力和功率

Expand the flux: mass, force and power

质量穿过单位面积面的速率是 ρun\rho u_n；它携带的 x、y 动量分别乘以 u,vu,v。压力又在面上施加法向力 pnpn，压力功率为 punp u_n。因此能量对流项不是单独的 eune u_n，而是 (e+p)un(e+p)u_n。黏性应力做功为 (u,v)⋅τn(u,v)\cdot\tau n，导热携带能量而不携带质量。这分别给出上面的四行通量。

Mass crosses unit face area at rate ρun\rho u_n, carrying x/y momentum at that rate times u,vu,v. Pressure contributes normal force pnpn and power punpu_n, giving energy convection (e+p)un(e+p)u_n. Viscous traction does work (u,v)⋅τn(u,v)\cdot\tau n; heat transports energy but no mass. These observations produce the four flux rows above.

τ=μ[43ux−23vyuy+vxuy+vx43vy−23ux],τn=[τxxnx+τxynyτxynx+τyyny].\tau=\mu\begin{bmatrix}\frac43u_x-\frac23v_y&u_y+v_x\\u_y+v_x&\frac43v_y-\frac23u_x\end{bmatrix},\quad \tau n=\begin{bmatrix}\tau_{xx}n_x+\tau_{xy}n_y\\\tau_{xy}n_x+\tau_{yy}n_y\end{bmatrix}.

这里的 uxu_x 等只在物理模型介绍中表示空间导数。代码会用下文重构产生的 GxuG_x^u 等替代它们。平面运动仍是三维流体本构的限制：w=0,∂z=0w=0,\partial_z=0，但通常 τzz=−(2/3)μ(ux+vy)\tau_{zz}=-(2/3)\mu(u_x+v_y) 不为零。这解释了系数为何是 2/32/3，而不是把空间维数改成二就改成另一系数。

Here uxu_x denotes a spatial derivative in the physical model; code replaces it by reconstructed GxuG_x^u. Plane motion restricts a three-dimensional constitutive law: w=0,∂z=0w=0,\partial_z=0, but generally τzz=−(2/3)μ(ux+vy)≠0\tau_{zz}=-(2/3)\mu(u_x+v_y)\ne0. This explains the factor 2/32/3.

同时保留平均值与几何矩

Retain averages and geometric moments

Pi(x)=Ui+cx,iΔx+cy,iΔy+cxx,i(Δx2−Mxx,i)+cxy,i(ΔxΔy−Mxy,i)+cyy,i(Δy2−Myy,i),(Δx,Δy)=x−xi.P_i(x)=U_i+c_{x,i}\Delta x+c_{y,i}\Delta y+c_{xx,i}(\Delta x^2-M_{xx,i})+c_{xy,i}(\Delta x\Delta y-M_{xy,i})+c_{yy,i}(\Delta y^2-M_{yy,i}),\quad (\Delta x,\Delta y)=x-x_i.

格心中心矩为 Mxx=⟨Δx2⟩iM_{xx}=\langle\Delta x^2\rangle_i 等，保证 ⟨Pi⟩i=Ui\langle P_i\rangle_i=U_i。用邻居的几何矩计算 ⟨Pi⟩j\langle P_i\rangle_j，而不是把平均值硬当成中心点值。

For cells the moments are Mxx=⟨Δx2⟩iM_{xx}=\langle\Delta x^2\rangle_i and similarly for the others, ensuring ⟨Pi⟩i=Ui\langle P_i\rangle_i=U_i. Neighbour equations use their geometric moments, not cell averages misinterpreted as centre point values.

min⁡ci∑j∈Niwij∥bijci−(Uj−Ui)∥2,wij=∥xj−xi∥−2,Hici=ri.\min_{c_i}\sum_{j\in\mathcal N_i}w_{ij}\|b_{ij}c_i-(U_j-U_i)\|^2,\quad w_{ij}=\|x_j-x_i\|^{-2},\quad H_ic_i=r_i.

邻域规则是连通图上的逐圈扩展：从 ii 出发，每次把当前一圈的全部面邻居加进来，直到连同自身至少有 12 个控制体（最多 5 圈）才停止。因为整圈加入，总数可能超过 12。基网格上，格心 0 用到其余 23 个格心中的 15 个；全部格心的邻居数在 11 到 15 之间。因此至少有 11 个邻居差值，多于待定的 5 个系数，加权最小二乘是超定的；四个守恒分量共享同一几何矩阵。

The stencil grows ring by ring on the face-neighbour graph: starting from ii, add every neighbour of the current ring until, counting ii itself, at least 12 control volumes are collected (at most five rings). Whole rings are added, so the count can exceed 12. On the base mesh, cell 0 uses 15 of the other 23; every stencil has between 11 and 15 neighbours. Hence at least 11 neighbour differences constrain the five coefficients, and the weighted least-squares fit is overdetermined; the four conserved components share one geometric matrix.

二次多项式用于黏性迹和梯度。对流一阶使用存储状态，二阶使用 Ui+cx,iΔx+cy,iΔyU_i+c_{x,i}\Delta x+c_{y,i}\Delta y；无 limiter。

Quadratic polynomials provide viscous traces and gradients. First-order convection uses stored states, while second order uses Ui+cx,iΔx+cy,iΔyU_i+c_{x,i}\Delta x+c_{y,i}\Delta y. No limiter is applied.

F^nc=12(Fnc(U−)+Fnc(U+))−32(U+−U−).\widehat F_n^c=\tfrac12(F_n^c(U^-)+F_n^c(U^+))-\tfrac32(U^+-U^-).

这一对流通量是 Rusanov（局部 Lax–Friedrichs）型：两侧物理通量的平均，减去“耗散速度 × 跳跃”的一半；这里耗散速度取常数 3，所以系数是 3/23/2。它不逐面取 max⁡(∣un∣+c)\max(|u_n|+c)，因此残差处处可微，复数步长也保持解析；代价是只在 ∣un∣+c<3|u_n|+c<3 的范围内保证足够的耗散，第 5 节的诊断 maxWave 必须小于 3。默认基准的最大特征速度为 1.4591.459，约为 3 的 49%。同一系列的取值不同：二维 Euler 页固定取 2；一维 N–S 页取两侧平均 12(u−+u++c−+c+)\tfrac12(u^-+u^++c^-+c^+)，因为一维管道中处处 u>0u>0，这个状态相关的平均本身光滑。二维面法向可指向任意方向，unu_n 会变号，状态相关的 ∣un∣|u_n| 在 un=0u_n=0 处不可微，所以本页与二维 Euler 页都取常数。上面的基准只用到 3 的约一半，常数 2 也能覆盖它，但余量更小；本页取 3。

This convective flux is of Rusanov (local Lax–Friedrichs) type: the average of the two physical fluxes minus half of “dissipation speed × jump”. The dissipation speed is the constant 3, hence the coefficient 3/23/2. It does not take max⁡(∣un∣+c)\max(|u_n|+c) face by face, so the residual stays differentiable everywhere and complex steps stay analytic; in exchange, enough dissipation is guaranteed only while ∣un∣+c<3|u_n|+c<3, and the Section 5 diagnostic maxWave must stay below 3. The default baseline's largest characteristic speed is 1.4591.459, about 49% of 3. The series uses different values: the 2D Euler page fixes 2; the 1D N–S page uses the two-sided average 12(u−+u++c−+c+)\tfrac12(u^-+u^++c^-+c^+), which is smooth because u>0u>0 throughout the 1D duct. In 2D a face normal can point anywhere, unu_n changes sign and a state-dependent ∣un∣|u_n| is not differentiable at un=0u_n=0; this page and the 2D Euler page therefore use constants. The baseline above uses about half of 3; the constant 2 would also cover it, with less margin, and this page takes 3.

最小二乘正规方程怎样得到

Deriving the least-squares normal equations

先只看一个守恒分量 zz，例如密度。令五个未知系数排成列 cic_i，邻居中心相对位置为 (Δx,Δy)(\Delta x,\Delta y)。因为 zjz_j 是平均值，格心的拟合行还必须包含邻居和本单元的中心矩：

Consider one conserved component zz, such as density. Stack its five coefficients into cic_i and let (Δx,Δy)(\Delta x,\Delta y) be the neighbour-centre offset. Cell-average fitting must include both cells’ central moments:

bij=[Δx,Δy,Δx2+Mxx,j−Mxx,i,ΔxΔy+Mxy,j−Mxy,i,Δy2+Myy,j−Myy,i].b_{ij}=\left[\Delta x,\Delta y,\Delta x^2+M_{xx,j}-M_{xx,i},\Delta x\Delta y+M_{xy,j}-M_{xy,i},\Delta y^2+M_{yy,j}-M_{yy,i}\right].

格点版本令全部中心矩为零。把所有 bijb_{ij} 叠成矩阵 BiB_i，把 zj−ziz_j-z_i 叠成 did_i，权重构成对角矩阵 WiW_i。最小化的是“邻居数据与多项式预测不一致”的加权平方和：

For nodes all central moments are zero. Stack rows bijb_{ij} into BiB_i, differences zj−ziz_j-z_i into did_i, and weights into diagonal WiW_i. Minimize the weighted squared mismatch between data and polynomial predictions:

Φ(ci)=12(Bici−di)⊤Wi(Bici−di).\Phi(c_i)=\frac12(B_ic_i-d_i)^{\top}W_i(B_ic_i-d_i).
δΦ=(Bici−di)⊤WiBiδci,∇ciΦ=Bi⊤Wi(Bici−di)=0.\delta\Phi=(B_ic_i-d_i)^{\top}W_iB_i\delta c_i,\quad \nabla_{c_i}\Phi=B_i^{\top}W_i(B_ic_i-d_i)=0.
Bi⊤WiBi⏟Hici=Bi⊤Widi⏟ri,ci=Hi−1ri.\underbrace{B_i^{\top}W_iB_i}_{H_i}c_i=\underbrace{B_i^{\top}W_id_i}_{r_i},\qquad c_i=H_i^{-1}r_i.

这是一个 5×55\times5 系统，每个守恒分量各解一次，几何矩阵可以共享。邻居数量多于五仍不保证可解，还要有足够独立的几何方向。实现检查权重的有限性和二次多项式再现误差；这里写逆矩阵是为了说明关系，不要求读者把“大矩阵显式求逆”当作求解原则。拟合矩阵 HiH_i 与面通量 HfH_f 由下标和维度区分。

This is a 5×55\times5 system for each conserved component, sharing geometry. More than five neighbours is insufficient without independent geometric directions. The implementation checks finite weights and quadratic reproduction. Inverse notation expresses the relation, not a recommendation to explicitly invert large matrices. Fit matrix HiH_i and face-flux vector HfH_f differ in indices and dimensions.

ci=(cx,i,cy,i,cxx,i,cxy,i,cyy,i)⊤,∂xPi=cx,i+2cxx,iΔx+cxy,iΔy,∂yPi=cy,i+cxy,iΔx+2cyy,iΔy.c_i=(c_{x,i},c_{y,i},c_{xx,i},c_{xy,i},c_{yy,i})^{\top},\quad\partial_xP_i=c_{x,i}+2c_{xx,i}\Delta x+c_{xy,i}\Delta y,\quad\partial_yP_i=c_{y,i}+c_{xy,i}\Delta x+2c_{yy,i}\Delta y.

黏性迹、梯度与跳跃修正

Viscous traces, gradients and jump correction

Ufv=12(PL(xf)+PR(xf)),Gfθ=12(∇θ(PL)+∇θ(PR))+2θ(PR)−θ(PL)xLR⋅xLRxLR,xLR=xR−xL.U_f^v=\tfrac12(P_L(x_f)+P_R(x_f)),\quad G_f^\theta=\tfrac12(\nabla\theta(P_L)+\nabla\theta(P_R))+2\frac{\theta(P_R)-\theta(P_L)}{x_{LR}\cdot x_{LR}}x_{LR},\quad x_{LR}=x_R-x_L.

θ∈{u,v,T}\theta\in\{u,v,T\}。先对守恒多项式求空间梯度，再用原始变量转换的 Jacobian 得到各侧原始量梯度。跳跃修正使用同一面点的两侧迹，系数为 2；它不是第 1D 页的中心点差分。精确二次守恒多项式的左右迹一致，修正为零。非线性转换、边界和通量装配后的整体阶数仍需制造解测量。

For θ∈{u,v,T}\theta\in\{u,v,T\}, differentiate the conservative polynomial spatially, then apply the primitive-conversion Jacobian. The penalty uses both traces at the same face point with coefficient two; it is not the 1D centre difference. Exact quadratic conservative traces agree and have zero penalty. Nonlinear conversion, boundaries and flux assembly still require measured global convergence.

为什么需要跳跃项？只平均两侧梯度时，中心差分形式的单元梯度看不到一维奇偶（棋盘）模式 θj=(−1)j\theta_j=(-1)^j：每个单元的梯度都是零，黏性通量也为零，这个模式既不受阻尼，也不被察觉。把跳跃项系数记作 α\alpha（本页 α=2\alpha=2），在均匀一维网格、线性重构且面位于中点时，面梯度化为 Gf=α(θR−θL)/h+(1−α)(gL+gR)/2G_f=\alpha(\theta_R-\theta_L)/h+(1-\alpha)(g_L+g_R)/2，其中 gL,gRg_L,g_R 是两侧单元梯度。对 θj=eijϕ\theta_j=e^{\mathrm ij\phi}，扩散算子的符号为

Why add a jump term? Averaging the two cell gradients alone cannot see the 1D odd-even (checkerboard) mode θj=(−1)j\theta_j=(-1)^j: every centred cell gradient vanishes, so the viscous flux vanishes and the mode is neither damped nor detected. Write the jump coefficient as α\alpha (α=2\alpha=2 here). On a uniform 1D grid with linear reconstruction and the face at the midpoint, the face gradient becomes Gf=α(θR−θL)/h+(1−α)(gL+gR)/2G_f=\alpha(\theta_R-\theta_L)/h+(1-\alpha)(g_L+g_R)/2, with gL,gRg_L,g_R the cell gradients. For θj=eijϕ\theta_j=e^{\mathrm ij\phi} the diffusion symbol is

h2D^(ϕ)=−4sin⁡2ϕ2[α+(1−α)cos⁡2ϕ2]=−ϕ2[1+3α−412 ϕ2+O(ϕ4)].h^2\widehat D(\phi)=-4\sin^2\tfrac\phi2\left[\alpha+(1-\alpha)\cos^2\tfrac\phi2\right]=-\phi^2\left[1+\tfrac{3\alpha-4}{12}\,\phi^2+O(\phi^4)\right].

最短波 ϕ=π\phi=\pi 的值依次为：α=0\alpha=0 时为 00（奇偶解耦）；α=1\alpha=1 时为 −4-4（紧致两点差分）；α=4/3\alpha=4/3 时为 −163-\tfrac{16}{3}，并使 ϕ2\phi^2 修正项的系数 3α−412\tfrac{3\alpha-4}{12} 等于 00，在均匀网格上达到四阶；α=2\alpha=2 时为 −8-8，最短波阻尼是紧致差分的两倍，光滑波的修正系数为 16\tfrac{1}{6}，仍是二阶相容。可见任何 α>0\alpha>0 都相容，差别只在有限网格的阻尼与截断误差；本页取 2，是偏向强阻尼的选择，不是由方程唯一决定的常数。

At the shortest wave ϕ=π\phi=\pi the values are: α=0\alpha=0 gives 00 (odd-even decoupling); α=1\alpha=1 gives −4-4 (compact two-point difference); α=4/3\alpha=4/3 gives −163-\tfrac{16}{3} and makes the ϕ2\phi^2 coefficient 3α−412\tfrac{3\alpha-4}{12} equal 00, fourth order on a uniform grid; α=2\alpha=2 gives −8-8, twice the damping of the compact difference, while the smooth-wave coefficient 16\tfrac{1}{6} keeps second-order consistency. Any α>0\alpha>0 is consistent; the choice only changes finite-mesh damping and truncation error. This page uses 2, favouring strong damping; it is not a constant fixed by the equations.

守恒量梯度怎样转换成速度、温度梯度

Converting conserved gradients to velocity and temperature gradients

对 u=mx/ρu=m_x/\rho 使用商法则，再对总能量关系使用链式法则。若 ∂kPz\partial_kP^z 表示重构守恒分量 zz 的多项式在方向 k=x,yk=x,y 上的斜率，实际计算为：

Apply the quotient rule to u=mx/ρu=m_x/\rho and the chain rule to total energy. With ∂kPz\partial_kP^z the slope, in direction k=x,yk=x,y, of the reconstructed polynomial of conserved component zz, code evaluates:

Gku=∂kPmx−u∂kPρρ,Gkv=∂kPmy−v∂kPρρ,G_k^u=\frac{\partial_kP^{m_x}-u \partial_kP^\rho}{\rho},\quad G_k^v=\frac{\partial_kP^{m_y}-v \partial_kP^\rho}{\rho},
GkT=1cv[∂kPe−(e/ρ)∂kPρρ−uGku−vGkv].G_k^T=\frac1{c_v}\left[\frac{\partial_kP^e-(e/\rho)\partial_kP^\rho}{\rho}-uG_k^u-vG_k^v\right].

不要用“分别拟合速度和温度”替代这条链：它会定义另一种离散残差。本页先拟合守恒量，再进行上述非线性转换。二阶对流仅取多项式的常数与线性部分，黏性仍使用完整二次迹及其梯度；空间精度按钮不是将所有多项式统一切成同一次数。

Fitting velocity and temperature independently would define a different residual. This implementation reconstructs conserved variables and then converts them nonlinearly. Second-order convection keeps only the constant and linear terms, while viscosity retains quadratic traces and gradients.

逐步推导：原始变量、Jacobian 行与梯度转换

Step by step: primitive variables, Jacobian rows and the gradient conversion

面上的每个物理量都从守恒量 U=(ρ,mx,my,e)U=(\rho,m_x,m_y,e) 的迹算出。前向、反向都要反复用到它们对 UU 的导数，所以先把这组导数一次推导完整，后面各节直接引用。下面的行向量都是 1×41\times4，列的顺序与代码的四个分量槽一致。

Every physical quantity on a face is computed from traces of the conserved state U=(ρ,mx,my,e)U=(\rho,m_x,m_y,e). The tangent and the reverse pass use their derivatives with respect to UU again and again, so derive them once, completely; later sections refer back here. All rows below are 1×41\times4, ordered like the four component slots in the code.

第一步，写出原始变量（physics.js 的 prim()）。E=e/ρE=e/\rho 是单位质量总能：

Step 1, write the primitive variables (prim() in physics.js). E=e/ρE=e/\rho is total energy per unit mass:

u=mxρ,v=myρ,E=eρ,T=1cv(E−u2+v22),p=ρT.u=\frac{m_x}{\rho},\qquad v=\frac{m_y}{\rho},\qquad E=\frac{e}{\rho},\qquad T=\frac1{c_v}\Big(E-\frac{u^2+v^2}{2}\Big),\qquad p=\rho T.

第二步，逐个求变分。商法则给出 δu=(δmx−u δρ)/ρ\delta u=(\delta m_x-u\,\delta\rho)/\rho、δE=(δe−E δρ)/ρ\delta E=(\delta e-E\,\delta\rho)/\rho；再把它们代入 δT=(δE−u δu−v δv)/cv\delta T=(\delta E-u\,\delta u-v\,\delta v)/c_v 并按 δρ,δmx,δmy,δe\delta\rho,\delta m_x,\delta m_y,\delta e 归并系数：

Step 2, vary each one. The quotient rule gives δu=(δmx−u δρ)/ρ\delta u=(\delta m_x-u\,\delta\rho)/\rho and δE=(δe−E δρ)/ρ\delta E=(\delta e-E\,\delta\rho)/\rho; substitute them into δT=(δE−u δu−v δv)/cv\delta T=(\delta E-u\,\delta u-v\,\delta v)/c_v and collect the coefficients of δρ,δmx,δmy,δe\delta\rho,\delta m_x,\delta m_y,\delta e:

uU=1ρ[−u100],vU=1ρ[−v010],TU=1ρcv[u2+v2−E−u−v1].u_U=\frac1\rho\begin{bmatrix}-u&1&0&0\end{bmatrix},\qquad v_U=\frac1\rho\begin{bmatrix}-v&0&1&0\end{bmatrix},\qquad T_U=\frac1{\rho c_v}\begin{bmatrix}u^2+v^2-E&-u&-v&1\end{bmatrix}.

压力是乘积 p=ρTp=\rho T，所以 pU=TρU+ρTUp_U=T\rho_U+\rho T_U，其中 ρU=(1,0,0,0)\rho_U=(1,0,0,0)。把 T=(E−12(u2+v2))/cvT=(E-\tfrac12(u^2+v^2))/c_v 代入第一个分量，EE 恰好消去：

Pressure is the product p=ρTp=\rho T, so pU=TρU+ρTUp_U=T\rho_U+\rho T_U with ρU=(1,0,0,0)\rho_U=(1,0,0,0). Substituting T=(E−12(u2+v2))/cvT=(E-\tfrac12(u^2+v^2))/c_v into the first entry cancels EE:

pU=1cv[12(u2+v2)−u−v1]=(γ−1)[12(u2+v2)−u−v1],γ−1=1cv=0.4.p_U=\frac1{c_v}\begin{bmatrix}\tfrac12(u^2+v^2)&-u&-v&1\end{bmatrix}=(\gamma-1)\begin{bmatrix}\tfrac12(u^2+v^2)&-u&-v&1\end{bmatrix},\qquad \gamma-1=\frac1{c_v}=0.4.

第三步，用链式法则得到空间梯度。迹 P(x)P(x) 在点 xx 的斜率 ∂kP=(∂kPρ,∂kPmx,∂kPmy,∂kPe)\partial_kP=(\partial_kP^\rho,\partial_kP^{m_x},\partial_kP^{m_y},\partial_kP^e) 是一个四分量列向量；对 θ(P(x))\theta(P(x)) 求 ∂k\partial_k，只需把上一步的行乘上这个斜率（physics.js 的 gradient()）：

Step 3, obtain spatial gradients by the chain rule. The slope ∂kP=(∂kPρ,∂kPmx,∂kPmy,∂kPe)\partial_kP=(\partial_kP^\rho,\partial_kP^{m_x},\partial_kP^{m_y},\partial_kP^e) of a trace P(x)P(x) at xx is a four-component column; differentiating θ(P(x))\theta(P(x)) with respect to xkx_k multiplies the row of Step 2 by this slope (gradient() in physics.js):

Gkθ=θU(P) ∂kP,θ∈{u,v,T}, k∈{x,y}.G_k^\theta=\theta_U(P)\,\partial_kP,\qquad\theta\in\{u,v,T\},\ k\in\{x,y\}.

例如温度：把 TUT_U 乘开，再按第 2 节已有的写法重新分组，

For temperature, multiply out TUT_U and regroup as in Section 2:

TU ∂kP=1ρcv[(u2+v2−E) ∂kPρ−u ∂kPmx−v ∂kPmy+∂kPe]=1cv[∂kPe−E ∂kPρρ−uGku−vGkv],T_U\,\partial_kP=\frac1{\rho c_v}\big[(u^2+v^2-E)\,\partial_kP^\rho-u\,\partial_kP^{m_x}-v\,\partial_kP^{m_y}+\partial_kP^e\big]=\frac1{c_v}\Big[\frac{\partial_kP^e-E\,\partial_kP^\rho}{\rho}-uG_k^u-vG_k^v\Big],

正是代码中 GkTG_k^T 的公式。所以“守恒量斜率 → 原始量梯度”只是一个 1×41\times4 行乘法。

exactly the code's formula for GkTG_k^T. Converting a conservative slope into a primitive gradient is therefore one 1×41\times4 row product.

第四步，对梯度再求一次变分。GkθG_k^\theta 通过两个位置依赖状态：行 θU(P)\theta_U(P) 本身和斜率 ∂kP\partial_kP。乘积法则给出两项，第二项需要对行再求导：

Step 4, vary the gradient once more. GkθG_k^\theta depends on the state in two places: through the row θU(P)\theta_U(P) and through the slope ∂kP\partial_kP. The product rule gives two terms; the second one differentiates the row again:

δGkθ=θU δ(∂kP)+∂(θU∂kP)∂U δP,\delta G_k^\theta=\theta_U\,\delta(\partial_kP)+\frac{\partial(\theta_U\partial_kP)}{\partial U}\,\delta P,

三个二阶行写成列（即它们的转置，反向时正好用到转置）：

The three second-derivative rows, written as columns (their transposes, which is what the reverse pass uses):

(∂(uU∂kP)∂U) ⁣⊤=1ρ2[2u ∂kPρ−∂kPmx−∂kPρ00],(∂(vU∂kP)∂U) ⁣⊤=1ρ2[2v ∂kPρ−∂kPmy0−∂kPρ0],\Big(\frac{\partial(u_U\partial_kP)}{\partial U}\Big)^{\!\top}=\frac1{\rho^2}\begin{bmatrix}2u\,\partial_kP^\rho-\partial_kP^{m_x}\\-\partial_kP^\rho\\0\\0\end{bmatrix},\qquad\Big(\frac{\partial(v_U\partial_kP)}{\partial U}\Big)^{\!\top}=\frac1{\rho^2}\begin{bmatrix}2v\,\partial_kP^\rho-\partial_kP^{m_y}\\0\\-\partial_kP^\rho\\0\end{bmatrix},
(∂(TU∂kP)∂U) ⁣⊤=1ρ2cv[(2E−3(u2+v2)) ∂kPρ+2u ∂kPmx+2v ∂kPmy−∂kPe2u ∂kPρ−∂kPmx2v ∂kPρ−∂kPmy−∂kPρ].\Big(\frac{\partial(T_U\partial_kP)}{\partial U}\Big)^{\!\top}=\frac1{\rho^2c_v}\begin{bmatrix}(2E-3(u^2+v^2))\,\partial_kP^\rho+2u\,\partial_kP^{m_x}+2v\,\partial_kP^{m_y}-\partial_kP^e\\2u\,\partial_kP^\rho-\partial_kP^{m_x}\\2v\,\partial_kP^\rho-\partial_kP^{m_y}\\-\partial_kP^\rho\end{bmatrix}.

把 uu 的这一行乘上 δP\delta P，得到 −(∂kPρ/ρ) δu−(Gku/ρ) δρ-(\partial_kP^\rho/\rho)\,\delta u-(G_k^u/\rho)\,\delta\rho，与第 7 节已有的 δGku\delta G_k^u 相同。反向时这两项变成两条路径：∂kP‾+=θU⊤ G‾kθ\overline{\partial_kP}\mathrel{+}=\theta_U^{\top}\,\overline G_k^\theta，以及 P‾+=(∂(θU∂kP)/∂U)⊤ G‾kθ\overline P\mathrel{+}=\big(\partial(\theta_U\partial_kP)/\partial U\big)^{\top}\,\overline G_k^\theta。

Multiplying the row for uu by δP\delta P gives −(∂kPρ/ρ) δu−(Gku/ρ) δρ-(\partial_kP^\rho/\rho)\,\delta u-(G_k^u/\rho)\,\delta\rho, the δGku\delta G_k^u already written in Section 7. In reverse the two terms become two paths: ∂kP‾+=θU⊤ G‾kθ\overline{\partial_kP}\mathrel{+}=\theta_U^{\top}\,\overline G_k^\theta and P‾+=(∂(θU∂kP)/∂U)⊤ G‾kθ\overline P\mathrel{+}=\big(\partial(\theta_U\partial_kP)/\partial U\big)^{\top}\,\overline G_k^\theta.

核对：在物理绕流基准的一个实际 Gauss 点（面 0），第二步的五行与第四步的六行（x,yx,y 两个斜率方向）与 physics.js 的 prim() 和 gradient() 经过运算图求导的结果相比，最大相对差分别为 7.1×10−167.1\times10^{-16} 和 2.5×10−162.5\times10^{-16}；常物性与 Sutherland 两种模式都检查了（本页代码在构建时计算）

Check: at a real Gauss point of the physical-flow baseline (face 0), the five rows of Step 2 and the six rows of Step 4 (slopes in xx and yy) agree with the graph derivatives of prim() and gradient() in physics.js to a maximum relative difference of 7.1×10−167.1\times10^{-16} and 2.5×10−162.5\times10^{-16}; both constant and Sutherland transport are checked (computed by this page's code at build time)

逐步推导：从三维 Newton 应力到面黏性通量及其 Jacobian

Step by step: from the 3-D Newtonian stress to the viscous face flux and its Jacobian

第一步，从三维本构出发。速度为 (u,v,0)(u,v,0)，且任何量都不随 zz 变化，所以速度梯度矩阵的第三行和第三列为零，∇⋅u=ux+vy\nabla\cdot\mathbf u=u_x+v_y：

Step 1, start from the 3-D constitutive law. The velocity is (u,v,0)(u,v,0) and nothing varies with zz, so the third row and column of the velocity-gradient matrix vanish and ∇⋅u=ux+vy\nabla\cdot\mathbf u=u_x+v_y:

τ=μ(∇u+∇u⊤)−23μ(∇⋅u)I,∇u=[uxuy0vxvy0000],\tau=\mu\big(\nabla\mathbf u+\nabla\mathbf u^{\top}\big)-\tfrac23\mu(\nabla\cdot\mathbf u)I,\qquad\nabla\mathbf u=\begin{bmatrix}u_x&u_y&0\\v_x&v_y&0\\0&0&0\end{bmatrix},
τxx=2μux−23μ(ux+vy)=μ(43ux−23vy),τxy=μ(uy+vx),τyy=μ(43vy−23ux),\tau_{xx}=2\mu u_x-\tfrac23\mu(u_x+v_y)=\mu\big(\tfrac43u_x-\tfrac23v_y\big),\qquad\tau_{xy}=\mu(u_y+v_x),\qquad\tau_{yy}=\mu\big(\tfrac43v_y-\tfrac23u_x\big),
τzz=−23μ(ux+vy),τxz=τyz=0.\tau_{zz}=-\tfrac23\mu(u_x+v_y),\qquad\tau_{xz}=\tau_{yz}=0.

τzz\tau_{zz} 一般不为零，但它不作用在任何法向位于 xyxy 平面内的面上，所以只剩下三个分量。离散时把 uxu_x 换成面梯度 GxuG_x^u，依此类推（physics.js 的 viscous()）。

τzz\tau_{zz} is generally nonzero, but it acts on no face whose normal lies in the xyxy plane, so three components remain. The discrete code replaces uxu_x by the face gradient GxuG_x^u, and so on (viscous() in physics.js).

第二步，用 Cauchy 公式求面上的牵引，并加上导热：

Step 2, form the traction on a face with Cauchy's formula and add conduction:

τn=[τxxnx+τxynyτxynx+τyyny],qn=−κ GT⋅n,Fv=[0(τn)x(τn)yu(τn)x+v(τn)y−qn].\tau n=\begin{bmatrix}\tau_{xx}n_x+\tau_{xy}n_y\\\tau_{xy}n_x+\tau_{yy}n_y\end{bmatrix},\qquad q_n=-\kappa\,G^T\cdot n,\qquad F^v=\begin{bmatrix}0\\(\tau n)_x\\(\tau n)_y\\u(\tau n)_x+v(\tau n)_y-q_n\end{bmatrix}.

图 2.3 画出了物理绕流基准中一个实际面点的这些量。

Figure 2.3 draws these quantities at a real face point of the physical-flow baseline.

第三步，对六个面梯度 g=(Gxu,Gyu,Gxv,Gyv,GxT,GyT)g=(G_x^u,G_y^u,G_x^v,G_y^v,G_x^T,G_y^T) 线性化。把第一步的应力代入第二步，每个动量行都是 gg 的线性函数；能量行等于 uu 乘第二行、vv 乘第三行，再加上 −qn-q_n 对 GTG^T 的导数 κn\kappa n：

Step 3, linearise in the six face gradients g=(Gxu,Gyu,Gxv,Gyv,GxT,GyT)g=(G_x^u,G_y^u,G_x^v,G_y^v,G_x^T,G_y^T). Substituting Step 1 into Step 2 makes each momentum row linear in gg; the energy row is uu times row two plus vv times row three, plus the derivative κn\kappa n of −qn-q_n with respect to GTG^T:

∂Fv∂g=[00000043μnxμnyμny−23μnx00−23μnyμnxμnx43μny0043μunx−23μvnyμ(uny+vnx)μ(uny+vnx)43μvny−23μunxκnxκny].\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial g}=\begin{bmatrix}0&0&0&0&0&0\\\tfrac43\mu n_x&\mu n_y&\mu n_y&-\tfrac23\mu n_x&0&0\\-\tfrac23\mu n_y&\mu n_x&\mu n_x&\tfrac43\mu n_y&0&0\\\tfrac43\mu un_x-\tfrac23\mu vn_y&\mu(un_y+vn_x)&\mu(un_y+vn_x)&\tfrac43\mu vn_y-\tfrac23\mu un_x&\kappa n_x&\kappa n_y\end{bmatrix}.

∂Fv∂(u,v)=[000000(τn)x(τn)y],∂Fv∂μ=1μ[0(τn)x(τn)yu(τn)x+v(τn)y],∂Fv∂κ=[000GT⋅n],\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial(u,v)}=\begin{bmatrix}0&0\\0&0\\0&0\\(\tau n)_x&(\tau n)_y\end{bmatrix},\quad\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial\mu}=\frac1\mu\begin{bmatrix}0\\(\tau n)_x\\(\tau n)_y\\u(\tau n)_x+v(\tau n)_y\end{bmatrix},\quad\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial\kappa}=\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\0\\G^T\cdot n\end{bmatrix},
∂Fv∂n=[00τxxτxyτxyτyyuτxx+vτxy+κGxTuτxy+vτyy+κGyT].\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial n}=\begin{bmatrix}0&0\\\tau_{xx}&\tau_{xy}\\\tau_{xy}&\tau_{yy}\\u\tau_{xx}+v\tau_{xy}+\kappa G_x^T&u\tau_{xy}+v\tau_{yy}+\kappa G_y^T\end{bmatrix}.

∂Fv/∂μ\partial F^v/\partial\mu 在 κ\kappa 固定时计算；κ\kappa 通过 κ=cpμ/Pr\kappa=c_p\mu/Pr 另有一条路径，见下一步。法向导数最后还要乘上第 11 节的 δn=(I−nn⊤)δN/s\delta n=(I-nn^{\top})\delta N/s。

∂Fv/∂μ\partial F^v/\partial\mu holds κ\kappa fixed; κ\kappa has its own path through κ=cpμ/Pr\kappa=c_p\mu/Pr, see the next step. The normal derivative is finally multiplied by δn=(I−nn⊤)δN/s\delta n=(I-nn^{\top})\delta N/s from Section 11.

Step 5, differentiate the transport law. Sutherland's law with reference temperature 1 and constant S=0.4S=0.4, normalised so that f(1)=1f(1)=1:

一个面的通量读取哪些状态

Which states one face flux reads

面通量用到两侧的二次迹、它们的斜率和二阶对流的线性迹。每一项都来自拟合系数 ci=Hi−1Bi⊤Widic_i=H_i^{-1}B_i^{\top}W_id_i，而 did_i 含有邻域 Ni\mathcal N_i 中每个状态与 UiU_i 之差。所以内部面 ff 的通量读取集合

A face flux uses the quadratic traces on both sides, their slopes and the linear convective traces. Each comes from fit coefficients ci=Hi−1Bi⊤Widic_i=H_i^{-1}B_i^{\top}W_id_i, where did_i holds the difference between UiU_i and every state of the stencil Ni\mathcal N_i. The interior face ff therefore reads the set

Nf={L}∪NL∪{R}∪NR(boundary face: Nf={L}∪NL).\mathcal N_f=\{L\}\cup\mathcal N_L\cup\{R\}\cup\mathcal N_R\qquad(\text{boundary face: }\mathcal N_f=\{L\}\cup\mathcal N_L).

基网格上每个面读取 15–19 个状态（本页代码在构建时统计）。图 2.5 画出按上文逐圈规则得到的单元 0 的邻域，以及附录 B.4 逐项跟踪的面 0 的读取集合；反向时，这个面的种子恰好写回同一组状态。

On the base mesh each face reads 15–19 states (counted by this page's code at build time). Figure 2.5 shows the stencil of cell 0 given by the ring-by-ring rule above, and the read set of face 0, the face that Appendix B.4 follows number by number; in reverse, the seed of that face writes back into exactly the same states.

第 3 节Section 3

完整边界闭合

Complete boundary closures

分别选择入流和牵引出口。切换到绕流后，再比较等温与绝热壁面；每次先重新计算。

Compare inflow and traction outflow. In the physical-flow case, recompute and compare isothermal and adiabatic walls.

图 3.1：两类热学边界Figure 3.1: Thermal boundary conditions

先定义边界函数，再对边界函数求导

Define a boundary function before differentiating it

制造解在内外边界按固定入流／出流分区提供数据；它的内圈不是固壁。绕流算例的内圈才是静止无滑移壁。分区由基网格面法向与固定方向 (0.22,0.055)(0.22,0.055) 的点积决定，求导时保持不变；参数或几何扰动越过支持范围需要报告，不能默默切换分支。

Manufactured data use fixed inflow/outflow partitions on both boundaries; the inner boundary is not a solid wall in that case. Only the flow case has a stationary no-slip inner wall. The base normal dotted with fixed direction (0.22,0.055)(0.22,0.055) sets the partition, held fixed during differentiation. Perturbations outside the supported branch must be reported, not silently switched.

Gbθ=∇θ(PL)+2(θb−θ(PL))hbn,hb={(xb−xL)⋅ncell,VLnode.G_b^\theta=\nabla\theta(P_L)+\frac{2(\theta_b-\theta(P_L))}{h_b}n,\qquad h_b=\begin{cases}(x_b-x_L)\cdot n&\text{cell},\\\sqrt{V_L}&\text{node}.\end{cases}

入口给定密度、两个速度和温度。对流使用规定状态的物理通量；速度、温度的黏性梯度使用上式弱边界修正。几何距离和边界数据都要参与求导。这里没有把同一模板无条件宣称为任意网格上的二阶壁面应力。

Inflow prescribes density, both velocities and temperature. Convection uses the prescribed physical flux, while viscous gradients of velocity and temperature receive the weak boundary correction above. Geometry distances and prescribed data are differentiated. This stencil is not unconditionally advertised as second-order wall stress on arbitrary meshes.

出口采用总牵引与热流

Outflow specifies total traction and heat flux

tb=pn−τn,Hb=[ρunρuun+tb,xρvun+tb,yeun+(u,v)⋅tb+qb].t_b=pn-\tau n,\quad H_b=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\\rho u u_n+t_{b,x}\\\rho v u_n+t_{b,y}\\e u_n+(u,v)\cdot t_b+q_b\end{bmatrix}.

绕流外出口取 tb=n,qb=0t_b=n,q_b=0；制造解取解析场的总牵引和热流。出口通量中的压力与应力已按条件消去，不能再叠加一次内部黏性通量。它是有限截断域的边界闭合，不是未经证明的无限远条件。

Flow outflow uses tb=n,qb=0t_b=n,q_b=0; manufactured outflow uses analytic traction and heat flux. Pressure and stress have already been eliminated in this net boundary flux: do not subtract an interior viscous flux again. This defines a truncated-domain closure, not a proven infinite-far-field condition.

固壁的机械与热学条件

Mechanical and thermal wall conditions

ub=vb=0,Tb=Tw or qb=0,Hb,ρ=0,Hb,E=qb.u_b=v_b=0,\qquad T_b=T_w\ \text{or}\ q_b=0,\qquad H_{b,\rho}=0,\quad H_{b,E}=q_b.

等温壁把壁温送入物性和梯度修正；绝热壁显式令法向热流为零。壁面密度从内部二次迹外推，压力由该密度和面温度得到。因为壁面速度为零，黏性功在壁面净能量通量中为零。

An isothermal wall sends wall temperature into transport and gradient correction; an adiabatic wall sets normal heat flux to zero. Extrapolate density from the interior quadratic trace and form pressure with face temperature. Zero wall velocity eliminates wall viscous work from net energy flux.

格心版没有边界存储点，所有条件通过面通量和梯度修正进入残差，不覆盖任何残差行。

Cells have no stored boundary points. Conditions enter through face fluxes and gradient corrections, with no residual-row replacement.

把边界条件代入通量，而不只是写在图上

Substitute boundary data into the actual flux

出口给定的是总牵引 tb=pn−τnt_b=pn-\tau n，不是同时各自给定压力和所有速度导数。将这个等式代入动量通量，pn−τnpn-\tau n 就整体替换为 tbt_b；能量中同样合并压力功与黏性功：

Outflow specifies total traction tb=pn−τnt_b=pn-\tau n, not pressure and all velocity derivatives independently. Substitute it into momentum flux. Combine pressure and viscous work in energy in the same way:

(e+p)un−(u,v)⋅τn+qn=eun+(u,v)⋅(pn−τn)+qn=eun+(u,v)⋅tb+qb.(e+p)u_n-(u,v)\cdot\tau n+q_n=e u_n+(u,v)\cdot(pn-\tau n)+q_n=e u_n+(u,v)\cdot t_b+q_b.

固壁处速度为零，所以质量通量为零、压力功为零、黏性功也为零，只剩法向导热通量进入能量收支。等温边界规定温度值；绝热边界规定法向热流。两者不是同时施加的两个条件。

At a stationary no-slip wall, mass flux, pressure work and viscous work vanish, leaving normal heat in the energy balance. Isothermal data specify temperature; adiabatic data specify normal heat flux. They are alternative conditions.

以一个原始变量 θ\theta 为例，弱梯度修正中的距离、法向、内侧迹和边界值都可能变化。把 Δθ=θb−θL\Delta\theta=\theta_b-\theta_L 记清楚，就可以用乘积与商法则逐项求导：

For one primitive variable θ\theta, boundary distance, normal, interior trace and prescribed value may all vary. Writing Δθ=θb−θL\Delta\theta=\theta_b-\theta_L, product and quotient rules give every term:

δGbθ=δGLθ+2(δθb−δθL)hbn−2Δθhb2(δhb)n+2Δθhbδn.\delta G_b^\theta=\delta G_L^\theta+\frac{2(\delta\theta_b-\delta\theta_L)}{h_b}n-\frac{2\Delta\theta}{h_b^2}(\delta h_b)n+\frac{2\Delta\theta}{h_b}\delta n.

上式的 hbh_b 是边界长度尺度，δhb\delta h_b 是它的变化。若是规定不变的壁温，其状态方向导数为零，但“对壁温参数求导”时 δTb\delta T_b 不为零。

Here hbh_b is the boundary length scale and δhb\delta h_b its variation. A fixed prescribed temperature has zero state derivative, but a wall-temperature design direction has nonzero δTb\delta T_b.

边界沿用同一个系数 2。在一维壁面，设单元中心到壁面的距离为 hbh_b，线性重构的内侧迹为 θL=θc+g hb\theta_L=\theta_c+g\,h_b，修正后的法向梯度化为 Gb=2(θb−θc)/hb−gG_b=2(\theta_b-\theta_c)/h_b-g：两点差分的两倍减去重构梯度，对线性分布精确。惩罚项 2(θb−θL)/hb2(\theta_b-\theta_L)/h_b 把内侧迹拉向规定值，这就是弱施加（Nitsche 型）：系数越大越接近强施加，但它只改变有限网格误差，不改变相容性。格心的 hb=(xb−xL)⋅nh_b=(x_b-x_L)\cdot n 是单元中心到该面求积点的法向距离，随网格一起按 hh 缩小。

The boundary reuses the coefficient 2. At a 1D wall, let hbh_b be the distance from the cell centre to the wall; the linear trace is θL=θc+g hb\theta_L=\theta_c+g\,h_b and the corrected normal gradient becomes Gb=2(θb−θc)/hb−gG_b=2(\theta_b-\theta_c)/h_b-g: twice the two-point difference minus the reconstructed gradient, exact for linear profiles. The penalty 2(θb−θL)/hb2(\theta_b-\theta_L)/h_b pulls the interior trace towards the prescribed value. This is weak (Nitsche-type) imposition: a larger coefficient approaches strong imposition but only changes finite-mesh error, not consistency. For cells hb=(xb−xL)⋅nh_b=(x_b-x_L)\cdot n is the normal distance from the centroid to the face Gauss point and shrinks with hh.

图 3.2 标出本页每个边界面采用的闭合：入流、出流由固定方向 (0.22,0.055)(0.22,0.055) 与面法向的点积划分，内圈在物理绕流中是无滑移固壁。

Figure 3.2 marks the closure used on every boundary face: inflow and outflow are split by the dot product of the face normal with the fixed direction (0.22,0.055)(0.22,0.055), and the inner ring is a no-slip wall in the physical flow.

逐步推导：固壁 Gauss 点的线性化与转置

Step by step: linearising and transposing a wall Gauss point

第一步，写出点通量的值（core.js 面循环中的固壁分支）。固壁只用左侧的二次迹 PL(x)P_L(x) 及其斜率：

Step 1, write the value of the point flux (the wall branch of the face loop in core.js). A wall point uses only the left quadratic trace PL(x)P_L(x) and its slopes:

ρb=ρ(PL),Tb={TwisothermalT(PL)adiabatic,pb=ρbTb,Gbθ=∇θ(PL)+2 (θb−θ(PL))hb n,\rho_b=\rho(P_L),\quad T_b=\begin{cases}T_w&\text{isothermal}\\T(P_L)&\text{adiabatic}\end{cases},\quad p_b=\rho_bT_b,\quad G_b^\theta=\nabla\theta(P_L)+\frac{2\,(\theta_b-\theta(P_L))}{h_b}\,n,

罚项里的规定值是 ub=vb=0u_b=v_b=0；温度只在等温壁上修正，Tb=TwT_b=T_w。

The prescribed values in the penalty are ub=vb=0u_b=v_b=0; temperature is corrected only at an isothermal wall, with Tb=TwT_b=T_w.

Fqwall=[0pbnx−(τbn)xpbny−(τbn)yqn,b],τb=μ(Tb) S(Gb),qn,b=−κ(Tb) GbT⋅n.F_q^{\rm wall}=\begin{bmatrix}0\\p_bn_x-(\tau_bn)_x\\p_bn_y-(\tau_bn)_y\\q_{n,b}\end{bmatrix},\qquad\tau_b=\mu(T_b)\,\mathcal S(G_b),\qquad q_{n,b}=-\kappa(T_b)\,G_b^T\cdot n.

绝热壁不修正温度梯度，并把能量分量直接置零（qn,b=0q_{n,b}=0）。无滑移使黏性功 ub(τbn)x+vb(τbn)yu_b(\tau_bn)_x+v_b(\tau_bn)_y 消失，所以能量行只剩热流。

An adiabatic wall leaves the temperature gradient uncorrected and sets the energy entry to zero (qn,b=0q_{n,b}=0). No slip removes the viscous work ub(τbn)x+vb(τbn)yu_b(\tau_bn)_x+v_b(\tau_bn)_y, so only the heat flux remains in energy.

第二步，对状态方向线性化。规定值 θb\theta_b 不随状态变化，所以罚项只通过内侧迹 θL=θ(PL)\theta_L=\theta(P_L) 变化：

Step 2, linearise along a state direction. The prescribed θb\theta_b does not change with the state, so the penalty varies only through the interior trace θL=θ(PL)\theta_L=\theta(P_L):

δpb=Tb δρb+ρb δTb,δGbθ=δ∇θL−2hb δθL n,\delta p_b=T_b\,\delta\rho_b+\rho_b\,\delta T_b,\qquad\delta G_b^\theta=\delta\nabla\theta_L-\frac2{h_b}\,\delta\theta_L\,n,
δ(τbn)=δμμ τbn+μ S(δGb) n,δqn,b=−δκ GbT⋅n−κ δGbT⋅n.\delta(\tau_bn)=\frac{\delta\mu}{\mu}\,\tau_bn+\mu\,\mathcal S(\delta G_b)\,n,\qquad\delta q_{n,b}=-\delta\kappa\,G_b^T\cdot n-\kappa\,\delta G_b^T\cdot n.

等温壁 Tb=TwT_b=T_w 固定，因此 δTb=δμ=δκ=0\delta T_b=\delta\mu=\delta\kappa=0：物性在等温壁上没有状态导数，只有对 TwT_w 的设计导数。绝热壁 δTb=δTL\delta T_b=\delta T_L，δμ=μTδTL\delta\mu=\mu_T\delta T_L。δθL\delta\theta_L 与 δ∇θL\delta\nabla\theta_L 用第 2 节的行与二阶行。

At an isothermal wall Tb=TwT_b=T_w is fixed, so δTb=δμ=δκ=0\delta T_b=\delta\mu=\delta\kappa=0: transport has no state derivative there, only a design derivative with respect to TwT_w. At an adiabatic wall δTb=δTL\delta T_b=\delta T_L and δμ=μTδTL\delta\mu=\mu_T\delta T_L. δθL\delta\theta_L and δ∇θL\delta\nabla\theta_L use the rows and second rows of Section 2.

第三步，转置。边界面只有左侧，种子为 ηf=w~L\eta_f=\widetilde w_L，点通量的权重为 Fˉ=wqηf\bar F=w_q\eta_f。把第一步每一项的系数反过来收集：

Step 3, transpose. A boundary face has only a left side, so the seed is ηf=w~L\eta_f=\widetilde w_L and the point-flux weight is Fˉ=wqηf\bar F=w_q\eta_f. Collect the coefficient of each term of Step 1 in reverse:

pˉb=Fˉmxnx+Fˉmyny,τbn‾=−(Fˉmx,Fˉmy),qˉn,b={FˉEisothermal0adiabatic,\bar p_b=\bar F_{m_x}n_x+\bar F_{m_y}n_y,\qquad\overline{\tau_bn}=-(\bar F_{m_x},\bar F_{m_y}),\qquad\bar q_{n,b}=\begin{cases}\bar F_E&\text{isothermal}\\0&\text{adiabatic}\end{cases},
ρˉb+=Tb pˉb,Tˉb+=ρb pˉb+μT μˉ,∇θL‾+=Gˉbθ,θˉL+=−2hb n⋅Gˉbθ.\bar\rho_b\mathrel{+}=T_b\,\bar p_b,\qquad\bar T_b\mathrel{+}=\rho_b\,\bar p_b+\mu_T\,\bar\mu,\qquad\overline{\nabla\theta_L}\mathrel{+}=\bar G_b^\theta,\qquad\bar\theta_L\mathrel{+}=-\frac2{h_b}\,n\cdot\bar G_b^\theta.

Gˉb\bar G_b、μˉ\bar\mu 由 τbn‾\overline{\tau_bn} 与 qˉn,b\bar q_{n,b} 按第 8 节的应力和热流反传得到。ρˉb\bar\rho_b 加到 PˉLρ\bar P_L^\rho；Tˉb\bar T_b 在等温壁上是对设计变量 TwT_w 的贡献，在绝热壁上加到 TˉL\bar T_L。最后 θˉL,∇θL‾\bar\theta_L,\overline{\nabla\theta_L} 经第 2 节的行和第 8 节的拟合转置回到状态。

Gˉb\bar G_b and μˉ\bar\mu come from τbn‾\overline{\tau_bn} and qˉn,b\bar q_{n,b} through the stress and heat reverse of Section 8. ρˉb\bar\rho_b is added to PˉLρ\bar P_L^\rho; Tˉb\bar T_b contributes to the design variable TwT_w at an isothermal wall and to TˉL\bar T_L at an adiabatic one. Finally θˉL,∇θL‾\bar\theta_L,\overline{\nabla\theta_L} return to the states through the rows of Section 2 and the fit transpose of Section 8.

格心版本没有强边界行（Ibc=II_{\rm bc}=I）：固壁完全通过上面的点通量进入残差，第三步就是它的全部转置。

The cell-centred version has no strong rows (Ibc=II_{\rm bc}=I): the wall enters the residual only through the point flux above, and Step 3 is its complete transpose.

固定网格拓扑后的有限维函数

A finite-dimensional function at fixed topology

Rh(Uh,a,X)=Ibc[∑fBfHf−Sh]+Ebcc(Uh,a,X),Hf=∑s⊂f∑q=12ss2(F^nc−Fnv)q.R_h(\mathbf U_h,a,X)=I_{\rm bc}\left[\sum_f B_fH_f-S_h\right]+E_{\rm bc}c(\mathbf U_h,a,X),\quad H_f=\sum_{s\subset f}\sum_{q=1}^2\frac{s_s}{2}(\widehat F_n^c-F_n^v)_q.

geometry = areas, centroids, moments, subfaces, quadrature

从积分守恒定律逐步得到残差

Deriving the residual from integral conservation

对静止控制体写“积累率＋净流出＝体源”。对流减黏性的符号沿用第 2 节；散度定理把面积上的散度积分变成边界积分：

For a stationary volume write “accumulation + net outward flux = source.” With the convection-minus-viscosity convention, the divergence theorem converts area divergence into boundary flux:

ddt∫ViU dA+∫∂Vi(Fnc−Fnv) ds−∫ViS dA=0.\frac{d}{dt}\int_{V_i}U\,dA+\int_{\partial V_i}(F_n^c-F_n^v)\,ds-\int_{V_i}S\,dA=0.
steady:Riraw=∑fσifHf−Si,σif={+1i=L(f),−1i=R(f),0otherwise.\text{steady:}\qquad R_i^{\rm raw}=\sum_f\sigma_{if}H_f-S_i,\quad \sigma_{if}=\begin{cases}+1&i=L(f),\\-1&i=R(f),\\0&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases}

每个内部面只有一个四分量 HfH_f。左单元加它、右单元减它，因而求和时严格抵消。这是离散守恒最直接的检查，与是否使用一阶或二阶重构无关：

Each interior face has one four-component HfH_f, added left and subtracted right. It cancels in the global sum, regardless of reconstruction order:

∑iRiraw=∑f∈∂ΩhHf−∑iSi.\sum_iR_i^{\rm raw}=\sum_{f\in\partial\Omega_h}H_f-\sum_iS_i.

一个直子面的两个 Gauss 点为中点加减切向位移，每个权重都是半个面长。弯折对偶面分别对子面应用此公式。先对点求通量，后乘权重，不能把单位法向中的归一化面长又乘进去一次：

The two Gauss points on a straight segment are symmetric about its midpoint, with half-length weights. Apply this separately to bent dual segments. Evaluate point flux, then multiply its weight exactly once:

x±=xa+xb2±xb−xa23,Hf=∑s⊂fss2[Fn(x−)+Fn(x+)],Fn=F^nc−Fnv.x_\pm=\frac{x_a+x_b}{2}\pm\frac{x_b-x_a}{2\sqrt3},\quad H_f=\sum_{s\subset f}\frac{s_s}{2}[F_n(x_-)+F_n(x_+)],\quad F_n=\widehat F_n^c-F_n^v.

最后才覆盖格点强边界行。掩码矩阵 IbcI_{\rm bc} 的保留行对角为 1、覆盖行对角为 0；EbcE_{\rm bc} 把边界条件的数值填到指定位置。格心版 Ibc=II_{\rm bc}=I，没有此覆盖步骤。

Strong nodal rows are replaced last. Diagonal mask IbcI_{\rm bc} is one for retained rows and zero for replaced rows; EbcE_{\rm bc} inserts constraints at their assigned positions. For cells Ibc=II_{\rm bc}=I and there is no replacement.

逐步推导：为什么每段两个 Gauss 点、每个三角形七个点就够了

Step by step: why two Gauss points per segment and seven per triangle suffice

图 4.2 画出一个控制体实际使用的求积点。

Figure 4.2 shows the quadrature points one control volume actually uses.

第一步，推导两点 Gauss 公式。把线段写成 x(ξ)=12(xa+xb)+ξ2(xb−xa)x(\xi)=\tfrac12(x_a+x_b)+\tfrac\xi2(x_b-x_a)，ds=s2dξds=\tfrac{s}{2}d\xi。要求 ∫−11ξkdξ=w1ξ1k+w2ξ2k\int_{-1}^1\xi^kd\xi=w_1\xi_1^k+w_2\xi_2^k 对 k=0,1,2,3k=0,1,2,3 成立：

Step 1, derive the two-point Gauss rule. Write the segment as x(ξ)=12(xa+xb)+ξ2(xb−xa)x(\xi)=\tfrac12(x_a+x_b)+\tfrac\xi2(x_b-x_a) with ds=s2dξds=\tfrac{s}{2}d\xi, and require ∫−11ξkdξ=w1ξ1k+w2ξ2k\int_{-1}^1\xi^kd\xi=w_1\xi_1^k+w_2\xi_2^k for k=0,1,2,3k=0,1,2,3:

w1+w2=2,w1ξ1+w2ξ2=0,w1ξ12+w2ξ22=23,w1ξ13+w2ξ23=0.w_1+w_2=2,\qquad w_1\xi_1+w_2\xi_2=0,\qquad w_1\xi_1^2+w_2\xi_2^2=\tfrac23,\qquad w_1\xi_1^3+w_2\xi_2^3=0.

由第二、四式得 ξ2=−ξ1\xi_2=-\xi_1、w1=w2w_1=w_2；再由第一、三式，

The second and fourth conditions give ξ2=−ξ1\xi_2=-\xi_1 and w1=w2w_1=w_2; the first and third then give

w1=w2=1,ξ1,2=∓13.w_1=w_2=1,\qquad\xi_{1,2}=\mp\frac1{\sqrt3}.

乘上 ds=s2dξds=\tfrac s2d\xi，得到第 4 节的求积点 x±x_\pm 和权重 s/2s/2。它对沿线段的三次多项式精确；通量本身不是多项式，所以面通量仍有求积误差。

Multiplying by ds=s2dξds=\tfrac s2d\xi gives the points x±x_\pm and weights s/2s/2 of Section 4. The rule is exact for cubics along the segment; the flux itself is not a polynomial, so face fluxes still carry quadrature error.

第二步，体积分。多边形从第一个顶点剖分成扇形三角形，每个三角形用 7 点 5 次精确公式（geometry.js 的 bary 表）。面积、形心和二阶矩的被积函数 1,x,y,x2,xy,y21,x,y,x^2,xy,y^2 都不超过 2 次，因此它们是精确值：

Step 2, volume integrals. The polygon is split into a fan of triangles from its first vertex; each triangle uses a 7-point rule exact to degree 5 (the bary table in geometry.js). Area, centroid and second moments integrate 1,x,y,x2,xy,y21,x,y,x^2,xy,y^2, all of degree at most 2, so they are exact:

Vi=∑qwiq,xi=1Vi∑qwiq xiq,Mxx,i=1Vi∑qwiq (xiq−xi)2, …V_i=\sum_qw_{iq},\qquad x_i=\frac1{V_i}\sum_qw_{iq}\,x_{iq},\qquad M_{xx,i}=\frac1{V_i}\sum_qw_{iq}\,(x_{iq}-x_i)^2,\ \ldots

这里 qq 取遍所有扇形三角形上的七个点；每个三角形上七个权重之和等于它的面积。

Here qq runs over the seven points of every fan triangle; on each triangle the seven weights add up to its area.

第三步，得到平均值守恒。形心处 ⟨Δx⟩i=⟨Δy⟩i=0\langle\Delta x\rangle_i=\langle\Delta y\rangle_i=0，二次项减去的正是中心矩，所以重构多项式在本单元上的平均值精确等于存储值：

Step 3, conservation of the mean follows. About the centroid ⟨Δx⟩i=⟨Δy⟩i=0\langle\Delta x\rangle_i=\langle\Delta y\rangle_i=0, and the quadratic terms subtract exactly the central moments, so the reconstruction averages to the stored value:

⟨Pi⟩i=Ui+cx,i⟨Δx⟩i+cy,i⟨Δy⟩i+cxx,i(⟨Δx2⟩i−Mxx,i)+⋯=Ui.\langle P_i\rangle_i=U_i+c_{x,i}\langle\Delta x\rangle_i+c_{y,i}\langle\Delta y\rangle_i+c_{xx,i}\big(\langle\Delta x^2\rangle_i-M_{xx,i}\big)+\cdots=U_i.

Jacobian 与原始求解

Jacobian and primal solve

选择残差块行 i 与状态块列 j，查看 4×4 导数块，并在网格上辨认依赖邻域。

Choose block row i and column j, inspect the 4×4 derivative block, and locate the stencil on the mesh.

精确算子与便宜的三角修正

Exact operators and inexpensive triangular corrections

Ah=Rh,U,Ph=Rh,U(1),Bh=(DP+LP)−1.A_h=R_{h,U},\quad P_h=R_{h,U}^{(1)},\quad B_h=(D_P+L_P)^{-1}.

PhP_h 在同一当前状态将对流切换为一阶，仍完整保留二次黏性重构、物性和边界。每个对角块为 4×44\times4，梯度依赖会产生远于最近邻的块。当前小网格预处理显式组装 PhP_h，主导数接口则通过计算图提供 AvAv 和 A⊤wA^{\top}w。

At the same state, PhP_h switches convection to first order while retaining quadratic viscosity reconstruction, transport and boundaries. Diagonal blocks are 4×44\times4 and gradient dependencies extend beyond nearest neighbours. The small-grid preconditioner explicitly assembles PhP_h, while main derivative interfaces provide graph-based AvAv and A⊤wA^{\top}w.

AhΔU=−Rh,Uk+1=Uk+ωkΔU.A_h\Delta U=-R_h,\qquad U^{k+1}=U^k+\omega_k\Delta U.

Newton 默认用分层 ASM／ILU 预处理 FGMRES，GS 保留为对照；回溯步长要求正密度、正温度、支持的速度范围以及残差下降。收敛后重新线性化，稳态伴随不求解 Newton 迭代轨迹的反向传播。下方残差是原始非线性残差，不能与线性迭代混作一条曲线。

Newton defaults to hierarchical ASM/ILU-preconditioned FGMRES and backtracking for positive density and temperature, supported speeds and residual decrease. Relinearize at convergence; the steady adjoint does not reverse the Newton iteration trajectory. The nonlinear residual below is distinct from inner linear convergence.

Newton 线性化与四乘四块

Newton linearization and four-by-four blocks

将第 i 个四分量残差对第 j 个四分量状态求偏导，得到 4×44\times4 块 AijA_{ij}。例如第一行、第二列是第 i 个质量残差对第 j 个 x 动量的导数。坐标和物理参数在这个偏导中保持固定：

Differentiating four residual components at i with respect to four state components at j produces a 4×44\times4 block AijA_{ij}. Its first-row, second-column entry differentiates mass residual i with respect to x-momentum j, holding coordinates and parameters fixed:

(Aij)kl=∂Ri,k∂Uj,l,(AhU˙h)i=∑jAijU˙j.(A_{ij})_{kl}=\frac{\partial R_{i,k}}{\partial U_{j,l}},\qquad (A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h)_i=\sum_jA_{ij}\dot U_j.
Rh(Uk+ΔU)=Rh(Uk)+Ah(Uk)ΔU+O(∥ΔU∥2).R_h(U^k+\Delta U)=R_h(U^k)+A_h(U^k)\Delta U+O(\|\Delta U\|^2).

希望下一步残差接近零，忽略二次小量后就得到 AhΔU=−RhA_h\Delta U=-R_h。Newton 步很大时，高阶项不能忽略，回溯才有必要。预处理只用来更便宜地解这个线性系统；它不能用一阶近似 Jacobian 替代实际二阶残差的精确 Jacobian。

Setting the linearized residual to zero gives AhΔU=−RhA_h\Delta U=-R_h. Large steps make neglected higher terms important, motivating backtracking. Preconditioning accelerates this linear solve; it does not replace the required exact second-order Jacobian by a first-order one.

matrix-free 的含义是“计算矩阵乘向量而不存储整个主矩阵”，不是“不存在 Jacobian”。代码沿局部计算链求得 AhU˙hA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h 或 Ah⊤wA_h^{\top}w；用于教学的小网格仍显式存储预处理矩阵 PhP_h。

Matrix-free means applying the main matrix without storing it, not that a Jacobian does not exist. Local chains produce AhU˙hA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h or Ah⊤wA_h^{\top}w, while the small teaching-grid preconditioner PhP_h is explicitly stored.

逐步推导：AhA_h 的哪些块不为零

Step by step: which blocks of AhA_h are nonzero

第一步，面 ff 的点通量只读取 Nf\mathcal N_f（第 2 节）。

Step 1, the point fluxes of face ff read only Nf\mathcal N_f (Section 2).

第二步，面循环把 HfH_f 加到左侧行、从右侧行减去，所以原始残差的块 (i,j)(i,j) 不为零，当且仅当某个以 ii 为一侧的面读取了 jj：

Step 2, the face loop adds HfH_f to the rows of LL and subtracts it from those of RR, so block (i,j)(i,j) of the raw residual is nonzero exactly when some face with ii on one side reads jj:

∂Riraw∂Uj≠0  ⟺  j∈⋃f: i∈{L(f),R(f)}Nf.\frac{\partial R_i^{\rm raw}}{\partial U_j}\ne0\iff j\in\bigcup_{f:\ i\in\{L(f),R(f)\}}\mathcal N_f.

第三步，比较一阶对流的预处理矩阵 PhP_h。一阶对流只读 L,RL,R，但黏性通量仍读取整个 Nf\mathcal N_f。

Step 3, compare the first-order preconditioner PhP_h. First-order convection reads only L,RL,R, but the viscous flux still reads the whole of Nf\mathcal N_f.

因此格心页上 PhP_h 与 AhA_h 的块结构完全相同：图 5.1 中两者都有 432 个非零块（共 576 块），其中只有 88 个是对角块或面邻居块。换成一阶对流改变的是数值，不是稀疏结构。附录 C 统计的默认制造解基准同样是 432 个。

So on the cell page PhP_h has exactly the block pattern of AhA_h: in Figure 5.1 both have 432 nonzero blocks (of 576), of which only 88 are diagonal or face-neighbour blocks. Switching convection to first order changes values, not sparsity. The default manufactured baseline counted in Appendix C has the same 432.

目标函数与壁面收支

Objectives and wall budgets

先判断当前目标在哪里积分，再区分压力、黏性和热流贡献。制造解内圈不是固壁。

Locate the integration domain, then separate pressure, viscous and heat contributions. The MMS inner boundary is not a wall.

离散目标先于目标梯度

Define the discrete objective before its gradient

JT,h=12∑i,qwiq[T(Uirec(xiq))−(1+0.02cos⁡xiq)]2.J_{T,h}=\frac12\sum_{i,q}w_{iq}\left[T(U_i^{\rm rec}(x_{iq}))-(1+0.02\cos x_{iq})\right]^2.
Fbody,h=∑f∈Γw,qwfq(pbnf−τbnf),Qw,h=∑f∈Γw,qwfqqn,b.F_{\rm body,h}=\sum_{f\in\Gamma_w,q}w_{fq}(p_bn_f-\tau_bn_f),\qquad Q_{w,h}=\sum_{f\in\Gamma_w,q}w_{fq}q_{n,b}.

流体域外法向在物面指向物体，因此流体对物体的合力为 pn−τnpn-\tau n。热流正号表示从流体流出到物体。制造解的内圈不是固壁，其“力”选项只是同一内边界牵引泛函。目标求积的重构、温度转换、法向、面长和壁温都属于目标导数；不能只对最终压力数值求导。

At the body the fluid-outward normal points into the body, so fluid-on-body force is pn−τnpn-\tau n. Positive heat flows out of the fluid into the body. The manufactured inner boundary is not a solid wall; its force option is the same mathematical traction functional. Objective derivatives include reconstruction, temperature conversion, normals, length and wall temperature.

J˙h=jU⊤U˙h+ja⊤da+jX⊤dX,jU∈R4N.\dot J_h=j_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h+j_a^{\top}d_a+j_X^{\top}d_X,\qquad j_U\in\mathbb R^{4N}.

压力和摩擦分别列出，再检查它们之和。温度跟踪使用一阶／二阶对应的对流重构；不能把它与黏性二次迹混用。热流对物性参数常有显式项，固定流场也不一定为零。

Display pressure and viscous contributions separately and verify their sum. Tracking uses the selected first/second-order convective reconstruction, not the quadratic viscous trace. Heat objectives generally have direct transport-parameter terms even at fixed flow.

这个例子的壁面热流目标 Q=−1.601×10−1Q=-1.601\times10^{-1}（负号表示热量从壁面流入流体），x／y 合力为 (5.79×10−1,1.90×10−2)(5.79\times10^{-1},1.90\times10^{-2})，其中黏性部分 (2.87×10−1,3.77×10−2)(2.87\times10^{-1},3.77\times10^{-2})。伴随敏感度最大的是顶点 5（极角 −2.15-2.15），∂Q/∂sn=−1.53×10−2\partial Q/\partial s_n=-1.53\times10^{-2}。这组数据与第 10 节的动画都由 run_flow_evidence.js 用本页代码在第 2 级加密网格上离线算出；浏览器里的层流算例用的是 24 个控制体的基网格。

For this case the wall-heat objective is Q=−1.601×10−1Q=-1.601\times10^{-1} (negative: heat flows from the wall into the fluid) and the x/y force is (5.79×10−1,1.90×10−2)(5.79\times10^{-1},1.90\times10^{-2}), with viscous part (2.87×10−1,3.77×10−2)(2.87\times10^{-1},3.77\times10^{-2}). The largest adjoint sensitivity is at vertex 5 (polar angle −2.15-2.15), ∂Q/∂sn=−1.53×10−2\partial Q/\partial s_n=-1.53\times10^{-2}. These data and the animation in Section 10 were computed offline by run_flow_evidence.js with this page's code on refinement level 2; the browser's own flow case uses the 24-volume base mesh.

加密后的层流算例

The flow case under refinement

同一算例逐级加密（run_flow_levels.js，第 0–4 级，与 A.18 相同的稀疏精确 Newton 与伴随）可以看出上图离收敛还有多远。从第 3 级到第 4 级，格心的 QQ 变化 0.026%，x 合力变化 0.78%；格点分别变化 6.6% 与 16%。第 4 级上两种格式的 QQ 仍相差 6.8%，x 合力相差 14%。格点的壁面量收敛更慢。一个可能的原因（这里没有单独验证）是：格点的壁面节点正好落在多边形的角点上，而角点附近的流场梯度是奇异的；第 14 节的无滑移制造解在角点处是光滑的，检验不到这一点。上图所用的第 2 级网格上，本页格式的 QQ 与第 4 级相差 1.2%。

Refining the same case (run_flow_levels.js, levels 0–4, with the same sparse exact Newton and adjoint as A.18) shows how far the figure is from converged. From level 3 to level 4, the cell values of QQ and of the x force change by 0.026% and 0.78%; the node values by 6.6% and 16%. At level 4 the two schemes still differ by 6.8% in QQ and 14% in the x force. The nodal wall quantities converge more slowly. A likely reason, not isolated here, is that the wall nodes sit exactly on the polygon corners, where the flow gradients are singular; the no-slip manufactured solution of Section 14 is smooth at the corners and cannot test this. On the level-2 mesh of the figure, this page’s QQ differs from its level-4 value by 1.2%.

把图中逐顶点的敏感度加起来，就是所有壁面顶点沿各自法向外移单位距离时 QQ 的导数（伴随梯度沿这一方向的分量；几何项由一次复数步长求值得到）。第 4 级格心为 −1.70×10−1-1.70\times10^{-1}，格点为 −3.40×10−1-3.40\times10^{-1}，格点约为格心的 2.0 倍。其中一部分并不是形状效应：只移动壁面顶点也会压扁第一层控制体，离散误差对这种压扁的导数只会随壁面附近的离散误差一起减小，而这里壁面附近收敛得慢。下表比较两个边界运动相同（壁面上都是径向单位向量）、因而连续导数相同的方向：只移动壁面顶点时，第 4 级格点值约为格心值的 1.7 倍；让全部顶点按光滑场 r^ ϕ(∣x∣)\hat r\,\phi(|x|) 移动（∣x∣≤0.9|x|\le0.9 时 ϕ=1\phi=1，到 ∣x∣=1.7|x|=1.7 光滑降为 0，外边界不动）时相差 4.2%。

Adding up the vertex values of the figure gives the derivative of QQ when every wall vertex moves outward by a unit distance along its own normal (the adjoint gradient along that direction; the geometric terms come from one complex-step evaluation). At level 4 it is −1.70×10−1-1.70\times10^{-1} for cells and −3.40×10−1-3.40\times10^{-1} for nodes, a factor of 2.0 apart. Part of this is not a shape effect: moving only the wall vertices also squeezes the first layer of control volumes, and the derivative of the discretization error with respect to that squeeze decreases only as fast as the error next to the wall, which converges slowly here. The table below compares two directions with the same boundary motion (the radial unit vector on the wall), hence the same continuum derivative: moving only the wall vertices, the node value is 1.7 times the cell value at level 4; moving all vertices with the smooth field r^ ϕ(∣x∣)\hat r\,\phi(|x|) (ϕ=1\phi=1 for ∣x∣≤0.9|x|\le0.9, decreasing smoothly to 0 at ∣x∣=1.7|x|=1.7, outer boundary fixed), they differ by 4.2%.

逐顶点的值是离散 QQ 的精确导数：在顶点 5 沿法向作 h=1×10−5h=1\times10^{-5} 的全重算中心差分（run_flow_fd.js），得到 −1.52886×10−2-1.52886\times10^{-2}，伴随为 −1.52887×10−2-1.52887\times10^{-2}；两个核对顶点的最大相对差为 9.2×10−69.2\times10^{-6}。但它们同样带有离散误差，也包含上面的网格压扁效应：本页的图中全部顶点的值都为负。所以图中的敏感度演示的是一次伴随求解如何给出全部顶点的导数，不能直接当作连续问题的形状梯度；形状优化应通过光滑的网格运动（第 11 节的网格映射 X=M(b)X=\mathcal M(b)）使用它们。

The vertex values are exact derivatives of the discrete QQ: a reconverged central difference with h=1×10−5h=1\times10^{-5} along the normal of vertex 5 (run_flow_fd.js) gives −1.52886×10−2-1.52886\times10^{-2} against the adjoint −1.52887×10−2-1.52887\times10^{-2}, and the largest relative difference over the two checked vertices is 9.2×10−69.2\times10^{-6}. They carry the same discretization error, including the squeeze effect above: in this page’s figure every vertex value is negative. The sensitivities in the figure therefore show how one adjoint solve yields the derivative for every vertex; they are not a converged continuum shape gradient, and shape optimization should use them through a smooth mesh motion (the mesh map X=M(b)X=\mathcal M(b) of Section 11).

温度跟踪目标的每一项导数

Every term in the temperature-tracking derivative

把每个求积点温度误差记为 dq=Tq−Ttarget,qd_q=T_q-T_{{\rm target},q}。平方项中的 1/21/2 与求导产生的 2 抵消，但几何方向还会改变权重和目标函数的采样位置：

Let dq=Tq−Ttarget,qd_q=T_q-T_{{\rm target},q}. Differentiating cancels the half with the derivative of a square. Geometry directions also change weights and the sampled target:

δJh=∑q[12dq2δwq+wqdq(δTq−δTtarget,q)],δTtarget,q=−0.02sin⁡(xq)δxq.\delta J_h=\sum_q\left[\frac12d_q^2\delta w_q+w_qd_q(\delta T_q-\delta T_{{\rm target},q})\right],\quad\delta T_{{\rm target},q}=-0.02\sin(x_q)\delta x_q.

固定状态仍可能有非零目标导数，例如移动面改变力的法向与面长，改变黏度会改变剪应力。力目标中的一个求积点可展开为：

An objective can change at fixed state: moving a face changes its normal and length, and viscosity changes shear. One force-quadrature contribution expands as:

δ[w(pn−τn)]=δw(pn−τn)+w[δp n+pδn−δτ n−τδn].\delta[w(pn-\tau n)]=\delta w(pn-\tau n)+w[\delta p\,n+p\delta n-\delta\tau\,n-\tau\delta n].

这就是后面把总梯度拆成“目标显式项”和“流场响应项”的原因。列梯度的定义是 δJ=jU⊤δU\delta J=j_U^{\top}\delta U；jUj_U 是列，∂J/∂U\partial J/\partial U 按通常 Jacobian 约定是行。两种写法不能在同一个等式里漏掉转置。

This explains the later direct-objective and state-response contributions. A column gradient satisfies δJ=jU⊤δU\delta J=j_U^{\top}\delta U; jUj_U is a column, whereas the usual Jacobian ∂J/∂U\partial J/\partial U is a row. Keep the transpose explicit.

逐步推导：壁面力与壁面热流的偏导数

Step by step: partial derivatives of the wall force and wall heat

第一步，写出一个固壁求积点的贡献（core.js 面循环末尾的目标累加）。等温壁上罚项把温度梯度的法向分量写成显式形式：

Step 1, write the contribution of one wall quadrature point (the objective accumulation at the end of the face loop in core.js). At an isothermal wall the penalty makes the normal temperature gradient explicit:

JQ=∑qwq qn,b,qn,b=−κ GbT⋅n=−κ(∇TL⋅n+2 (Tw−TL)hb),J_Q=\sum_qw_q\,q_{n,b},\qquad q_{n,b}=-\kappa\,G_b^T\cdot n=-\kappa\Big(\nabla T_L\cdot n+\frac{2\,(T_w-T_L)}{h_b}\Big),
JF,x=∑qwq(pbnx−(τbn)x).J_{F,x}=\sum_qw_q\big(p_bn_x-(\tau_bn)_x\big).

这里用了 n⋅n=1n\cdot n=1。绝热壁上 qn,b≡0q_{n,b}\equiv0，热流目标恒为零。

This uses n⋅n=1n\cdot n=1. On an adiabatic wall qn,b≡0q_{n,b}\equiv0 and the heat objective vanishes identically.

第二步，对状态求偏导。等温壁上 κ=κ(Tw)\kappa=\kappa(T_w) 不依赖状态，热流只通过内侧迹及其斜率依赖状态：

Step 2, take state partials. At an isothermal wall κ=κ(Tw)\kappa=\kappa(T_w) is independent of the state, and the heat flux depends on it only through the interior trace and its slopes:

∂JQ∂∇TL=−wqκ n,∂JQ∂TL=2wqκhb.\frac{\partial J_Q}{\partial\nabla T_L}=-w_q\kappa\,n,\qquad\frac{\partial J_Q}{\partial T_L}=\frac{2w_q\kappa}{h_b}.

TL=T(PL)T_L=T(P_L)，∇TL\nabla T_L 的分量是 TU(PL) ∂kPLT_U(P_L)\,\partial_kP_L，所以用第 2 节的行与二阶行得到迹值与迹斜率上的权重：

Since TL=T(PL)T_L=T(P_L) and the components of ∇TL\nabla T_L are TU(PL) ∂kPLT_U(P_L)\,\partial_kP_L, the rows and second rows of Section 2 give the weights on the trace value and slopes:

P‾L=2wqκhb TU⊤−wqκ∑knk(∂(TU∂kPL)∂U)⊤,∂kPL‾=−wqκ nk TU⊤.\overline P_L=\frac{2w_q\kappa}{h_b}\,T_U^{\top}-w_q\kappa\sum_kn_k\Big(\frac{\partial(T_U\partial_kP_L)}{\partial U}\Big)^{\top},\qquad\overline{\partial_kP_L}=-w_q\kappa\,n_k\,T_U^{\top}.

再经第 8 节第七步的拟合转置，把它们送到邻域 NL\mathcal N_L 的全部状态；对所有固壁求积点求和就是 jUj_U。力目标同理：pˉb=wqnx\bar p_b=w_qn_x 给出 ρˉL=wqTwnx\bar\rho_L=w_qT_wn_x；τbn‾=−wq(1,0)\overline{\tau_bn}=-w_q(1,0) 经应力反传给出速度梯度的权重，再经罚项 Gbu=∇uL−2uLn/hbG_b^u=\nabla u_L-2u_Ln/h_b 同时作用于 ∇uL\nabla u_L 与 uLu_L。

The fit transpose of Section 8, Step 7, then sends them to every state of the stencil NL\mathcal N_L; summing over all wall quadrature points gives jUj_U. The force works the same way: pˉb=wqnx\bar p_b=w_qn_x gives ρˉL=wqTwnx\bar\rho_L=w_qT_wn_x; τbn‾=−wq(1,0)\overline{\tau_bn}=-w_q(1,0) gives velocity-gradient weights through the stress reverse, which act on both ∇uL\nabla u_L and uLu_L through the penalty Gbu=∇uL−2uLn/hbG_b^u=\nabla u_L-2u_Ln/h_b.

第三步，对设计参数求显式偏导（状态固定）。μ∝μref\mu\propto\mu_{\rm ref}、κ∝μ/Pr\kappa\propto\mu/Pr，壁温同时出现在罚项、物性和壁面压力中：

Step 3, take explicit parameter partials at fixed state. μ∝μref\mu\propto\mu_{\rm ref} and κ∝μ/Pr\kappa\propto\mu/Pr; the wall temperature appears in the penalty, in transport and in the wall pressure:

∂JQ∂μref=JQμref,∂JQ∂Pr=−JQPr,∂JQ∂Tw=∑qwq(−2κhb+qn,bμTμ),\frac{\partial J_Q}{\partial\mu_{\rm ref}}=\frac{J_Q}{\mu_{\rm ref}},\quad\frac{\partial J_Q}{\partial Pr}=-\frac{J_Q}{Pr},\quad\frac{\partial J_Q}{\partial T_w}=\sum_qw_q\Big(-\frac{2\kappa}{h_b}+q_{n,b}\frac{\mu_T}{\mu}\Big),
∂JF,x∂μref=−∑qwq(τbn)xμref,∂JF,x∂Tw=∑qwq(ρbnx−(τbn)xμTμ).\frac{\partial J_{F,x}}{\partial\mu_{\rm ref}}=-\sum_qw_q\frac{(\tau_bn)_x}{\mu_{\rm ref}},\qquad\frac{\partial J_{F,x}}{\partial T_w}=\sum_qw_q\Big(\rho_bn_x-(\tau_bn)_x\frac{\mu_T}{\mu}\Big).

第四步，对坐标求显式偏导。权重、法向和边界长度 hb=(xq−xL)⋅nh_b=(x_q-x_L)\cdot n（格心）都随坐标变化；由乘积法则

Step 4, take explicit coordinate partials. The weight, the normal and the boundary length hb=(xq−xL)⋅nh_b=(x_q-x_L)\cdot n (cells) all move with the coordinates; by the product rule

δ(wqqn,b)=δwq qn,b−wqκ(δ∇TL⋅n+∇TL⋅δn−2 δTLhb−2 (Tw−TL)hb2 δhb),δhb=(δxq−δxL)⋅n+(xq−xL)⋅δn.\delta(w_qq_{n,b})=\delta w_q\,q_{n,b}-w_q\kappa\Big(\delta\nabla T_L\cdot n+\nabla T_L\cdot\delta n-\frac{2\,\delta T_L}{h_b}-\frac{2\,(T_w-T_L)}{h_b^2}\,\delta h_b\Big),\qquad\delta h_b=(\delta x_q-\delta x_L)\cdot n+(x_q-x_L)\cdot\delta n.

δwq=12δs\delta w_q=\tfrac12\delta s 与 δn\delta n 来自第 11 节；δTL,δ∇TL\delta T_L,\delta\nabla T_L 在坐标方向上还包含拟合矩阵的变化 Hiδci=δri−δHiciH_i\delta c_i=\delta r_i-\delta H_ic_i。格点版本的 hb=VLh_b=\sqrt{V_L}，δhb=δVL/(2hb)\delta h_b=\delta V_L/(2h_b)。图 6.2 画出三个目标的 jUj_U 在网格上的分布：温度跟踪遍布全域；壁面目标只读取固壁邻域，在这张小网格上它已经覆盖全部控制体，但数值集中在第一层。

δwq=12δs\delta w_q=\tfrac12\delta s and δn\delta n come from Section 11; along coordinate directions δTL,δ∇TL\delta T_L,\delta\nabla T_L also contain the fit change Hiδci=δri−δHiciH_i\delta c_i=\delta r_i-\delta H_ic_i. On the node page hb=VLh_b=\sqrt{V_L} and δhb=δVL/(2hb)\delta h_b=\delta V_L/(2h_b). Figure 6.2 maps jUj_U for three objectives: temperature tracking covers the whole domain; the wall objectives read only the wall stencils, which on this small mesh already cover every control volume, but their values concentrate in the first layer.

Differentiate fitted coefficients and geometry together

Hici=ri,Hic˙i=r˙i−H˙ici,P˙i=U˙i+b˙i ci+bic˙i.H_ic_i=r_i,\qquad H_i\dot c_i=\dot r_i-\dot H_ic_i,\qquad \dot P_i=\dot U_i+\dot b_i\,c_i+b_i\dot c_i.

方向导数就是多元函数的一阶变化

Directional derivatives are first-order changes

f(z+εd)=f(z)+εDf(z)[d]+O(ε2),Df(z)[d]=∑j∂f∂zjdj.f(z+\varepsilon d)=f(z)+\varepsilon Df(z)[d]+O(\varepsilon^2),\quad Df(z)[d]=\sum_j\frac{\partial f}{\partial z_j}d_j.

例如 z=abz=ab，展开 (a+εδa)(b+εδb)(a+\varepsilon\delta a)(b+\varepsilon\delta b) 后，保留一次项就得到 δz=bδa+aδb\delta z=b\delta a+a\delta b。本页的 AD（自动微分）只是在实际代码的每一步应用这条链式法则，不用差分步长近似偏导。

Expanding (a+εδa)(b+εδb)(a+\varepsilon\delta a)(b+\varepsilon\delta b) gives δ(ab)=bδa+aδb\delta(ab)=b\delta a+a\delta b at first order. Automatic differentiation applies such chain rules to actual code operations, without difference-step approximations.

例如速度梯度本身也要再求导。把 Gku=(∂kPmx−u∂kPρ)/ρG_k^u=(\partial_kP^{m_x}-u \partial_kP^\rho)/\rho 当作一个普通多元代数函数：

The reconstructed velocity gradient must itself be differentiated. Treat Gku=(∂kPmx−u∂kPρ)/ρG_k^u=(\partial_kP^{m_x}-u \partial_kP^\rho)/\rho as an algebraic function:

δGku=δ∂kPmx−(δu)∂kPρ−uδ∂kPρρ−Gkuρδρ.\delta G_k^u=\frac{\delta\partial_kP^{m_x}-(\delta u)\partial_kP^\rho-u\delta\partial_kP^\rho}{\rho}-\frac{G_k^u}{\rho}\delta\rho.

因此只对梯度系数求导、却冻结从守恒量到速度的转换，也是不完整的。拟合系数对几何的变化来自对 Hici=riH_ic_i=r_i 直接求导：

Differentiating fit coefficients while freezing conservative-to-velocity conversion is incomplete. Fit-geometry variations follow by differentiating Hici=riH_ic_i=r_i:

(δHi)ci+Hiδci=δri⟹Hiδci=δri−(δHi)ci.(\delta H_i)c_i+H_i\delta c_i=\delta r_i\quad\Longrightarrow\quad H_i\delta c_i=\delta r_i-(\delta H_i)c_i.
δHi=(δBi)⊤WiBi+Bi⊤(δWi)Bi+Bi⊤WiδBi,\delta H_i=(\delta B_i)^{\top}W_iB_i+B_i^{\top}(\delta W_i)B_i+B_i^{\top}W_i\delta B_i,
δri=(δBi)⊤Widi+Bi⊤(δWi)di+Bi⊤Wiδdi.\delta r_i=(\delta B_i)^{\top}W_id_i+B_i^{\top}(\delta W_i)d_i+B_i^{\top}W_i\delta d_i.

继续展开对流和黏性通量

Continue through convective and viscous fluxes

δun=nxδu+nyδv+uδnx+vδny,\delta u_n=n_x\delta u+n_y\delta v+u\delta n_x+v\delta n_y,
δFnc=[unδρ+ρδununδmx+mxδun+nxδp+pδnxunδmy+myδun+nyδp+pδnyun(δe+δp)+(e+p)δun].\delta F_n^c=\begin{bmatrix}u_n\delta\rho+\rho\delta u_n\\u_n\delta m_x+m_x\delta u_n+n_x\delta p+p\delta n_x\\u_n\delta m_y+m_y\delta u_n+n_y\delta p+p\delta n_y\\u_n(\delta e+\delta p)+(e+p)\delta u_n\end{bmatrix}.
δF^nc=12(δFnc,−+δFnc,+)−32(δU+−δU−).\delta\widehat F_n^c=\frac12(\delta F_n^{c,-}+\delta F_n^{c,+})-\frac32(\delta U^+-\delta U^-).

固定耗散速度是 3，所以这里没有“耗散速度的导数”。Sutherland 黏度可先取对数微分，得到显式温度偏导；常黏度模式则只有这个温度偏导为零：

The dissipation speed is fixed at three, so it has no derivative. Logarithmic differentiation gives the Sutherland temperature derivative; only that derivative vanishes in constant-viscosity mode:

μT=μ(32T−1T+0.4),δμ=μTδT+μμrefδμref.\mu_T=\mu\left(\frac{3}{2T}-\frac1{T+0.4}\right),\quad \delta\mu=\mu_T\delta T+\frac\mu{\mu_{\rm ref}}\delta\mu_{\rm ref}.
δτxx=δμ(43Gxu−23Gyv)+μ(43δGxu−23δGyv),\delta\tau_{xx}=\delta\mu\left(\frac43G_x^u-\frac23G_y^v\right)+\mu\left(\frac43\delta G_x^u-\frac23\delta G_y^v\right),
δτxy=δμ(Gyu+Gxv)+μ(δGyu+δGxv).\delta\tau_{xy}=\delta\mu(G_y^u+G_x^v)+\mu(\delta G_y^u+\delta G_x^v).
δFn,Ev=(δu,δv)⋅τn+(u,v)⋅[(δτ)n+τδn]−δqn.\delta F_{n,E}^v=(\delta u,\delta v)\cdot\tau n+(u,v)\cdot[(\delta\tau)n+\tau\delta n]-\delta q_n.

这条链在求积后给出 δHf\delta H_f，再按“左加右减”得到 δR\delta R。若只想计算 AhU˙hA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h，就将参数和坐标种子置零；若构造设计右端，就将状态种子置零。

Quadrature produces δHf\delta H_f, then conservative scatter produces δR\delta R. Set parameter and coordinate seeds to zero for AhU˙hA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h; set state seeds to zero to form a design right-hand side.

图 7.2 把残差画成依次执行的几遍：每一遍读一组存储数组、写一组新数组。前向沿图从左到右传播方向，反向从右到左传播权重。

Figure 7.2 draws the residual as a sequence of passes, each reading stored arrays and writing new ones. The tangent carries directions left to right; the reverse carries weights right to left.

逐步推导：一个内部 Gauss 点的切线，逐遍传播

Step by step: the tangent of one interior Gauss point, pass by pass

第一步，迹遍（core.js 的 rec()）。状态方向 U˙\dot{\mathbf U} 先进入拟合：c˙i=Hi−1Bi⊤Wid˙i\dot c_i=H_i^{-1}B_i^{\top}W_i\dot d_i，d˙ij=U˙j−U˙i\dot d_{ij}=\dot U_j-\dot U_i。在面点 xx 处，用第 2 节的基函数行 bi(x)b_i(x) 及其斜率：

Step 1, the trace pass (rec() in core.js). The state direction U˙\dot{\mathbf U} first enters the fit: c˙i=Hi−1Bi⊤Wid˙i\dot c_i=H_i^{-1}B_i^{\top}W_i\dot d_i with d˙ij=U˙j−U˙i\dot d_{ij}=\dot U_j-\dot U_i. At the face point xx use the basis row bi(x)b_i(x) of Section 2 and its slopes:

P˙i(x)=U˙i+bi(x)⊤c˙i,∂kP˙i(x)=∂kbi(x)⊤c˙i,U˙∓=U˙L/R+bL/R(1)(x)⊤c˙L/R.\dot P_i(x)=\dot U_i+b_i(x)^{\top}\dot c_i,\qquad\partial_k\dot P_i(x)=\partial_kb_i(x)^{\top}\dot c_i,\qquad\dot U^\mp=\dot U_{L/R}+b^{(1)}_{L/R}(x)^{\top}\dot c_{L/R}.

最后一式是二阶对流的迹，b(1)b^{(1)} 只保留 bb 的两个线性分量；一阶对流时 U˙∓=U˙L/R\dot U^\mp=\dot U_{L/R}。几何固定时 Hi,Bi,WiH_i,B_i,W_i 不变，这一遍对状态是线性的。

The last formula is the second-order convective trace, where b(1)b^{(1)} keeps only the two linear entries of bb; with first-order convection U˙∓=U˙L/R\dot U^\mp=\dot U_{L/R}. At fixed geometry Hi,Bi,WiH_i,B_i,W_i do not change, so this pass is linear in the state.

第二步，原始量遍：用第 2 节的行和二阶行，

Step 2, the primitive pass, with the rows and second rows of Section 2:

θ˙L=θU(PL) P˙L,G˙L,kθ=θU(PL) ∂kP˙L+∂(θU∂kPL)∂U P˙L.\dot\theta_{L}=\theta_U(P_L)\,\dot P_L,\qquad\dot G_{L,k}^\theta=\theta_U(P_L)\,\partial_k\dot P_L+\frac{\partial(\theta_U\partial_kP_L)}{\partial U}\,\dot P_L.

右侧 RR 同样处理。

The right side RR is treated in the same way.

第三步，面梯度遍。面梯度是两侧梯度的平均加上沿 xLR=xR−xLx_{LR}=x_R-x_L 的跳跃项；几何固定时 xLRx_{LR} 不变：

Step 3, the face-gradient pass. The face gradient is the average of both sides plus a jump term along xLR=xR−xLx_{LR}=x_R-x_L; at fixed geometry xLRx_{LR} does not change:

G˙fθ=12(G˙Lθ+G˙Rθ)+2 (θ˙R−θ˙L)xLR⋅xLR xLR,U˙v=12(P˙L+P˙R),(u˙,v˙,T˙)v=(uU,vU,TU)(Uv) U˙v.\dot G_f^\theta=\tfrac12\big(\dot G_L^\theta+\dot G_R^\theta\big)+\frac{2\,(\dot\theta_R-\dot\theta_L)}{x_{LR}\cdot x_{LR}}\,x_{LR},\qquad\dot U^v=\tfrac12\big(\dot P_L+\dot P_R\big),\qquad(\dot u,\dot v,\dot T)^v=(u_U,v_U,T_U)(U^v)\,\dot U^v.

坐标方向还要加上 δxLR\delta x_{LR} 的贡献：

Coordinate directions add the δxLR\delta x_{LR} term

2(θR−θL)xLR⋅xLR(δxLR−2 xLR⋅δxLRxLR⋅xLR xLR).\frac{2(\theta_R-\theta_L)}{x_{LR}\cdot x_{LR}}\Big(\delta x_{LR}-\frac{2\,x_{LR}\cdot\delta x_{LR}}{x_{LR}\cdot x_{LR}}\,x_{LR}\Big).

跳跃项沿 xLRx_{LR} 而不是沿 nn；图 7.3 画出实际网格上两者的夹角。

The jump acts along xLRx_{LR}, not along nn; Figure 7.3 shows the angle between them on the actual mesh.

第四步，物性与本构遍：

Step 4, the transport and constitutive pass:

μ˙=μTT˙v,κ˙=cpPrμ˙,τ˙=μ˙μτ+μ S(G˙f),(τ˙n)=τ˙ n,q˙n=−κ˙ GfT⋅n−κ G˙fT⋅n.\dot\mu=\mu_T\dot T^v,\quad\dot\kappa=\frac{c_p}{Pr}\dot\mu,\quad\dot\tau=\frac{\dot\mu}{\mu}\tau+\mu\,\mathcal S(\dot G_f),\quad(\dot\tau n)=\dot\tau\,n,\quad\dot q_n=-\dot\kappa\,G_f^T\cdot n-\kappa\,\dot G_f^T\cdot n.

第五步，通量遍。黏性部分用第 2 节的 Jacobian；对流部分是 Rusanov（局部 Lax–Friedrichs）通量，耗散速度固定为 3，没有导数：

Step 5, the flux pass. The viscous part uses the Jacobian of Section 2; the convective part is the Rusanov (local Lax–Friedrichs) flux with the dissipation speed fixed at 3, which has no derivative:

F˙v=[0(τ˙n)x(τ˙n)yu˙(τn)x+u(τ˙n)x+v˙(τn)y+v(τ˙n)y−q˙n],F^˙c=12(FUc(U−)U˙−+FUc(U+)U˙+)−32(U˙+−U˙−).\dot F^v=\begin{bmatrix}0\\(\dot\tau n)_x\\(\dot\tau n)_y\\\dot u(\tau n)_x+u(\dot\tau n)_x+\dot v(\tau n)_y+v(\dot\tau n)_y-\dot q_n\end{bmatrix},\qquad\dot{\widehat F}{}^c=\tfrac12\big(F_U^c(U^-)\dot U^-+F_U^c(U^+)\dot U^+\big)-\tfrac32\big(\dot U^+-\dot U^-\big).

第六步，求积与分发遍：

Step 6, the quadrature and scatter pass:

H˙f=∑qwq(F^˙c−F˙v)q,R˙L+=H˙f,R˙R−=H˙f,R˙=IbcR˙raw+EbccUU˙.\dot H_f=\sum_qw_q\big(\dot{\widehat F}{}^c-\dot F^v\big)_q,\qquad\dot R_L\mathrel{+}=\dot H_f,\quad\dot R_R\mathrel{-}=\dot H_f,\qquad\dot R=I_{\rm bc}\dot R_{\rm raw}+E_{\rm bc}c_U\dot U.

边界面按第 3 节替换第一、三步中的右侧迹和罚项，其余各遍不变。

Boundary faces replace the right trace and the penalty of Steps 1 and 3 as in Section 3; every other pass is unchanged.

核对：用这六遍（及第 3 节边界）手工组装的 AhU˙A_h\dot{\mathbf U}，在 6 种配置（制造解与物理绕流、一阶与二阶、两种物性、等温与绝热）上与本页运算图的 JVP 相比，最大相对差为 1.1×10−151.1\times10^{-15}；同样公式重算的点通量值与面循环记录的值相差 3.2×10−153.2\times10^{-15}（本页代码在构建时计算）

Check: AhU˙A_h\dot{\mathbf U} assembled by hand from these six passes (with the boundaries of Section 3) agrees with the page's graph JVP over 6 configurations (manufactured and physical flow, first and second order, both transport laws, isothermal and adiabatic) to a maximum relative difference of 1.1×10−151.1\times10^{-15}; the point fluxes recomputed by the same formulas differ from the values recorded by the face loop by 3.2×10−153.2\times10^{-15} (computed by this page's code at build time)

第 8 节Section 8

matrix-free 反向

Matrix-free reverse

用同一个单点权重，逐步观察它怎样返回整个重构邻域。格点版先看强边界行反传。

Use one nonzero row weight and watch contributions return to the whole stencil. For nodes, inspect strong-row reversal first.

转置来自有限求和交换

Transposition exchanges finite sums

w⊤AhU˙=∑r∑jwr∂Rr∂UjU˙j=U˙⊤Ah⊤w.w^{\top}A_h\dot{\mathbf U}=\sum_r\sum_jw_r\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial U_j}\dot U_j=\dot{\mathbf U}^{\top}A_h^{\top}w.
w~=Ibc⊤w,ηf=w~L−w~R,c‾bc=Ebc⊤w.\widetilde w=I_{\rm bc}^{\top}w,\quad\eta_f=\widetilde w_L-\widetilde w_R,\quad\overline c_{\rm bc}=E_{\rm bc}^{\top}w.

先反传强约束，屏蔽被覆盖的旧平衡行。边界缺少右控制体时取右种子为零。内部共享面只得到一个净种子，不分别计算两个不一致的导数。所有共享输入都用 += 累加。

Reverse strong constraints first and mask overwritten balances. Missing exterior volumes have zero right seed. A shared interior face receives one net seed rather than two independently differentiated fluxes. Accumulate every shared-input contribution with +=.

黏性功的反向种子

Reverse seeds from viscous work

τn‾=−(ηmx,ηmy)−ηe(u,v),(u,v)‾=−ηeτn,q‾n=ηe.\overline{\tau n}=-(\eta_{m_x},\eta_{m_y})-\eta_e(u,v),\quad\overline{(u,v)}=-\eta_e\tau n,\quad\overline q_n=\eta_e.

以上种子用于内部通量“减去黏性”的路径，尚未包含目标种子、法向和求积权重。继续把牵引反传到应力、物性、梯度，再通过两侧二次迹和邻域拟合回传。出口已消去应力的总牵引闭合必须用自己的反向公式。

These seeds belong to the interior subtract-viscosity path, before objective seeds, normals and quadrature weights. Reverse traction through stress, transport and gradients, then through both quadratic traces and stencil fits. The outflow closure with eliminated stress has its own reverse rule.

Hi⊤zi=c‾i,r‾i+=zi,H‾i−=zici⊤.H_i^{\top}z_i=\overline c_i,\quad\overline r_i\mathrel{+}=z_i,\quad\overline H_i\mathrel{-}=z_ic_i^{\top}.

这里每个守恒分量各有一列拟合系数，对几何矩阵的贡献要对四个分量求和。一个面的反传可以写入多个邻居，不局限于 L、R；播放器在一次“累加”事件中把该面的全部状态贡献散射出去。

Each conserved component has its own fit coefficients; sum all four contributions to the geometry matrix. A face can write to many neighbours, not just L and R. Each player accumulation event scatters all state contributions of that face.

reverse boundary constraints; mask raw balance seeds
for face in reverse order:
    eta = masked_w[L] - masked_w[R]
    reverse quadrature, flux, stress, transport, traces and fits
    for every dependency j: bar_U[j] += contribution[j]
# shared geometry receives every face and source contribution

反向权重不是另一种流动物理量

Reverse weights are algebraic sensitivities

给输出 zz 一个权重 zˉ\bar z，考察标量 zˉ δz\bar z\,\delta z。对于 z=abz=ab，把上一节的一阶变化代入并重新分组：

Give output z a weight zˉ\bar z and consider zˉ δz\bar z\,\delta z. For z=abz=ab, substitute the first-order variation and regroup:

zˉ δz=(bzˉ)δa+(azˉ)δb⟹aˉ+=bzˉ,bˉ+=azˉ.\bar z\,\delta z=(b\bar z)\delta a+(a\bar z)\delta b\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\bar a\mathrel{+}=b\bar z,\quad\bar b\mathrel{+}=a\bar z.

上横线在这里表示反向权重，不表示平均值。如果同一输入参与多个运算，各条路径的系数必须相加。矩阵转置就是把“按输出行求和”重新排成“按输入列求和”。共享面的种子差因此可以从一个等式直接读出：

Overbars here mean reverse weights, not averages. Shared inputs receive sums from all paths. Matrix transposition reorganizes output-row sums into input-column sums. For one shared face:

wL⊤δHf+wR⊤(−δHf)=(wL−wR)⊤δHf.w_L^{\top}\delta H_f+w_R^{\top}(-\delta H_f)=(w_L-w_R)^{\top}\delta H_f.

把应力的反向传播写到每个分量

Reverse stress down to individual components

设传给三个独立应力分量的权重为 bxx,bxy,byyb_{xx},b_{xy},b_{yy}。展开 bxxδτxx+bxyδτxy+byyδτyyb_{xx}\delta\tau_{xx}+b_{xy}\delta\tau_{xy}+b_{yy}\delta\tau_{yy} 并收集同一梯度的系数：

Let weights of the three independent stresses be bxx,bxy,byyb_{xx},b_{xy},b_{yy}. Expand bxxδτxx+bxyδτxy+byyδτyyb_{xx}\delta\tau_{xx}+b_{xy}\delta\tau_{xy}+b_{yy}\delta\tau_{yy} and collect gradient coefficients:

G‾xu+=μ(43bxx−23byy),G‾yv+=μ(43byy−23bxx),\overline G_x^u\mathrel{+}=\mu(\tfrac43b_{xx}-\tfrac23b_{yy}),\quad\overline G_y^v\mathrel{+}=\mu(\tfrac43b_{yy}-\tfrac23b_{xx}),
G‾yu+=μbxy,G‾xv+=μbxy,\overline G_y^u\mathrel{+}=\mu b_{xy},\quad\overline G_x^v\mathrel{+}=\mu b_{xy},
μˉ+=bxx(43Gxu−23Gyv)+byy(43Gyv−23Gxu)+bxy(Gyu+Gxv).\bar\mu\mathrel{+}=b_{xx}(\tfrac43G_x^u-\tfrac23G_y^v)+b_{yy}(\tfrac43G_y^v-\tfrac23G_x^u)+b_{xy}(G_y^u+G_x^v).
G‾T+=−κqˉnn,κˉ+=−qˉnGT⋅n,nˉ+=−κqˉnGT.\overline G^T\mathrel{+}=-\kappa\bar q_n n,\quad\bar\kappa\mathrel{+}=-\bar q_nG^T\cdot n,\quad\bar n\mathrel{+}=-\kappa\bar q_nG^T.

例如正向变量转换 u=mx/ρu=m_x/\rho 的反向是 mˉx+=uˉ/ρ\bar m_x\mathrel{+}=\bar u/\rho、ρˉ−=uuˉ/ρ\bar\rho\mathrel{-}=u\bar u/\rho。温度、重构梯度、两侧平均与跳跃修正继续使用同一收集系数的方法。代码里的反向计算图保留所有这些路径。

For example, reversing u=mx/ρu=m_x/\rho gives mˉx+=uˉ/ρ\bar m_x\mathrel{+}=\bar u/\rho and ρˉ−=uuˉ/ρ\bar\rho\mathrel{-}=u\bar u/\rho. Continue collecting coefficients through temperature, gradients, trace averages and jump correction. The reverse graph retains all these paths.

为什么反传拟合也要解一个转置系统

Why reversing the fit needs a transposed system

cˉi⊤δci=cˉi⊤Hi−1[δri−(δHi)ci].\bar c_i^{\top}\delta c_i=\bar c_i^{\top}H_i^{-1}[\delta r_i-(\delta H_i)c_i].
Hi⊤zi=cˉi⟹cˉi⊤δci=zi⊤δri−∑k,ℓ(zi)k(ci)ℓδ(Hi)kℓ.H_i^{\top}z_i=\bar c_i\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \bar c_i^{\top}\delta c_i=z_i^{\top}\delta r_i-\sum_{k,\ell}(z_i)_k(c_i)_\ell\delta(H_i)_{k\ell}.

由系数直接读出 rˉi=zi\bar r_i=z_i 与 Hˉi=−zici⊤\bar H_i=-z_ic_i^{\top}，再继续反传 Bi,Wi,diB_i,W_i,d_i。这不是另一个连续伴随方程，而是五个拟合系数的有限维链式法则。

Read off rˉi=zi\bar r_i=z_i and Hˉi=−zici⊤\bar H_i=-z_ic_i^{\top}, then reverse Bi,Wi,diB_i,W_i,d_i. This is a finite-dimensional chain rule for five fit coefficients, not a continuous adjoint PDE.

逐步推导：把同一个 Gauss 点倒过来

Step by step: reversing the same Gauss point

第 7 节的六遍按相反顺序执行，每一遍换成其转置。输入是面种子 ηf\eta_f，输出累加到 U‾\overline{\mathbf U}；所有累加都用 +=\mathrel{+}=。

Run the six passes of Section 7 in reverse order, each replaced by its transpose. The input is the face seed ηf\eta_f; outputs accumulate into U‾\overline{\mathbf U}, always with +=\mathrel{+}=.

第一步，分发与求积的转置（边界面上 w~R=0\widetilde w_R=0）：

Step 1, transpose the scatter and the quadrature (w~R=0\widetilde w_R=0 at a boundary face):

ηf=w~L−w~R,Fˉq=wq ηf.\eta_f=\widetilde w_L-\widetilde w_R,\qquad\bar F_q=w_q\,\eta_f.

第二步，Rusanov（局部 Lax–Friedrichs）对流通量的转置。F^c\widehat F^c 的线性化（第 7 节第五步）是两侧迹方向的线性组合，转置就是把各项的转置 Jacobian 作用到种子上；固定速度 3 只贡献常数系数 ±32\pm\tfrac32：

Step 2, transpose the Rusanov (local Lax–Friedrichs) convective flux. The linearisation of F^c\widehat F^c (Section 7, Step 5) is a linear combination of the two trace directions, so its transpose applies each term's transposed Jacobian to the seed; the fixed speed 3 contributes only the constant coefficients ±32\pm\tfrac32:

U‾−+=12FUc(U−)⊤Fˉq+32Fˉq,U‾++=12FUc(U+)⊤Fˉq−32Fˉq.\overline U^-\mathrel{+}=\tfrac12F_U^c(U^-)^{\top}\bar F_q+\tfrac32\bar F_q,\qquad\overline U^+\mathrel{+}=\tfrac12F_U^c(U^+)^{\top}\bar F_q-\tfrac32\bar F_q.

第三步，黏性通量的转置。点通量是 F^c−Fv\widehat F^c-F^v，所以黏性路径的种子是 −Fˉq-\bar F_q；按第 2 节的 Jacobian 取转置：

Step 3, transpose the viscous flux. The point flux is F^c−Fv\widehat F^c-F^v, so the viscous path is seeded with −Fˉq-\bar F_q; transpose the Jacobian of Section 2:

τn‾=−(Fˉmx+uFˉE, Fˉmy+vFˉE),(uˉ,vˉ)v=−FˉE τn,qˉn=FˉE,\overline{\tau n}=-\big(\bar F_{m_x}+u\bar F_E,\ \bar F_{m_y}+v\bar F_E\big),\qquad(\bar u,\bar v)^v=-\bar F_E\,\tau n,\qquad\bar q_n=\bar F_E,
τˉxx=τn‾xnx,τˉxy=τn‾xny+τn‾ynx,τˉyy=τn‾yny,G‾fT=−κ qˉn n,κˉ=−qˉn GfT⋅n.\bar\tau_{xx}=\overline{\tau n}_x n_x,\quad\bar\tau_{xy}=\overline{\tau n}_x n_y+\overline{\tau n}_y n_x,\quad\bar\tau_{yy}=\overline{\tau n}_y n_y,\qquad\overline G_f^T=-\kappa\,\bar q_n\,n,\quad\bar\kappa=-\bar q_n\,G_f^T\cdot n.

应力分量到 G‾fu,G‾fv,μˉ\overline G_f^u,\overline G_f^v,\bar\mu 的公式与本节上文“把应力的反向传播写到每个分量”相同。

The stress components go to G‾fu,G‾fv,μˉ\overline G_f^u,\overline G_f^v,\bar\mu by the formulas of “Reverse stress down to individual components” above.

第四步，物性的转置：

Step 4, transpose the transport law:

μˉ+=cpPrκˉ,Tˉv+=μT μˉ,μˉref+=μμrefμˉ,Pr‾−=κPrκˉ.\bar\mu\mathrel{+}=\frac{c_p}{Pr}\bar\kappa,\qquad\bar T^v\mathrel{+}=\mu_T\,\bar\mu,\qquad\bar\mu_{\rm ref}\mathrel{+}=\frac{\mu}{\mu_{\rm ref}}\bar\mu,\qquad\overline{Pr}\mathrel{-}=\frac{\kappa}{Pr}\bar\kappa.

第五步，面状态与面梯度的转置。平均把权重平分给两侧；跳跃项把 xLRx_{LR} 方向上的权重以相反符号送给两侧的迹值：

Step 5, transpose the face state and the face gradient. The average splits a weight equally between the sides; the jump sends the weight along xLRx_{LR} to the two trace values with opposite signs:

U‾v=uU⊤uˉv+vU⊤vˉv+TU⊤Tˉv,P‾L+=12U‾v,P‾R+=12U‾v,\overline U^v=u_U^{\top}\bar u^v+v_U^{\top}\bar v^v+T_U^{\top}\bar T^v,\qquad\overline P_L\mathrel{+}=\tfrac12\overline U^v,\quad\overline P_R\mathrel{+}=\tfrac12\overline U^v,
G‾Lθ+=12G‾fθ,G‾Rθ+=12G‾fθ,θˉR+=2 xLR⋅G‾fθxLR⋅xLR,θˉL−=2 xLR⋅G‾fθxLR⋅xLR.\overline G_L^\theta\mathrel{+}=\tfrac12\overline G_f^\theta,\quad\overline G_R^\theta\mathrel{+}=\tfrac12\overline G_f^\theta,\qquad\bar\theta_R\mathrel{+}=\frac{2\,x_{LR}\cdot\overline G_f^\theta}{x_{LR}\cdot x_{LR}},\quad\bar\theta_L\mathrel{-}=\frac{2\,x_{LR}\cdot\overline G_f^\theta}{x_{LR}\cdot x_{LR}}.

第六步，原始量的转置（第 2 节第四步的两条路径）：

Step 6, transpose the primitive conversion (the two paths of Section 2, Step 4):

P‾L+=∑θθU⊤θˉL+∑θ,k(∂(θU∂kPL)∂U)⊤G‾L,kθ,∂kPL‾+=∑θθU⊤ G‾L,kθ.\overline P_L\mathrel{+}=\sum_\theta\theta_U^{\top}\bar\theta_L+\sum_{\theta,k}\Big(\frac{\partial(\theta_U\partial_kP_L)}{\partial U}\Big)^{\top}\overline G_{L,k}^\theta,\qquad\overline{\partial_kP_L}\mathrel{+}=\sum_\theta\theta_U^{\top}\,\overline G_{L,k}^\theta.

第七步，迹与拟合的转置。把迹值、迹斜率和对流迹的权重收集成拟合系数的权重，再解转置的 5×55\times5 系统；四个守恒分量各解一次：

Step 7, transpose the traces and the fit. Collect the weights of trace value, trace slopes and convective trace into a weight on the fit coefficients, then solve the transposed 5×55\times5 system, once per conserved component:

cˉi=bi(x) P‾i+∑k∂kbi(x) ∂kPi‾+bi(1)(x) U‾∓,Hi⊤zi=cˉi,dˉij=wij bij⊤zi,\bar c_i=b_i(x)\,\overline P_i+\sum_k\partial_kb_i(x)\,\overline{\partial_kP_i}+b_i^{(1)}(x)\,\overline U^{\mp},\qquad H_i^{\top}z_i=\bar c_i,\qquad\bar d_{ij}=w_{ij}\,b_{ij}^{\top}z_i,
U‾j+=dˉij  (j∈Ni),U‾i+=P‾i+U‾∓−∑j∈Nidˉij.\overline U_j\mathrel{+}=\bar d_{ij}\ \ (j\in\mathcal N_i),\qquad\overline U_i\mathrel{+}=\overline P_i+\overline U^{\mp}-\sum_{j\in\mathcal N_i}\bar d_{ij}.

最后一行来自 dij=Uj−Uid_{ij}=U_j-U_i 与 Pi(x)=Ui+bi(x)⊤ciP_i(x)=U_i+b_i(x)^{\top}c_i：UiU_i 一方面直接出现，一方面在每个差值里以负号出现。

The last line comes from dij=Uj−Uid_{ij}=U_j-U_i and Pi(x)=Ui+bi(x)⊤ciP_i(x)=U_i+b_i(x)^{\top}c_i: UiU_i appears once directly and once with a minus sign in every difference.

第八步，看清累加的范围。一个面的种子写回整个 Nf\mathcal N_f；反过来，状态 jj 收到所有读取它的面的贡献。图 8.1 画出状态 0 的“扇入”：48 个面中有 40 个会写入 U‾0\overline U_{0}；全部状态的扇入数在 28–40 之间。

Step 8, see how far the accumulation reaches. One face seed writes into all of Nf\mathcal N_f; conversely state jj receives contributions from every face that reads it. Figure 8.1 shows the fan-in of state 0: 40 of the 48 faces write into U‾0\overline U_{0}; over all states the fan-in is 28–40.
