第 9 节Section 9

前向方程求解

Tangent equation solve

选择一个物性参数，再选一个坐标方向。每次核对线性残差和目标方向导数。

Select a transport parameter, then a coordinate. Check the linear residual and objective directional derivative.

图 9.1：两未知量例子Figure 9.1: Two-unknown example

从隐函数得到状态响应

Obtain state response from the implicit equations

Rh(Uh(a,X),a,X)=0,AhU˙h=−Rh,ada−Rh,XdX,DJ^h[d]=jU⊤U˙h+ja⊤da+jX⊤dX.R_h(U_h(a,X),a,X)=0,\quad A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h=-R_{h,a}d_a-R_{h,X}d_X,\quad D\widehat J_h[d]=j_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h+j_a^{\top}d_a+j_X^{\top}d_X.
Rh,a=∂Rh∂a∈R4N×6,Rh,X=∂Rh∂X∈R4N×2Nv,da=a˙,dX=X˙.R_{h,a}=\frac{\partial R_h}{\partial a}\in\mathbb R^{4N\times6},\quad R_{h,X}=\frac{\partial R_h}{\partial X}\in\mathbb R^{4N\times2N_v},\quad d_a=\dot a,\quad d_X=\dot X.

先解收敛流场，再固定该基态的线性化。零状态种子与单位设计方向产生右端，解出的 U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h 再与同一设计方向一起送进目标求导。一个方向对应一次 tangent 求解；并非把任意扰动经过一次 JVP 就完成了敏感度求解。

First converge the primal, then fix its linearization. Zero state seed and a unit design direction form the right-hand side. Feed the solved U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h and the same design direction into the objective derivative. One design direction requires one tangent solve; a single arbitrary JVP is not that solve.

本页几何方向只移动所选节点，其他节点固定；攻角导数按弧度。图中显示的是守恒量响应，若需要速度或温度响应，还要经过第 7 节的变量转换。

A coordinate direction moves just the selected node; other nodes are fixed. Incidence derivatives are per radian. Plotted responses are conserved quantities; velocity or temperature responses require the variable conversion of Section 7.

把“流场也随设计变化”写进链式法则

Include the design-induced state change

令一条设计路径为 a(ε)=a+εdaa(\varepsilon)=a+\varepsilon d_a、X(ε)=X+εdXX(\varepsilon)=X+\varepsilon d_X。每个设计都对应重新收敛的状态。因为路径上的残差始终为零，对它求导仍应等于零：

Consider a(ε)=a+εdaa(\varepsilon)=a+\varepsilon d_a and X(ε)=X+εdXX(\varepsilon)=X+\varepsilon d_X, with a converged state for each design. The residual remains zero along this path, so its derivative is zero:

0=ddεRh(Uh(ε),a(ε),X(ε))∣0=AhU˙h+Rh,ada+Rh,XdX.0=\left.\frac{d}{d\varepsilon}R_h(U_h(\varepsilon),a(\varepsilon),X(\varepsilon))\right|_0=A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h+R_{h,a}d_a+R_{h,X}d_X.
bd=−(Rh,ada+Rh,XdX),AhU˙h=bd,dJ^hdε=jU⊤U˙h+ja⊤da+jX⊤dX.b_d=-(R_{h,a}d_a+R_{h,X}d_X),\quad A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h=b_d,\quad \frac{d\widehat J_h}{d\varepsilon}=j_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h+j_a^{\top}d_a+j_X^{\top}d_X.

这里假设当前离散 Jacobian 可逆，从而局部状态响应唯一。这是隐函数定理的有限维条件，不是对所有流动分支的全局唯一性保证。AhU˙hA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h 的一次乘法只是给定 U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h 后求输出；求解 AhU˙h=bdA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h=b_d 才是在找未知的 U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h。

Assume the current discrete Jacobian is invertible so the local response is unique: a finite-dimensional implicit-function condition, not global uniqueness of all flow branches. Applying AhU˙hA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h to a given U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h differs from solving for an unknown U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h.

[2−1−12][U˙1U˙2]=[10]⟹U˙2=U˙1/2,U˙1=2/3, U˙2=1/3.\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}\dot U_1\\\dot U_2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1\\0\end{bmatrix}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \dot U_2=\dot U_1/2,\quad \dot U_1=2/3,\ \dot U_2=1/3.

这个例子只是线性代数练习，不是将 N–S 简化成两条物理方程。它让我们不依赖程序即可核对后面的符号和转置。真实页面有 96 个状态未知量，但推导完全相同。

This is a linear-algebra exercise, not a two-equation physical N–S model. It lets us check signs and transposes by hand. The real page has 96 state unknowns, with the same derivation.

逐步推导：设计右端项，逐列写出 Rh,aekR_{h,a}e_k

Step by step: the design right-hand sides, one column at a time

前向方程的右端项是 −Rh,ada-R_{h,a}d_a。下面逐个参数写出列 Rh,aekR_{h,a}e_k，也就是残差对该参数的显式导数（状态固定）。参数顺序与代码相同：a=(a0,…,a5)a=(a_0,\dots,a_5)，依次为入流幅度（绕流为 Mach 数）、入流方向、μref\mu_{\rm ref}、PrPr、壁温（制造解为内边界温度偏移）和热源幅度。

The right-hand side of the tangent equation is −Rh,ada-R_{h,a}d_a. Below, each column Rh,aekR_{h,a}e_k is written out: the explicit derivative of the residual with respect to one parameter at fixed state. The order is the code's: a=(a0,…,a5)a=(a_0,\dots,a_5) are the inflow amplitude (Mach number in the flow case), the inflow direction, μref\mu_{\rm ref}, PrPr, the wall temperature (the inner-boundary temperature offset in the manufactured case) and the heating amplitude.

第一步，源项与热源幅度 a5a_5（core.js 体循环中的 src）。能量方程的源项含 a5∫Vis dAa_5\int_{V_i}s\,dA，s(x,y)=sin⁡2(0.7x+0.5y)s(x,y)=\sin^2(0.7x+0.5y)，按体求积计算；残差减去源项，所以

Step 1, the source term and the heating amplitude a5a_5 (src in the volume loop of core.js). The energy source contains a5∫Vis dAa_5\int_{V_i}s\,dA with s(x,y)=sin⁡2(0.7x+0.5y)s(x,y)=\sin^2(0.7x+0.5y), computed by volume quadrature; the residual subtracts the source, so

∂Ri,E∂a5=−∑qwiq s(xiq),∂Ri,ρ∂a5=∂Ri,mx∂a5=∂Ri,my∂a5=0.\frac{\partial R_{i,E}}{\partial a_5}=-\sum_qw_{iq}\,s(x_{iq}),\qquad\frac{\partial R_{i,\rho}}{\partial a_5}=\frac{\partial R_{i,m_x}}{\partial a_5}=\frac{\partial R_{i,m_y}}{\partial a_5}=0.

源项不含状态，所以它对状态的线性化为零；对坐标的线性化就是第 11 节的 S˙i=∑q(w˙qS(xq)+wqSx(xq)x˙q)\dot S_i=\sum_q(\dot w_qS(x_q)+w_qS_x(x_q)\dot x_q)。制造解的源 S∗S_* 在参数方向上保持固定。

The source does not contain the state, so its state linearisation is zero; its coordinate linearisation is S˙i=∑q(w˙qS(xq)+wqSx(xq)x˙q)\dot S_i=\sum_q(\dot w_qS(x_q)+w_qS_x(x_q)\dot x_q) of Section 11. The manufactured source S∗S_* stays fixed along parameter directions.

第二步，参考黏度 μref\mu_{\rm ref}。μ=μreff(T)\mu=\mu_{\rm ref}f(T)、κ=cpμ/Pr\kappa=c_p\mu/Pr，所以应力与热流都与 μref\mu_{\rm ref} 成正比，黏性通量对它是一次齐次的：

Step 2, the reference viscosity μref\mu_{\rm ref}. With μ=μreff(T)\mu=\mu_{\rm ref}f(T) and κ=cpμ/Pr\kappa=c_p\mu/Pr, stress and heat flux are both proportional to μref\mu_{\rm ref}; the viscous flux is homogeneous of degree one in it:

∂Fv∂μref=Fvμref,∂Fq∂μref=−Fqvμref  (interior, inflow),∂Fqwall∂μref=1μref[0−τbnqn,b].\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial\mu_{\rm ref}}=\frac{F^v}{\mu_{\rm ref}},\qquad\frac{\partial F_q}{\partial\mu_{\rm ref}}=-\frac{F^v_q}{\mu_{\rm ref}}\ \ (\text{interior, inflow}),\qquad\frac{\partial F_q^{\rm wall}}{\partial\mu_{\rm ref}}=\frac1{\mu_{\rm ref}}\begin{bmatrix}0\\-\tau_bn\\q_{n,b}\end{bmatrix}.

绝热壁的能量分量为零。制造解出口的数据 tb=p∗n−τ∗nt_b=p_*n-\tau_*n、qbq_b 也用当前物性计算，给出 (0,−τ∗n, −(u,v)⋅τ∗n+qb)/μref\big(0,-\tau_*n,\ -(u,v)\cdot\tau_*n+q_b\big)/\mu_{\rm ref}。

The energy entry vanishes at an adiabatic wall. The manufactured outflow data tb=p∗n−τ∗nt_b=p_*n-\tau_*n and qbq_b also use the current transport and give (0,−τ∗n, −(u,v)⋅τ∗n+qb)/μref\big(0,-\tau_*n,\ -(u,v)\cdot\tau_*n+q_b\big)/\mu_{\rm ref}.

第三步，Prandtl 数 PrPr。只有导热含 PrPr：−qn=κGT⋅n∝1/Pr-q_n=\kappa G^T\cdot n\propto1/Pr，所以 ∂(−qn)/∂Pr=qn/Pr\partial(-q_n)/\partial Pr=q_n/Pr，而 Fq=F^c−FvF_q=\widehat F^c-F^v：

Step 3, the Prandtl number PrPr. Only conduction contains PrPr: −qn=κGT⋅n∝1/Pr-q_n=\kappa G^T\cdot n\propto1/Pr, so ∂(−qn)/∂Pr=qn/Pr\partial(-q_n)/\partial Pr=q_n/Pr, and Fq=F^c−FvF_q=\widehat F^c-F^v:

∂Fq∂Pr=[000−qn/Pr],∂Fqwall∂Pr=[000−qn,b/Pr] (isothermal),∂Fqout∂Pr=[000−qb/Pr].\frac{\partial F_q}{\partial Pr}=\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\0\\-q_n/Pr\end{bmatrix},\qquad\frac{\partial F_q^{\rm wall}}{\partial Pr}=\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\0\\-q_{n,b}/Pr\end{bmatrix}\ (\text{isothermal}),\qquad\frac{\partial F_q^{\rm out}}{\partial Pr}=\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\0\\-q_b/Pr\end{bmatrix}.

第四步，壁温 TwT_w（物理固壁，等温）。TwT_w 出现在壁面压力 pb=ρbTwp_b=\rho_bT_w、物性 μ(Tw)\mu(T_w) 和温度罚项中：

Step 4, the wall temperature TwT_w (physical wall, isothermal). TwT_w appears in the wall pressure pb=ρbTwp_b=\rho_bT_w, in the transport μ(Tw)\mu(T_w) and in the temperature penalty:

∂Fqwall∂Tw=[0ρbn−μTμ τbnμTμ qn,b−2κhb].\frac{\partial F_q^{\rm wall}}{\partial T_w}=\begin{bmatrix}0\\\rho_bn-\dfrac{\mu_T}{\mu}\,\tau_bn\\\dfrac{\mu_T}{\mu}\,q_{n,b}-\dfrac{2\kappa}{h_b}\end{bmatrix}.

绝热壁上 Tb=T(PL)T_b=T(P_L)，不含 TwT_w，这一列为零。

At an adiabatic wall Tb=T(PL)T_b=T(P_L) does not contain TwT_w, and the column is zero.

第五步，入流参数 a0,a1a_0,a_1（及制造解的 a4a_4）。它们只通过规定的入流状态 Ub(a)U_b(a) 起作用：绕流中 ub=a0γcos⁡a1u_b=a_0\sqrt\gamma\cos a_1、vb=a0γsin⁡a1v_b=a_0\sqrt\gamma\sin a_1；制造解中 ub=u∗+1.4 (a0−a0(0))u_b=u_*+\sqrt{1.4}\,(a_0-a_0^{(0)})、vb=v∗+0.2 (a1−a1(0))v_b=v_*+0.2\,(a_1-a_1^{(0)})，内边界上 Tb=T∗+(a4−a4(0))T_b=T_*+(a_4-a_4^{(0)})，ak(0)a_k^{(0)} 是基准值。由 δθb\delta\theta_b 得到

Step 5, the inflow parameters a0,a1a_0,a_1 (and a4a_4 in the manufactured case). They act only through the prescribed inflow state Ub(a)U_b(a): in the flow case ub=a0γcos⁡a1u_b=a_0\sqrt\gamma\cos a_1 and vb=a0γsin⁡a1v_b=a_0\sqrt\gamma\sin a_1; in the manufactured case ub=u∗+1.4 (a0−a0(0))u_b=u_*+\sqrt{1.4}\,(a_0-a_0^{(0)}), vb=v∗+0.2 (a1−a1(0))v_b=v_*+0.2\,(a_1-a_1^{(0)}) and, on the inner boundary, Tb=T∗+(a4−a4(0))T_b=T_*+(a_4-a_4^{(0)}), where ak(0)a_k^{(0)} is the baseline. From δθb\delta\theta_b,

δUb=[0ρb δubρb δvbρb(cv δTb+ub δub+vb δvb)],δGbθ=2 δθbhb n,δμ=μT δTb,\delta U_b=\begin{bmatrix}0\\\rho_b\,\delta u_b\\\rho_b\,\delta v_b\\\rho_b(c_v\,\delta T_b+u_b\,\delta u_b+v_b\,\delta v_b)\end{bmatrix},\qquad\delta G_b^\theta=\frac{2\,\delta\theta_b}{h_b}\,n,\qquad\delta\mu=\mu_T\,\delta T_b,
δFqin=FUc(Ub) δUb−[∂Fv∂(u,v)(δubδvb)+∂Fv∂g δg+∂Fv∂μ δμ+∂Fv∂κ κT δTb].\delta F_q^{\rm in}=F_U^c(U_b)\,\delta U_b-\Big[\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial(u,v)}\begin{pmatrix}\delta u_b\\\delta v_b\end{pmatrix}+\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial g}\,\delta g+\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial\mu}\,\delta\mu+\frac{\partial F^v}{\partial\kappa}\,\kappa_T\,\delta T_b\Big].

这里的 Jacobian 都是第 2 节写出的那些，在规定状态 qbq_b 与修正梯度 GbG_b 处取值。出口数据不含这三个参数。

The Jacobians are those of Section 2, evaluated at the prescribed state qbq_b and the corrected gradients GbG_b. The outflow data do not contain these three parameters.

核对：六列 Rh,aekR_{h,a}e_k 都按上面的公式手工组装，与本页运算图在单位参数种子下的 JVP 相比，在 6 种配置上最大相对差为 1.3×10−131.3\times10^{-13}（本页代码在构建时计算）

逐步推导：用一次前向求解得到热源梯度

Step by step: one tangent solve for the heating gradient

取 da=e5d_a=e_5，在默认制造解基准上解 AhU˙h=bdA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h=b_d，bd=−Rh,ae5b_d=-R_{h,a}e_5（本页在构建时用 96 列 JVP 组装 AhA_h，再用部分主元 LU 求解）。图 9.2 画出右端项与温度响应。同一个导数可以走两条路：

Take da=e5d_a=e_5 and solve AhU˙h=bdA_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h=b_d with bd=−Rh,ae5b_d=-R_{h,a}e_5 on the default manufactured baseline (the build assembles AhA_h from 96 JVP columns and solves by partial-pivoting LU). Figure 9.2 shows the right-hand side and the temperature response. The same derivative can be formed by two routes:

dJ^hda5=jU⊤U˙h+ja,5(tangent),g5=ja,5+(Rh,ae5)⊤ψh(adjoint).\frac{d\widehat J_h}{da_5}=j_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h+j_{a,5}\quad(\text{tangent}),\qquad g_5=j_{a,5}+(R_{h,a}e_5)^{\top}\psi_h\quad(\text{adjoint}).

若 ψh\psi_h 只解到残差 rψ=Ah⊤ψh+jUr_\psi=A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U，两条路之差正好是第 10 节的 g5−dJ^hda5=−rψ⊤U˙hg_5-\dfrac{d\widehat J_h}{da_5}=-r_\psi^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h。两条路给出的都是基网格上离散目标的精确导数；第 11 节说明，这个基网格值与加密后的值相差很远，连符号都不同。

If ψh\psi_h is solved only to the residual rψ=Ah⊤ψh+jUr_\psi=A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U, the two routes differ by exactly the Section 10 identity g5−dJ^hda5=−rψ⊤U˙hg_5-\dfrac{d\widehat J_h}{da_5}=-r_\psi^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h. Both routes give the exact derivative of the discrete objective on the base mesh; Section 11 shows that this base-mesh value is far from the refined one, even in sign.

第 10 节Section 10

伴随方程求解

Adjoint equation solve

伴随只需求解一次；切换显示分量时，解释它为何是残差行权重而非流场变量。

One adjoint solve suffices. When viewing components, explain why they weight residual rows rather than represent flow variables.

有限维 Lagrangian 与列梯度约定

Finite-dimensional Lagrangian and column gradients

Lh=Jh+ψh⊤Rh,L˙h=(jU+Ah⊤ψh)⊤U˙h+(ja+Rh,a⊤ψh)⊤da+(jX+Rh,X⊤ψh)⊤dX.\mathcal L_h=J_h+\psi_h^{\top}R_h,\qquad \dot{\mathcal L}_h=(j_U+A_h^{\top}\psi_h)^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h+(j_a+R_{h,a}^{\top}\psi_h)^{\top}d_a+(j_X+R_{h,X}^{\top}\psi_h)^{\top}d_X.
Ah⊤ψh=−jU,ga=ja+Rh,a⊤ψh,gX=jX+Rh,X⊤ψh.A_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_U,\qquad g_a=j_a+R_{h,a}^{\top}\psi_h,\qquad g_X=j_X+R_{h,X}^{\top}\psi_h.

所有 jj 都是列梯度。ψh\psi_h 对应最终离散残差的行，包括被替换的边界约束行，它不是连续速度或温度伴随场。因为收敛时 Rh=0R_h=0，乘子变化产生的项为零；令状态响应的系数为零即可消去 U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h。同一目标只需一次伴随求解。

All jj are column gradients. The multiplier ψh\psi_h weights final residual rows, including replaced boundary constraints; it is not a continuous velocity or temperature adjoint. At convergence Rh=0R_h=0 eliminates multiplier-variation terms. Cancel the state-response coefficient to eliminate U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h, requiring one adjoint solve per objective.

rψ=Ah⊤ψ~h+jU,(g~−g)⊤d=−rψ⊤U˙h.r_\psi=A_h^{\top}\widetilde\psi_h+j_U,\qquad (\widetilde g-g)^{\top}d=-r_\psi^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h.

右端、线性算子和目标必须属于同一阶数、同一边界、同一收敛状态。上式在精确 tangent 下说明：小伴随残差只有结合状态响应幅度才能解释为小梯度误差。

Right-hand side, operator and objective must use the same order, boundary and converged state. With an exact tangent, the identity shows why a small adjoint residual must be interpreted together with the response magnitude.

逐行消去未知状态响应

Eliminate the unknown state response step by step

目标总变化中最贵的项是 jU⊤U˙hj_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h。从上一节的线性约束出发，把零乘以任意列向量 ψh\psi_h 再加上，不改变总导数：

The expensive term in the objective change is jU⊤U˙hj_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h. Multiply the zero tangent constraint by any column ψh\psi_h and add it without changing the derivative:

δJ^h=jU⊤U˙h+ja⊤da+jX⊤dX+ψh⊤(AhU˙h+Rh,ada+Rh,XdX).\delta\widehat J_h=j_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h+j_a^{\top}d_a+j_X^{\top}d_X+\psi_h^{\top}(A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h+R_{h,a}d_a+R_{h,X}d_X).
ψh⊤AhU˙h=(Ah⊤ψh)⊤U˙h⟹δJ^h=(jU+Ah⊤ψh)⊤U˙h+(ja+Rh,a⊤ψh)⊤da+(jX+Rh,X⊤ψh)⊤dX.\psi_h^{\top}A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h=(A_h^{\top}\psi_h)^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \delta\widehat J_h=(j_U+A_h^{\top}\psi_h)^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h+(j_a+R_{h,a}^{\top}\psi_h)^{\top}d_a+(j_X+R_{h,X}^{\top}\psi_h)^{\top}d_X.

选择 ψh\psi_h 使 U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h 的系数为零，就不必为每个设计方向分别求 U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h。这一步给出负号：本页使用“目标加残差乘子”的约定，所以右端是 −jU-j_U。若改变 Lagrangian 的符号，乘子符号也要整体改变。

Choose ψh\psi_h to cancel the coefficient of U˙h\dot{\mathbf U}_h, eliminating one response solve per design direction. The minus sign follows from adding the residual multiplier: the right-hand side is −jU-j_U. A different Lagrangian sign would change the multiplier sign consistently.

Ah⊤ψh=−jU,δJ^h=ga⊤da+gX⊤dX.A_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_U,\qquad \delta\widehat J_h=g_a^{\top}d_a+g_X^{\top}d_X.

在两未知量练习中，jU=(0,1)⊤j_U=(0,1)^{\top}，Rh,a=(−1,0)⊤R_{h,a}=(-1,0)^{\top}，且没有目标显式项。直接手算可得：

In the two-unknown exercise, jU=(0,1)⊤j_U=(0,1)^{\top}, Rh,a=(−1,0)⊤R_{h,a}=(-1,0)^{\top}, and the direct objective term is zero:

2ψ1−ψ2=0,−ψ1+2ψ2=−1⟹ψ=(−1/3,−2/3)⊤,2\psi_1-\psi_2=0,\quad-\psi_1+2\psi_2=-1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\psi=(-1/3,-2/3)^{\top},
g=0+(−1,0)ψ=1/3=jU⊤U˙h.g=0+(-1,0)\psi=1/3=j_U^{\top}\dot{\mathbf U}_h.

前向适合少量设计方向、多个目标；伴随适合一个或少量目标、很多设计变量。本页每个目标解一次伴随，即可返回六个物理参数与全部坐标的梯度。伴随向量的分量是残差行的权重，并不是速度或温度本身。

Tangents suit a few directions and many objectives; adjoints suit a few objectives and many design variables. One adjoint here yields six physical-parameter and all coordinate gradients. Its components weight residual rows, not physical velocities or temperatures.

图 10.1 画出物理绕流基准（等温壁、二阶、常物性）中 xx 力目标的伴随解 ψh\psi_h 的四个分量，每个分量有自己的色标。它们是残差行的权重：ψi,k\psi_{i,k} 表示残差第 ii 块第 kk 行的单位扰动使目标改变多少。本节的迭代动画则在加密网格上展示热流目标伴随解的能量分量怎样逐步形成。

Figure 10.1 shows the four components of the adjoint solution ψh\psi_h for the xx-force objective on the physical-flow baseline (isothermal wall, second order, constant transport), each with its own colour bar. They are residual-row weights: ψi,k\psi_{i,k} says how much a unit perturbation of row kk of residual block ii changes the objective. The iteration animation of this section shows, on a refined mesh, how the energy component of the heat-objective adjoint builds up.

逐步推导：为什么 ψh\psi_h 的分量是行权重

Step by step: why the components of ψh\psi_h are row weights

第一步，在残差的第 rr 行加上一个小量 ε\varepsilon，即求解 Rh(Uh)+εer=0R_h(\mathbf U_h)+\varepsilon e_r=0，ere_r 是第 rr 个单位向量。对 ε\varepsilon 求导：

Step 1, add a small ε\varepsilon to residual row rr, i.e. solve Rh(Uh)+εer=0R_h(\mathbf U_h)+\varepsilon e_r=0 with ere_r the rr-th unit vector. Differentiate with respect to ε\varepsilon:

AhdUhdε+er=0⟹dUhdε=−Ah−1er.A_h\frac{d\mathbf U_h}{d\varepsilon}+e_r=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\frac{d\mathbf U_h}{d\varepsilon}=-A_h^{-1}e_r.

第二步，代入目标的变化，并用伴随方程 Ah⊤ψh=−jUA_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_U：

Step 2, insert this into the change of the objective and use the adjoint equation Ah⊤ψh=−jUA_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_U:

dJ^hdε=jU⊤dUhdε=−jU⊤Ah−1er=(−Ah−⊤jU)⊤er=ψh⊤er=ψh,r.\frac{d\widehat J_h}{d\varepsilon}=j_U^{\top}\frac{d\mathbf U_h}{d\varepsilon}=-j_U^{\top}A_h^{-1}e_r=\big(-A_h^{-\top}j_U\big)^{\top}e_r=\psi_h^{\top}e_r=\psi_{h,r}.

所以 ψh,r\psi_{h,r} 是“第 rr 个方程多出一个单位残差”对目标的影响；它的单位是目标的单位除以该行残差的单位，不是速度或温度。

So ψh,r\psi_{h,r} is the effect on the objective of one extra unit of residual in equation rr; its unit is the objective's unit divided by that row's residual unit, not a velocity or temperature.

核对：读入 run_enrichment.js 保存的 ψh\psi_h 后，用本页运算图重新计算伴随真残差 ∥Ah⊤ψh+jU∥=8.2×10−14\|A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U\|=8.2\times10^{-14}，基准流场残差 ∥Rh∥=1.8×10−13\|R_h\|=1.8\times10^{-13}；再用 JVP 组装的 AhA_h 做 LU，对 6 个残差行按第一、二步算出 dJ^h/dεd\widehat J_h/d\varepsilon，与 ψh\psi_h 的对应分量相比最大差为 max⁡∣ψh∣\max|\psi_h| 的 2.0×10−142.0\times10^{-14} 倍（本页代码在构建时计算）

Check: after reading the ψh\psi_h stored by run_enrichment.js, the page's graph recomputes the true adjoint residual ∥Ah⊤ψh+jU∥=8.2×10−14\|A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U\|=8.2\times10^{-14} and the baseline flow residual ∥Rh∥=1.8×10−13\|R_h\|=1.8\times10^{-13}; with AhA_h assembled from JVPs and factored by LU, dJ^h/dεd\widehat J_h/d\varepsilon from Steps 1 and 2 for 6 residual rows matches the corresponding components of ψh\psi_h to 2.0×10−142.0\times10^{-14} times max⁡∣ψh∣\max|\psi_h| (computed by this page's code at build time)

下面的动画播放加热壁面层流算例（第 6 节的图）已保存的实际迭代：原始 Newton 的 4 步温度与速度，以及热流目标伴随的 46 次 FGMRES 迭代。伴随从零开始。ASM/ILU 预处理本身是非局部的，所以第一次迭代就已远离壁面：紧邻外边界的 32 个控制体中有 29 个超过该次迭代最大值的 1%。但权重集中在壁面附近：半径小于 0.9 的控制体占 ∑ψE2\sum\psi_E^2 的 70%，最终解中为 38%。第 8 次迭代以后，归一化的场形状与最终解相差不到 1%；其余迭代只把真残差降到容差以下。

The animation below plays stored actual iterates of the heated-wall laminar case (the Section 6 figure): 4 primal Newton steps of temperature and velocity, and 46 FGMRES iterations of the heat-objective adjoint. The adjoint starts from zero. The ASM/ILU preconditioner is itself non-local, so the first iterate already reaches far from the wall: 29 of the 32 volumes next to the outer boundary exceed 1% of that iterate's maximum. Its weight, however, sits near the wall: volumes with centroid radius below 0.9 hold 70% of ∑ψE2\sum\psi_E^2, against 38% in the final solution. From iteration 8 on, the normalized field differs from the final one by less than 1%; the remaining iterations only drive the true residual below the tolerance.

参数与几何导数

Parameter and geometry derivatives

移动坐标方向只在图中标出单位扰动，不改变当前基准。对比目标显式项和残差响应项。

The coordinate arrow denotes a unit direction, without deforming the baseline. Compare direct and residual-response terms.

图 11.1：几何变化Figure 11.1: Geometry variations

物性、边界与源项参数

Transport, boundary and source parameters

参数依次为来流幅度、方向、参考黏度、Pr、壁温／制造解内边界温度偏移、附加热源。制造解的前两个参数分别扰动入口两个速度分量；基准解析源项固定，不随这些局部扰动重新制造。制造解出口牵引与热流使用当前物性和固定解析场，因此物性也有显式边界路径。

Parameters are inflow amplitude, direction, reference viscosity, Pr, wall temperature/manufactured inner-boundary temperature offset, and added heating. In the manufactured case the first two perturb inlet velocity components; analytic baseline forcing stays fixed. Manufactured outflow traction and heat use current transport and a fixed analytic field, retaining explicit transport boundary paths.

坐标导数贯穿整条离散链

Coordinates enter the entire discrete chain

s˙=n⋅N˙,n˙=N˙−ns˙s,c˙i=Hi−1(r˙i−H˙ici),S˙i=∑q(w˙qS(xq)+wqSx(xq)x˙q).\dot s=n\cdot\dot N,\quad\dot n=\frac{\dot N-n\dot s}{s},\quad\dot c_i=H_i^{-1}(\dot r_i-\dot H_ic_i),\quad \dot S_i=\sum_q(\dot w_qS(x_q)+w_qS_x(x_q)\dot x_q).

N=snN=sn 是长度法向。坐标还改变体积、质心、中心矩、边界距离和目标求积。固定制造源函数不等于固定其空间采样值。没有引入网格弹性映射，所以表中的节点梯度是直接坐标梯度，不是已包含内部网格移动的完整物面形状梯度。

The length normal is N=snN=sn. Coordinates also change volume, centroid, moments, boundary distances and objective quadrature. Freezing the manufactured source function does not freeze its spatial samples. With no mesh-elasticity map, these are direct coordinate gradients, not complete body-shape gradients including interior mesh motion.

单位法向的导数为什么不能省略归一化

Differentiate the normalization of a unit normal

N=(yb−ya,−(xb−xa)),δN=(δyb−δya,−δxb+δxa).N=(y_b-y_a,-(x_b-x_a)),\quad\delta N=(\delta y_b-\delta y_a,-\delta x_b+\delta x_a).
s=(N⊤N)1/2⟹δs=N⊤δNs=n⊤δN.s=(N^{\top}N)^{1/2}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\delta s=\frac{N^{\top}\delta N}{s}=n^{\top}\delta N.
δn=δ(N/s)=δNs−Nδss2=I−nn⊤sδN,n⊤δn=0.\delta n=\delta(N/s)=\frac{\delta N}{s}-\frac{N\delta s}{s^2}=\frac{I-nn^{\top}}{s}\delta N,\qquad n^{\top}\delta n=0.

最后一个恒等式来自 n⊤n=1n^{\top}n=1，可以作为实现的局部检查。移动节点还会改变求积点、体积和拟合中心。例如有向多边形的面积可由相邻顶点的叉积求和，再直接对每一项求导：

The final identity follows from n⊤n=1n^{\top}n=1 and is a local check. Node motion also changes quadrature, volume and fit centres. For example, differentiate the signed polygon-area formula term by term:

V=12∑k(xkyk+1−ykxk+1),V=\frac12\sum_k(x_ky_{k+1}-y_kx_{k+1}),
δV=12∑k(δxkyk+1+xkδyk+1−δykxk+1−ykδxk+1).\delta V=\frac12\sum_k(\delta x_k y_{k+1}+x_k\delta y_{k+1}-\delta y_k x_{k+1}-y_k\delta x_{k+1}).

若将来用少量物面参数 b 控制全部网格坐标 X=M(b)X=\mathcal M(b)，还需要一层链式法则 gb=Mb⊤gXg_b=\mathcal M_b^{\top}g_X。当前页面直接扰动节点坐标，尚未引入网格变形求解器。

A future mesh map X=M(b)X=\mathcal M(b) from a few shape parameters needs another chain rule, gb=Mb⊤gXg_b=\mathcal M_b^{\top}g_X. This page directly perturbs coordinates and has no mesh-deformation solver.

Figure 11.2 draws the gradient of the xx-force objective with respect to all 48 coordinates as arrows at the vertices: the explicit term jXj_X on the left and the total gradient gX=jX+Rh,X⊤ψhg_X=j_X+R_{h,X}^{\top}\psi_h on the right. Figure 11.3 shows which geometric quantities move when one vertex moves.

逐步推导：面积、形心与二阶矩对坐标的导数

Step by step: coordinate derivatives of area, centroid and second moments

第一步，用顶点写出多边形积分。令 Ak=12(xkyk+1−xk+1yk)\mathcal A_k=\tfrac12(x_ky_{k+1}-x_{k+1}y_k)（原点与边 kk 组成的有向三角形面积），由散度定理

Step 1, write the polygon integrals through the vertices. With Ak=12(xkyk+1−xk+1yk)\mathcal A_k=\tfrac12(x_ky_{k+1}-x_{k+1}y_k), the signed area of the triangle formed by the origin and edge kk, the divergence theorem gives

Vi=∑kAk,∫Vix dA=13∑k(xk+xk+1)Ak,∫Vix2dA=16∑k(xk2+xkxk+1+xk+12)Ak,V_i=\sum_k\mathcal A_k,\quad\int_{V_i}x\,dA=\frac13\sum_k(x_k+x_{k+1})\mathcal A_k,\quad\int_{V_i}x^2dA=\frac16\sum_k(x_k^2+x_kx_{k+1}+x_{k+1}^2)\mathcal A_k,
∫Vixy dA=112∑k(xkyk+1+2xkyk+2xk+1yk+1+xk+1yk)Ak,.\int_{V_i}xy\,dA=\frac1{12}\sum_k\big(x_ky_{k+1}+2x_ky_k+2x_{k+1}y_{k+1}+x_{k+1}y_k\big)\mathcal A_k,.

把 xx 换成 yy 得到其余两个积分。

Exchanging xx and yy gives the remaining two integrals.

第二步，形心与中心矩是它们的商与差：

Step 2, the centroid and central moments are quotients and differences of these:

xi=1Vi∫Vix dA,Mxx,i=1Vi∫Vix2dA−xi2,Mxy,i=1Vi∫Vixy dA−xiyi.x_i=\frac1{V_i}\int_{V_i}x\,dA,\qquad M_{xx,i}=\frac1{V_i}\int_{V_i}x^2dA-x_i^2,\qquad M_{xy,i}=\frac1{V_i}\int_{V_i}xy\,dA-x_iy_i.

第三步，逐项求变分。先写出每个有向三角形面积的变分，再用乘积与商法则：

Step 3, vary term by term: first the signed triangle areas, then the product and quotient rules give

δAk=12(δxk yk+1+xk δyk+1−δxk+1 yk−xk+1 δyk),\delta\mathcal A_k=\tfrac12\big(\delta x_k\,y_{k+1}+x_k\,\delta y_{k+1}-\delta x_{k+1}\,y_k-x_{k+1}\,\delta y_k\big),
δxi=δ ⁣∫x dA−xi δViVi,δMxx,i=δ ⁣∫x2dAVi−∫x2dAVi2 δVi−2xi δxi.\delta x_i=\frac{\delta\!\int x\,dA-x_i\,\delta V_i}{V_i},\qquad\delta M_{xx,i}=\frac{\delta\!\int x^2dA}{V_i}-\frac{\int x^2dA}{V_i^2}\,\delta V_i-2x_i\,\delta x_i.

这些量进入拟合行 bijb_{ij}、权重 wij=∥xj−xi∥−2w_{ij}=\|x_j-x_i\|^{-2} 与边界长度 hbh_b，再经 Hiδci=δri−δHiciH_i\delta c_i=\delta r_i-\delta H_ic_i 进入每个迹。

These quantities enter the fit rows bijb_{ij}, the weights wij=∥xj−xi∥−2w_{ij}=\|x_j-x_i\|^{-2} and the boundary length hbh_b, and through Hiδci=δri−δHiciH_i\delta c_i=\delta r_i-\delta H_ic_i every trace.

基网格梯度不等于连续梯度

A base-mesh gradient is not the continuum gradient

读表时注意：这些是 24 个控制体基网格上的离散梯度。它们是这个离散目标的精确导数（第 12、13 节用差分与复数步长核对），却不一定接近连续问题的梯度。以热源幅度为例，附录 A.18 对同一问题（同一制造基态、物性和温度跟踪目标）逐级加密：格心二阶在基网格上为 6.739×10−46.739\times10^{-4}，第 1 级加密（96 个控制体）就变为 −4.50×10−3-4.50\times10^{-3}，到 6144 个控制体为 −3.512×10−3-3.512\times10^{-3}；独立连续参考为 −3.509×10−3-3.509\times10^{-3}。粗网格连梯度符号都给错了，因此不能拿基网格的数值去判断设计方向。

Read the table with care: these are discrete gradients on the 24-volume base mesh. They are exact derivatives of this discrete objective (checked by differences and complex steps in Sections 12 and 13) but need not be close to the continuum gradient. Take the heating amplitude: Appendix A.18 refines the same problem (same manufactured base, transport and tracking objective). Second-order cells give 6.739×10−46.739\times10^{-4} on the base mesh, −4.50×10−3-4.50\times10^{-3} at refinement level 1 (96 volumes) and −3.512×10−3-3.512\times10^{-3} at 6144 volumes; the independent continuous reference is −3.509×10−3-3.509\times10^{-3}. The coarse mesh even has the wrong sign, so base-mesh values must not be used to judge a design direction.

壁温／内边界温度（参数 4）在同一基网格上，格心为 7.17×10−37.17\times10^{-3}，格点为 −1.97×10−2-1.97\times10^{-2}，符号相反。用同样的稀疏精确伴随逐级加密（run_boundary_temperature.js）：格心依次为 7.17×10−37.17\times10^{-3}、6.53×10−36.53\times10^{-3}、8.07×10−38.07\times10^{-3}、8.58×10−38.58\times10^{-3}、8.73×10−38.73\times10^{-3}，格点依次为 −1.97×10−2-1.97\times10^{-2}、2.57×10−32.57\times10^{-3}、7.54×10−37.54\times10^{-3}、8.54×10−38.54\times10^{-3}、8.72×10−38.72\times10^{-3}，最细层（6144／4224 个控制体）两者相差 0.15%。两种格式趋于同一个正值，所以格心的基网格值更接近加密极限，格点基网格的负号是粗网格误差。它并不只来自纯入口节点 0、1、7 的强温度行：把 Rh,a⊤ψhR_{h,a}^{\top}\psi_h 的第 4 分量按行拆开，基网格上强约束行贡献 −7.40×10−3-7.40\times10^{-3}，其余平衡行（入口半面的规定状态与梯度惩罚）贡献 −1.23×10−2-1.23\times10^{-2}，二者同号；加密后强约束行的贡献变为正值（最细层 1.16×10−21.16\times10^{-2}），平衡行贡献缩小到 −2.89×10−3-2.89\times10^{-3}。

For the wall / inner-boundary temperature (parameter 4) the same base mesh gives 7.17×10−37.17\times10^{-3} for cells and −1.97×10−2-1.97\times10^{-2} for nodes, with opposite signs. Refining with the same sparse exact adjoint (run_boundary_temperature.js) gives, for cells, 7.17×10−37.17\times10^{-3}, 6.53×10−36.53\times10^{-3}, 8.07×10−38.07\times10^{-3}, 8.58×10−38.58\times10^{-3}, 8.73×10−38.73\times10^{-3} and, for nodes, −1.97×10−2-1.97\times10^{-2}, 2.57×10−32.57\times10^{-3}, 7.54×10−37.54\times10^{-3}, 8.54×10−38.54\times10^{-3}, 8.72×10−38.72\times10^{-3}; on the finest level (6144 / 4224 volumes) they differ by 0.15%. Both schemes approach the same positive value, so the cell base-mesh value is closer to the refined limit and the node's negative sign is coarse-mesh error. It does not come only from the strong temperature rows at pure-inlet nodes 0, 1, 7: splitting component 4 of Rh,a⊤ψhR_{h,a}^{\top}\psi_h row by row, strong rows contribute −7.40×10−3-7.40\times10^{-3} on the base mesh and the remaining balance rows (prescribed inlet states and gradient penalties) contribute −1.23×10−2-1.23\times10^{-2}, with the same sign. On refinement the strong-row part turns positive (1.16×10−21.16\times10^{-2} on the finest level) and the balance-row part shrinks to −2.89×10−3-2.89\times10^{-3}.

坐标行也要这样读。以内部顶点 X[12] 的 x 坐标为例，目标显式项为 3.621×10−43.621\times10^{-4}，残差响应项为 −3.753×10−4-3.753\times10^{-4}，总导数为 −1.329×10−5-1.329\times10^{-5}，只有显式项的 3.7%。移动内部顶点不改变连续问题的区域和数据，只改变离散方式，所以连续目标对这种移动的导数恰为零，离散导数只是离散误差随顶点位置的变化。显式项（存储状态不动，求积点、权重和重构随顶点移动）与响应项（存储状态跟着网格移动）各自相当于把局部流场平移了一下，本身并不小；二者相加只剩离散误差的变化，这部分随网格加密趋于零。移动固壁或入口上的顶点则不同：它改变区域形状，在连续极限下仍有非零导数。

Read the coordinate rows the same way. For the x coordinate of interior vertex X[12], the direct objective term is 3.621×10−43.621\times10^{-4}, the residual-response term −3.753×10−4-3.753\times10^{-4}, and the total −1.329×10−5-1.329\times10^{-5}, only 3.7% of the direct term. Moving an interior vertex changes neither the continuum domain nor its data, only the discretization, so the continuum objective has exactly zero derivative for such a motion, and the discrete derivative is only the change of the discretization error with the vertex position. The direct term (stored states fixed while quadrature points, weights and reconstruction move with the vertex) and the response term (stored states following the mesh) each amount to shifting the local field and are not small by themselves; their sum leaves only the change of the discretization error, which vanishes under refinement. Moving a vertex on a wall or inlet is different: it changes the domain and keeps a nonzero derivative in the continuum limit.

有限差分与 Taylor 检验

Finite differences and Taylor checks

选择一个方向并扫描步长；检查正负扰动残差后，再解释误差下降与回升。

Sweep steps for one direction. Inspect both perturbed residuals before interpreting the error curve.

每个步长都重新收敛

Reconverge for every step

Dk+=J^(a+εek)−J^(a)ε,Dk−=J^(a)−J^(a−εek)ε,Dk0=J^(a+εek)−J^(a−εek)2ε.D_k^+=\frac{\widehat J(a+\varepsilon e_k)-\widehat J(a)}\varepsilon,\quad D_k^-=\frac{\widehat J(a)-\widehat J(a-\varepsilon e_k)}\varepsilon,\quad D_k^0=\frac{\widehat J(a+\varepsilon e_k)-\widehat J(a-\varepsilon e_k)}{2\varepsilon}.
E2(ε)=∣J^(a+εek)−J^(a)−εgk∣.E_2(\varepsilon)=|\widehat J(a+\varepsilon e_k)-\widehat J(a)-\varepsilon g_k|.

可以选择全部六个物理参数及所有节点的 x/y 坐标，执行一个步长或完整步长扫描。每次重新构造几何、边界和流场。大步长有截断误差，小步长受浮点相消和原始容差影响；误差接近零时优先查看绝对误差。全部方向扫描较慢，计算中显示进度。

Select all six physical parameters and x/y coordinates of every vertex, for one step or a complete step sweep. Rebuild geometry, boundaries and primal flow each time. Large steps incur truncation error and small steps suffer cancellation and primal tolerance. Use absolute error near zero derivatives. All-direction sweeps are slower and display progress.

应期待的吻合程度：截断误差区的斜率接近 1（单边）或 2（中心差分与 E2E_2）；最小相对误差由截断误差与求解、舍入误差的平衡决定，上表三个方向为 1.1×10−81.1\times10^{-8} 到 5.7×10−75.7\times10^{-7}，出现在 ε=1×10−5\varepsilon=1\times10^{-5} 到 1×10−41\times10^{-4}。再减小步长时，目标值的求解误差 EJE_J 被放大为 O(EJ/ε)O(E_J/\varepsilon)，曲线回升；这部分不说明伴随有误。这些检查只说明伴随给出了本离散目标的精确导数；粗网格上的离散梯度本身仍可能与连续梯度相差很大，甚至符号相反（第 11 节，附录 A.18）。

What agreement to expect: in the truncation range the slopes approach 1 (one-sided) or 2 (central and E2E_2). The smallest relative error is set by the balance of truncation against solve and roundoff error; for the three directions above it ranges from 1.1×10−81.1\times10^{-8} to 5.7×10−75.7\times10^{-7} at ε\varepsilon from 1×10−51\times10^{-5} to 1×10−41\times10^{-4}. For smaller steps the objective solve error EJE_J is amplified to O(EJ/ε)O(E_J/\varepsilon) and the curve turns up; this does not indicate an adjoint error. These checks show only that the adjoint gives the exact derivative of this discrete objective; the discrete gradient on a coarse mesh can still differ greatly from the continuum gradient, even in sign (Section 11, Appendix A.18).

由 Taylor 展开预测差分误差

Predict difference errors using Taylor expansion

为了同时覆盖物理参数与坐标，本节把全部设计分量合记为 b，约化目标为 J^(b)=Jh(Uh(b),b)\widehat J(b)=J_h(U_h(b),b)。在可微的固定分支上沿单位方向展开：

Collect physical parameters and coordinates into b and write the reduced objective J^(b)=Jh(Uh(b),b)\widehat J(b)=J_h(U_h(b),b). Expand along a unit direction within a smooth fixed branch:

J^(b±εek)=J^(b)±εgk+12ε2Jkk±16ε3Jkkk+O(ε4).\widehat J(b\pm\varepsilon e_k)=\widehat J(b)\pm\varepsilon g_k+\tfrac12\varepsilon^2J_{kk}\pm\tfrac16\varepsilon^3J_{kkk}+O(\varepsilon^4).
Dk+=gk+12εJkk+O(ε2),Dk0=gk+16ε2Jkkk+O(ε4),E2=O(ε2).D_k^+=g_k+\tfrac12\varepsilon J_{kk}+O(\varepsilon^2),\quad D_k^0=g_k+\tfrac16\varepsilon^2J_{kkk}+O(\varepsilon^4),\quad E_2=O(\varepsilon^2).

正负相减消掉二次项，所以中心差分的截断误差通常比单边差分低一阶。但若每次目标求解带有误差 EJE_J，除以步长会放大到 O(EJ/ε)O(E_J/\varepsilon)，因此图线不会随步长缩小而永远下降。曲线回升不一定是伴随写错，也可能是流场容差与浮点相消。

Subtracting opposite perturbations cancels the quadratic term, improving central truncation error by one order. However, objective-solve error EJE_J contributes O(EJ/ε)O(E_J/\varepsilon). Thus the curve need not decrease indefinitely; an upturn may reflect solve tolerance or cancellation rather than an adjoint error.

若只在固定 U 上扰动参数，算到的是显式偏导 jaj_a，不是经过重新收敛的总导数。操作时先选一个坐标方向，查看不同步长、正负流场残差与伴随值，再切换到全部方向。

Perturbing parameters at fixed U yields only a direct partial derivative, not the reconverged total derivative. Start with one coordinate, inspect step sizes and both perturbed residuals, then switch to all directions.

第 13 节Section 13

独立复数算术

Independent complex arithmetic

用与差分相同的方向，比较独立复数运算和伴随导数。

Compare independent complex arithmetic and adjoint derivatives in the same direction as finite differences.

复数残差是另一条算术路径

Complex residuals use another arithmetic path

gk≃Im⁡Jh(UC,a+iεek)/ε,ε=10−25,AhΔUIm=−Im⁡Rh/ε.g_k\simeq\operatorname{Im}J_h(U^{\mathbb C},a+\mathrm i\varepsilon e_k)/\varepsilon,\quad\varepsilon=10^{-25},\qquad A_h\Delta U_{\rm Im}=-\operatorname{Im}R_h/\varepsilon.

从收敛实解开始，用复数四则运算、正值分支的分数幂和三角函数评估同一残差，再校正虚部。整数幂用代数乘法，避免对负实数做极坐标幂时引入与步长无关的虚部舍入。此路径不直接返回 tangent 结果，但校正线性系统仍复用实 Jacobian。

Start from the converged real state, evaluate the residual using complex arithmetic, positive-branch fractional powers and trigonometric functions, then correct its imaginary part. Integer powers use algebraic multiplication to avoid step-independent imaginary roundoff from polar powers of negative reals. The final result is not copied from a tangent, although corrections reuse the real Jacobian.

几何拓扑、边界分区和拟合邻域保持固定。有效性检查在实基态进行；不对复数作大小比较、绝对值 limiter 或裁剪。必须同时查看缩放虚部残差，而不是仅凭步长很小判断正确。

Topology, boundary partitions and fit stencils stay fixed. Admissibility is checked at the real base state, without complex ordering, absolute-value limiters or clipping. Inspect scaled imaginary residuals rather than trusting a small step by itself.

Saved complex-step results

默认基准上，本页的独立复数残差对六个物理参数和三个坐标方向（步长 10−2510^{-25}）给出的梯度，与伴随梯度的最大相对差为 3.3×10−83.3\times10^{-8}，缩放虚部残差 ∥Im⁡Rh/ε∥\|\operatorname{Im}R_h/\varepsilon\| 都小于 8.9×10−128.9\times10^{-12}。复数步长没有相减，截断误差为 O(ε2)O(\varepsilon^2)；步长足够小后，误差停在由线性修正容差决定的平台 5.5×10−135.5\times10^{-13}，与步长无关。

On the default baseline, this page's independent complex residual gives gradients for the six physical parameters and three coordinates (step 10−2510^{-25}) that differ from the adjoint gradient by at most 3.3×10−83.3\times10^{-8} relative; every scaled imaginary residual ∥Im⁡Rh/ε∥\|\operatorname{Im}R_h/\varepsilon\| is below 8.9×10−128.9\times10^{-12}. With no subtraction the truncation error is O(ε2)O(\varepsilon^2); once the step is small enough the error stays on a plateau of 5.5×10−135.5\times10^{-13} set by the linear-correction tolerance, independent of the step.

复数步长为何不需要相减

Why complex step avoids subtraction

J^(b+iεek)=J^(b)+iεgk−12ε2Jkk−i6ε3Jkkk+⋯ .\widehat J(b+\mathrm i\varepsilon e_k)=\widehat J(b)+\mathrm i\varepsilon g_k-\tfrac12\varepsilon^2J_{kk}-\tfrac{\mathrm i}{6}\varepsilon^3J_{kkk}+\cdots.
Im⁡J^(b+iεek)/ε=gk−16ε2Jkkk+⋯ .\operatorname{Im}\widehat J(b+\mathrm i\varepsilon e_k)/\varepsilon=g_k-\tfrac16\varepsilon^2J_{kkk}+\cdots.

它通过虚部隔离一次项，避免两个接近实数的目标值相减。但前提是整条残差计算在当前分支上能作解析延拓；例如使用绝对值直接处理复数，就会破坏这条展开。这里使用独立复数残差、固定拓扑及固定分支。

The imaginary part isolates the first-order term without subtracting nearby real objective values. The residual path must admit analytic continuation on the active branch; complex absolute values would invalidate the expansion. This implementation uses independent complex arithmetic and fixed topology and branches.

UC=U∗+iεU˙h,Im⁡R(UC,b+iεd)ε=AhU˙h+Rh,bd+O(ε2).U^{\mathbb C}=U_*+\mathrm i\varepsilon\dot{\mathbf U}_h,\quad \frac{\operatorname{Im}R(U^{\mathbb C},b+\mathrm i\varepsilon d)}{\varepsilon}=A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h+R_{h,b}d+O(\varepsilon^2).

因此实 Jacobian 可以用来校正缩放虚部残差，但最终目标虚部仍必须由复数运算独立算出。两种方法共用物理残差定义，所以通过复数检查仍不能单独证明物理模型和边界条件正确。

The real Jacobian can therefore correct the scaled imaginary residual, while the final imaginary objective is evaluated independently. Both routes share the residual definition, so agreement alone cannot prove physical modelling and boundary correctness.

Compare first/second-order error ratios and distinguish mesh size from the design-difference step.

独立制造源项与固定几何域

Independent forcing on a fixed geometric domain

ρ∗=1+0.025sin⁡(0.7x+0.4y),u∗=0.22+0.025sin⁡(0.5x+0.6y),\rho_*=1+0.025\sin(0.7x+0.4y),\quad u_*=0.22+0.025\sin(0.5x+0.6y),
v∗=0.055+0.01cos⁡(0.8x−0.3y),T∗=1+0.04sin⁡(0.6x+0.7y),S∗=∇⋅(Fc−Fv)(U∗).v_*=0.055+0.01\cos(0.8x-0.3y),\quad T_*=1+0.04\sin(0.6x+0.7y),\quad S_*=\nabla\cdot(F^c-F^v)(U_*).

源项通过解析函数的空间双层方向运算构造，包含应力散度、黏性功和变物性导数，不调用离散残差生成源项。四个分量都允许非零源。加密细分同一个多边形域，边界中点留在原直边上，避免把物面形状改变混进阶数。

Spatial nested directional arithmetic differentiates analytic functions to construct forcing, including stress divergence, viscous work and variable transport. It does not manufacture forcing from the discrete residual. All four source components may be nonzero. Refinement subdivides the same polygonal domain, placing boundary midpoints on existing straight edges rather than changing the body shape.

Eh=[∑iVi∥Ui−U∗,i∥22∑iVi]1/2,ordh=log⁡2(Eh/Eh/2).E_h=\left[\frac{\sum_iV_i\|U_i-U_{*,i}\|_2^2}{\sum_iV_i}\right]^{1/2},\qquad \mathrm{ord}_h=\log_2(E_h/E_{h/2}).

格心参考为独立高阶求积的守恒平均，格点参考为解析节点值。表中给出实际误差和观测斜率；“二阶重构”是算法选择，不是预先保证每个目标、壁面应力和粗网格误差都二阶。物理绕流的多边形角点与薄层解析能力另当别论。

Cell references are conservative averages from independent high-order quadrature; node references are analytic point values. Tables report measured errors and rates. Second-order reconstruction does not pre-guarantee second order for every objective, wall stress or coarse-grid error. Polygonal corners and boundary-layer resolution in physical flow are separate issues.

制造解检查的对象与二阶误差的含义

What manufactured solutions and second-order errors test

选好光滑的 U∗U_* 后，先代入连续物理通量并求散度，得到独立源项 S∗S_*。边界数据也由同一个解析场构造。然后求解离散方程并比较；若用离散残差本身来构造“源项”，就失去了检查空间离散误差的独立性。

Choose smooth U∗U_*, differentiate its physical flux to construct independent S∗S_*, and derive boundary data from that field. Solve the discrete problem and compare. Manufacturing a source from the discrete residual itself would remove this independent spatial-error check.

Eh≈CEhord,Eh/2≈CE(h/2)ord⟹EhEh/2≈2ord,ord≈log⁡2(Eh/Eh/2).E_h\approx C_Eh^{\rm ord},\quad E_{h/2}\approx C_E(h/2)^{\rm ord}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \frac{E_h}{E_{h/2}}\approx2^{\rm ord},\quad {\rm ord}\approx\log_2(E_h/E_{h/2}).

这说明误差每次约缩小四倍才对应二阶，而不是“图看上去更光滑”。这里 h 表示网格加密尺度；第 12、13 节的 ε\varepsilon 表示设计方向上的差分或复数步长，两者不能混在同一结论中。格心误差必须比较守恒平均：一般 T(⟨U⟩)T(\langle U\rangle) 不等于 ⟨T(U)⟩\langle T(U)\rangle。

Second order means roughly fourfold error reduction per halving of h, not simply a smoother picture. Mesh scale h differs from the design step ε\varepsilon of Sections 12 and 13. Compare conserved averages for cells: generally T(⟨U⟩)≠⟨T(U)⟩T(\langle U\rangle)\ne\langle T(U)\rangle.

无滑移壁面的制造解

A no-slip manufactured solution

上面的制造解在内圈使用开口的入流／牵引数据，从不经过第 3 节的固壁代码。为了检验真实的固壁闭合——格心的面通量与惩罚梯度（系数 2）、格点的强速度行、等温温度行和绝热法向梯度行，以及第 6 节的壁面合力与热流——另造一个在内圈满足无滑移的光滑解。内圈走与层流绕流完全相同的固壁分支（core.js 的 wallmms 情形），外圈仍用本节的入流／牵引闭合和数据。

The manufactured solution above uses open inflow/traction data on the inner boundary and never reaches the wall code of Section 3. The inner boundary takes exactly the wall branch of the laminar-flow case (core.js mode wallmms); the outer boundary keeps this section's inflow/traction closures and data.

连续对照与验证范围

Continuum comparison and scope

区分转置点积、总梯度、空间精度与连续参照四类检查。

Distinguish transpose products, total gradients, spatial accuracy and continuum checks.

三个不同层次的正确性

Three different levels of correctness

点积测试检查转置；全重算差分检查实际离散目标的总导数；制造解加密检查离散解对连续方程的逼近。它们不是同一个检查，也不能互相替代。连续参考的独立性应来自不同方程／边值求解路线，而不是换一个符号调用同一矩阵。

Dot tests check transposition; reconverged differences check total derivatives of the actual discrete objective; manufactured refinement checks approximation of the continuum equation. These are distinct tests. Independence requires a different equation/boundary-solve route, not renaming the same matrix.

R~=D−1R,ψ~=D⊤ψ,A~⊤ψ~=−jU.\widetilde R=D^{-1}R,\quad\widetilde\psi=D^{\top}\psi,\quad\widetilde A^{\top}\widetilde\psi=-j_U.

将积分残差除以体积会改变乘子数值，但在收敛状态不改变总梯度。强边界行需要自己的尺度。正文 ψh\psi_h 与附录的连续 λ(x,y)\lambda(x,y) 不直接逐点相减；附录提供完整二维推导、O 型域上独立的二维边值求解与制造目标梯度验证，以及平面一维 ODE 对照。温度跟踪另有局部 P₁／P₂ 连续弱形式、局部加密与独立原始重算；同网格差分吻合与连续网格精度分别报告。A.18 进一步把正文四种离散格式的热源梯度与同一问题的连续参考直接加密比较。有限网格差距和参考自身的变化分别展示；这项验证限定为开口内圈热源问题，不能推广到一般二维绕流。

Dividing integrated residuals by volume changes multiplier values but not converged total gradients. Strong boundary rows need their own scales. Do not subtract the discrete ψh\psi_h directly from continuum λ(x,y)\lambda(x,y). The appendix provides the full 2D derivation, an independent O-domain BVP solve and manufactured-objective gradient validation, plus a plane-1D ODE comparison. Tracking additionally has a local P₁/P₂ continuous weak form, local refinement and independent primal reruns. Same-mesh FD agreement and continuum resolution are reported separately. A.18 directly compares heating-gradient refinement for all four FV variants with the continuous reference for the same problem. Finite-mesh differences and reference changes are reported separately. Scope remains the open-inner-boundary heating problem, not general flow around a body.

Saved dot-product result: on the default baseline the left side w⊤(AhU˙+Rh,bd)+J˙w^{\top}(A_h\dot{\mathbf U}+R_{h,b}d)+\dot J is −1.88149261096033×102-1.88149261096033\times10^{2} and the right side U˙⊤Uˉ+d⊤bˉ\dot{\mathbf U}^{\top}\bar U+d^{\top}\bar b is −1.88149261096034×102-1.88149261096034\times10^{2}, an absolute difference of 2.84×10−142.84\times10^{-14} and a relative difference of 1.5×10−161.5\times10^{-16}. The forward and reverse graphs of the same discrete function each accumulate 247 products, the largest being 2.03×1012.03\times10^{1}; for a correct implementation the difference is pure roundoff, a small multiple of machine precision 2.2×10−162.2\times10^{-16}. A clearly larger relative difference (say 10−810^{-8}) usually means a missing, extra or untransposed path.

残差缩放改变乘子，但不改变收敛总梯度

Residual scaling changes multipliers but not converged gradients

令 D 是可逆的行尺度矩阵。固定坐标时 R~=D−1R\widetilde R=D^{-1}R 给出 A~=D−1A\widetilde A=D^{-1}A；因此取 ψ~=D⊤ψ\widetilde\psi=D^{\top}\psi 恰好保证伴随方程相同：

Let D be an invertible row-scale matrix. At fixed geometry, R~=D−1R\widetilde R=D^{-1}R gives A~=D−1A\widetilde A=D^{-1}A. Choosing ψ~=D⊤ψ\widetilde\psi=D^{\top}\psi preserves the adjoint equation:

A~⊤ψ~=A⊤D−⊤D⊤ψ=A⊤ψ=−jU.\widetilde A^{\top}\widetilde\psi=A^{\top}D^{-\top}D^{\top}\psi=A^{\top}\psi=-j_U.

若尺度随坐标或参数变化，还会出现 δ(D−1)R\delta(D^{-1})R。仅在原始残差已经为零时，这一项才消失。因此比较不同程序的伴随数值前，要先核对残差定义、体积缩放与强边界行。

If D varies with design, a term δ(D−1)R\delta(D^{-1})R appears and vanishes only at a converged state. Compare residual definitions, volume scaling and strong rows before comparing multipliers between codes.

δR~=D−1δR+δ(D−1)R,R=0⇒ψ~⊤δR~=ψ⊤δR.\delta\widetilde R=D^{-1}\delta R+\delta(D^{-1})R,\qquad R=0\Rightarrow\widetilde\psi^{\top}\delta\widetilde R=\psi^{\top}\delta R.

GS, GMRES and LU

对同一个伴随系统比较 GS、GMRES 与 LU，以真实残差判断是否收敛。

Compare GS, GMRES and LU for the same adjoint system, using true residuals to judge convergence.

图 16.2：GS 的扫描方向Figure 16.2: GS sweep directions

便宜修正始终针对精确系统

Inexpensive correction still targets the exact system

Kx=b,xk+1=xk+ωBK(b−Kxk),BK=Bh or Bh⊤,ω=0.5.Kx=b,\quad x^{k+1}=x^k+\omega B_K(b-Kx^k),\quad B_K=B_h\ \text{or}\ B_h^{\top},\quad\omega=0.5.
Bh⊤=(DP⊤+LP⊤)−1,zi=Pii−⊤(ri−∑j>iPji⊤zj).B_h^{\top}=(D_P^{\top}+L_P^{\top})^{-1},\quad z_i=P_{ii}^{-\top}\left(r_i-\sum_{j>i}P_{ji}^{\top}z_j\right).

前向块 GS 从前往后扫描，转置作用从后往前，并转置每个块。固定迭代收敛需要 ρ(I−ωBKK)<1\rho(I-\omega B_KK)<1，不是由格式名自动保证。预算耗尽或残差增长必须显示为未收敛。

Forward block GS sweeps forward; its transpose sweeps backward and transposes every block. Stationary convergence requires ρ(I−ωBKK)<1\rho(I-\omega B_KK)<1, not a method name. Budget exhaustion or growth must be shown as nonconvergence.

KBKVm=Vm+1H‾m,ym=arg⁡min⁡y∥∥r0∥e1−H‾my∥2,xm=BKVmym.KB_K\mathbf V_m=\mathbf V_{m+1}\overline H_m,\quad y_m=\arg\min_y\big\|\|r_0\|e_1-\overline H_my\big\|_2,\quad x_m=B_K\mathbf V_my_m.

GMRES 使用右预处理，Arnoldi 正交化两次；每轮恢复解并计算真残差，必要时重启。比较时使用同一个基态、同一个右端和同一真残差尺度。LU 的准备包括显式组装和分解；小网格的速度不能直接推广到工业规模。

GMRES uses right preconditioning and two orthogonalization passes, reconstructing solutions to measure true residuals and restarting if needed. Compare the same base, right-hand side and true-residual scale. LU preparation includes assembly and factorization; small-grid timing does not prescribe industrial-scale methods.

从三角方程得到 GS 扫描式

Derive the GS sweep from a triangular system

将预处理矩阵分成块对角 D、严格下三角 L 和严格上三角 U。一次从零开始的前向 GS 扫描就是求解 (D+L)z=r(D+L)z=r；逐行把已经求出的量移到右侧：

Split the preconditioner into block diagonal D, strict lower L and strict upper U. A forward GS sweep from zero solves (D+L)z=r(D+L)z=r. Move already known terms to the right:

Piizi+∑j<iPijzj=ri⟹zi=Pii−1(ri−∑j<iPijzj).P_{ii}z_i+\sum_{j<i}P_{ij}z_j=r_i\quad\Longrightarrow\quad z_i=P_{ii}^{-1}\left(r_i-\sum_{j<i}P_{ij}z_j\right).

对伴随使用这个线性作用的精确转置：先转置三角系统，再从后往前解。它不等于“仍然从前往后扫一遍，只把名称改成 adjoint”。

For the adjoint use the exact transpose of this linear action: transpose the triangular system and solve backward.

(D+L)⊤z=r⟹zi=Pii−⊤(ri−∑j>iPji⊤zj).(D+L)^{\top}z=r\quad\Longrightarrow\quad z_i=P_{ii}^{-\top}\left(r_i-\sum_{j>i}P_{ji}^{\top}z_j\right).

从固定点误差到 GMRES 的最小二乘

From fixed-point error to GMRES least squares

ek+1=xk+1−x∗=(I−ωBKK)ek,Kx∗=b.e^{k+1}=x^{k+1}-x_*=(I-\omega B_KK)e^k,\quad Kx_*=b.

误差传播矩阵决定固定点是否收敛。GMRES 则在逐步扩大的子空间里选择使残差最小的修正。令当前残差 r0=b−Kx0r_0=b-Kx_0，从 v1=r0/∥r0∥\mathbf v_1=r_0/\|r_0\| 开始反复作用 KBKKB_K 并正交化，得到 Arnoldi 关系：

The error-propagation matrix controls stationary convergence. GMRES instead chooses a residual-minimizing correction in an expanding subspace. Set r0=b−Kx0r_0=b-Kx_0, start with v1=r0/∥r0∥\mathbf v_1=r_0/\|r_0\|, and repeatedly apply and orthogonalize KBKKB_K:

KBKVm=Vm+1H‾m,xm=x0+BKVmy,KB_K\mathbf V_m=\mathbf V_{m+1}\overline H_m,\quad x_m=x_0+B_K\mathbf V_my,
b−Kxm=r0−KBKVmy=Vm+1(∥r0∥e1−H‾my).b-Kx_m=r_0-KB_K\mathbf V_my=\mathbf V_{m+1}(\|r_0\|e_1-\overline H_my).

由于 Vm+1\mathbf V_{m+1} 的列正交归一，上式的二范数等于小向量的二范数，最终只需解一个小规模最小二乘问题。若 x0≠0x_0\ne0，修正公式里不能漏掉它；本页每次 GMRES 修正从零初值开始，再加回外层解。

Because the columns of Vm+1\mathbf V_{m+1} are orthonormal, its residual norm equals the norm of the small vector, leaving a small least-squares problem. Retain x0x_0 for nonzero starts; this implementation solves zero-start corrections and adds them to the outer iterate.

图 16.3Figure 16.3

工程规模：分层预处理与离线计算

Engineering scale: hierarchical preconditioning and offline computation

GS 用于展示一次三角修正。网格加密后，黏性耦合与重构邻域会使它的收敛变慢，甚至在给定预算内停滞。本页默认求解采用右预处理 FGMRES；GS 和 GS–GMRES 是同一系统上的教学对照。

GS illustrates a triangular correction. On refined meshes, viscous coupling and reconstruction stencils can make it slow or cause stagnation within the available budget. The default solver is right-preconditioned FGMRES; GS and GS–GMRES serve as comparisons on the same system.

预处理结构参照 OVERU 的 hierarchical 分支：外层精确算子，内层可选 Richardson 修正、重叠子域的限制型 ASM、局部 ILU(k)。这里是独立的串行教学实现；不调用 OVERU 或 PETSc，也不含 MPI、湍流和多重网格。

The hierarchy follows OVERU’s hierarchical branch: an exact outer operator, optional Richardson corrections, restricted overlapping ASM and local ILU(k). This is an independent serial teaching implementation, without OVERU/PETSc bindings, MPI, turbulence or multigrid.

K=Ah or Ah⊤,P0=Rh,U(1)+αPdiag⁡(V),P=P0 or P0⊤.K=A_h\ \text{or}\ A_h^{\top},\qquad P_0=R_{h,U}^{(1)}+\alpha_{\rm P}\operatorname{diag}(V),\qquad P=P_0\ \text{or}\ P_0^{\top}.

一阶近似只降低对流重构；本页黏性重构、物性和实际边界求导仍保留。默认 αP=0\alpha_{\rm P}=0。离线程序可用 αPdiag⁡(V)\alpha_{\rm P}\operatorname{diag}(V) 增强对角，其中 VV 为控制体体积重复到四个分量，强边界约束行取零。它仅加入预处理矩阵，不能加到最终检验的精确 KK 中。

The approximation lowers convection reconstruction only; viscous reconstruction, transport and actual boundary derivatives remain. The default is αP=0\alpha_{\rm P}=0. Offline, αPdiag⁡(V)\alpha_{\rm P}\operatorname{diag}(V) can strengthen the diagonal, using repeated control-volume weights and zero weight for strong constraints. This term belongs only to the preconditioner, never to the exact KK used for the final residual.

Ps=RsPRs⊤,Ps≈LsUs,Br=∑sR~s⊤Us−1Ls−1Rsr.P_s=R_sPR_s^{\top},\quad P_s\approx L_sU_s,\quad B r=\sum_s\widetilde R_s^{\top} U_s^{-1}L_s^{-1}R_s r.

RsR_s 读取子域及重叠区，R~s⊤\widetilde R_s^{\top} 只把该子域拥有的自由度写回。这样每个全局未知量只接受一次子域修正。四个守恒量始终一起分区。ILU(0) 不增加原矩阵之外的非零位置；ILU(1) 保留一级消元填充。更多填充和重叠会增加内存与准备时间，不能只比较迭代次数。

RsR_s reads a subdomain including overlap; R~s⊤\widetilde R_s^{\top} scatters only owned degrees of freedom. Each global unknown receives one subdomain correction. All four conserved components stay together. ILU(0) preserves the original sparsity; ILU(1) permits level-one elimination fill. More overlap and fill cost memory and setup time; iteration counts alone are insufficient.

z(0)=0,z(ℓ+1)=z(ℓ)+ωB(r−Pz(ℓ)).z^{(0)}=0,\qquad z^{(\ell+1)}=z^{(\ell)}+\omega B\bigl(r-Pz^{(\ell)}\bigr).

内层全局 Richardson 始终用近似 PP 计算内层残差；外层 FGMRES 用精确 KK。局部也可在 PsP_s 上重复修正。默认一个全局、一个局部修正、一级重叠、ILU(1)，不把“增加内迭代”当作必然更好的选择。FGMRES 保存每次实际得到的 zjz_j，适合以后引入可变内层求解。

Global inner Richardson uses approximate PP for its residual, while outer FGMRES uses exact KK. Local corrections may likewise repeat on PsP_s. Defaults are one global and one local application, one overlap layer and ILU(1). More inner iterations are not automatically better. FGMRES stores each actual zjz_j, allowing future variable inner solves.

zj=Cj(vj),wj=Kzj,xm=x0+∑j=1myjzj,rm=b−Kxm.z_j=\mathcal C_j(\mathbf v_j),\quad w_j=Kz_j,\quad x_m=x_0+\sum_{j=1}^{m}y_jz_j,\quad r_m=b-Kx_m.

伴随路径先转置近似矩阵，再建立子域和 ILU。限制型 ASM 对 P⊤P^{\top} 的作用一般不等于对 PP 所建预处理作用的精确转置；这不影响外层精确伴随方程。不能因此把两种预处理误称为严格点积对偶。小主元保护会计入 shifted_pivots；求解仍必须通过真实残差检查。

The adjoint path transposes the approximate matrix before building subdomains and ILU. Restricted ASM built for P⊤P^{\top} is generally not the transpose of the preconditioner built for PP. This does not change the exact outer adjoint equation, but the two PC applications must not be called exact dot-product duals. Small-pivot protection is counted in shifted_pivots; the true residual remains the acceptance criterion.

P0 = first_order_jacobian(U) + alpha_P * volume_weights
P = transpose(P0) if adjoint else P0
PC = Richardson(restricted_ASM(local_ILU(P)))
for each Arnoldi step:
    z[j] = PC(basis[j])
    w = exact_JVP(z[j]) or exact_VJP(z[j])
    orthogonalize_twice(w)
x = x0 + Z @ y
accept only if norm(b - exact_operator(x)) meets tolerance

浏览器的边界：每次计算最多 2 秒

Browser boundary: at most 2 seconds per computation

网页用于小网格演示。耗时求解在 Worker 内运行，每次操作的全部子步骤共享 2 秒总预算；超时终止，不将未完成计算作为收敛结果。默认小网格先加载已经核验的基准，逐面运算仍可交互。加密曲线可以浏览随页的已保存结果，不要求在浏览器重算。不同机器速度不同，因此实际超时也会触发停止。

The browser is for small-grid demonstrations. Expensive solves run in a Worker with a shared two-second wall-clock budget for the entire operation. Timeout terminates computation and is not accepted as convergence. Verified small-grid baselines load first; face-by-face operations remain interactive. Saved refinement curves can be inspected without recomputation. A slower machine can also trigger the cutoff.

The download covers fixed-polygon smooth MMS and physical wall flow: cell/node, both orders and transport laws, isothermal/adiabatic walls, temperature/force/heat objectives, primal/tangent/adjoint, six physical parameter gradients and frozen-topology coordinate derivatives. Python generates refined meshes and assembles sparse Jacobians by coloured complex-step differentiation. It does not invoke Node.js and is not matrix-free. Selected mesh deformations, sparse coordinate Jacobians and deformed-mesh FD are supported. 第 17 节Section 17

总结

Summary

按“存储 → 重构 → 通量 → 装配 → 求导 → 求解 → 验证”复述一次完整计算。

Explain the full sequence: storage → reconstruction → flux → assembly → differentiation → solve → verify.

从二维标量到二维 N–S，面装配仍是“左加右减”，但单个通量背后已包含四个守恒量、多点重构、应力张量、导热、无滑移或自然牵引边界。精确离散伴随必须反转整条计算链，而不是只转置无粘通量。

From the scalar equation to 2D N–S, face assembly remains add-left/subtract-right, but each flux includes four states, multipoint reconstruction, stress, heat and no-slip or natural-traction boundaries. An exact discrete adjoint reverses the entire chain, not only inviscid fluxes.

对流部分与二维 Euler 页同为 Rusanov（局部 Lax–Friedrichs）型通量，黏性应力与导热沿用一维 N–S 页的物理模型。耗散速度在二维 Euler 页取常数 2，本页取常数 3，一维 N–S 页取两侧平均 ½(u⁻+u⁺+c⁻+c⁺)，原因见第 2 节。

The convective part is the same Rusanov (local Lax–Friedrichs) type flux as on the 2D Euler page, and viscous stress and heat conduction follow the physical model of the 1D N–S page. The dissipation speed is the constant 2 on the 2D Euler page, the constant 3 here and the two-sided average ½(u⁻+u⁺+c⁻+c⁺) on the 1D N–S page; Section 2 explains why.

Rh=0 ⟶ AhU˙h=−Rh,ad ⟶ Ah⊤ψh=−jU ⟶ g=ja+Rh,a⊤ψh.R_h=0\ \longrightarrow\ A_h\dot{\mathbf U}_h=-R_{h,a}d\ \longrightarrow\ A_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_U\ \longrightarrow\ g=j_a+R_{h,a}^{\top}\psi_h.

当前范围是小型固定拓扑、无 limiter、无激波的层流教学系统。它展示通向二维非结构 RANS 所需的几何、黏性和边界求导；湍流模型及其边界、网格变形映射、并行分区和大规模稀疏求解仍是后续内容。判断正确性时，应同时看数学定义、实际执行、局部验证与全链路验证。

The current scope is a small fixed-topology, unlimited, shock-free laminar teaching system. It demonstrates geometry, viscous and boundary derivatives needed on the path to 2D unstructured RANS. Turbulence and its boundaries, mesh-motion maps, parallel partitioning and large sparse solves remain future work. Judge definitions, actual execution, local checks and full-chain checks together.

建议按一条完整计算链复习

Review one complete computation chain

先在网格上选一个面，说清左右存储量、求积点与法向；再用该面检查对流、应力与热流的符号。随后播放残差、前向与反向，核对邻域贡献为什么需要累加。最后选择一个物理参数或坐标，比较 tangent、adjoint、不同步长差分及复数步长。做到这些后，再看加密图判断空间精度；两种判断回答的是不同问题。

Select a face and identify stored states, quadrature points and normals. Check signs of convection, stress and heat. Replay primal, tangent and reverse assembly and explain why stencil contributions accumulate. Choose one physical parameter or coordinate and compare tangent, adjoint, finite-difference steps and complex step. Then use refinement to assess spatial accuracy: it answers a different question.

Start with a fixed piecewise-smooth domain Ω\Omega and an outward-from-fluid normal n, which points into the solid on the inner wall. The symbol δij\delta_{ij} is the Kronecker delta, whereas δW\delta W denotes a variation. The factor 2/32/3 retains the three-dimensional Newtonian constitutive law for plane motion. Energy flux is convection minus viscous work plus heat; substituting q=−κ∇Tq=-\kappa\nabla T gives a negative conduction term. The implemented local derivatives keep manufactured forcing at its baseline, and added heating depends only on position and parameters, so SW=0S_W=0 here. Keep a general SWS_W in the derivation to expose its sign.

The last row has two viscous-work paths: velocity variation times existing stress, and existing velocity times stress variation. Omitting either changes the adjoint. A.3 Objectives and the multiplier sign convention

Reversing the normal or force convention also reverses the associated objective and adjoint boundary signs.

只有绕流模式的内圈是固壁。制造解模式仍可在内圈积分同样的力／热流表达式，但那里施加的是入流或牵引数据；不能套用下面的固壁伴随条件。对这一情况，应把 δg\delta g 保留在通用边界式中，再按实际边界代入。

Only the physical-flow mode has an inner solid wall. MMS can integrate the same force/heat expression on its inner boundary, but that boundary has inflow or traction data. Do not apply solid-wall adjoint conditions there: retain δg\delta g in the general boundary form and substitute the actual conditions.

λ=(α,β1,β2,χ)⊤,L=Jc+∫Ωλ⊤R dΩ.\lambda=(\alpha,\beta_1,\beta_2,\chi)^{\top},\qquad\mathscr L=J^{\rm c}+\int_\Omega\lambda^{\top}\mathcal R\,d\Omega.

采用加号后，体内伴随满足“目标导数 + 残差算子的转置作用 = 0”，与正文 Ah⊤ψh=−jUA_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_U 的符号一致。但连续算子里的空间分部积分不是离散矩阵转置。对温度跟踪，原始变量目标导数只有 fT=T−Tdf_T=T-T_d 非零；换成守恒变量则：

With the plus sign, the interior equation is objective derivative plus adjoint residual action equal to zero, matching the sign of Ah⊤ψh=−jUA_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_U. Spatial integration by parts is nevertheless distinct from a discrete transpose. For tracking, only fT=T−Tdf_T=T-T_d is nonzero in primitive variables. In conservative variables:

fU⊤=(T−Td)[(K−cvT)/(ρcv)−u1/(ρcv)−u2/(ρcv)1/(ρcv)].f_U^{\top}=(T-T_d)\begin{bmatrix}(K-c_vT)/(\rho c_v)\\-u_1/(\rho c_v)\\-u_2/(\rho c_v)\\1/(\rho c_v)\end{bmatrix}.

A.4 守恒变量的线性算子与两次分部积分

A.4 Conservative linearization and two integrations by parts

Cj=∂Fj∂U∣∇U,a,Djk=∂Fj∂(∂kU)∣U,a,LδU=∂j(CjδU+Djk∂kδU)−SUδU.C_j=\left.\frac{\partial F_j}{\partial U}\right|_{\nabla U,a},\qquad D_{jk}=\left.\frac{\partial F_j}{\partial(\partial_kU)}\right|_{U,a},\qquad\mathcal L\delta U=\partial_j(C_j\delta U+D_{jk}\partial_k\delta U)-S_U\delta U.

每个 Cj,DjkC_j,D_{jk} 都是 4×44\times4 矩阵。CjC_j 已包含黏性通量对状态的依赖，包括物性和守恒量到原始量梯度的转换，不能只拿 Euler 通量 Jacobian 代替。DjkD_{jk} 是总通量“对流减黏性”的梯度导数，已包含相应负号。

Each Cj,DjkC_j,D_{jk} is a 4×44\times4 matrix. CjC_j includes viscous state dependence, transport, and conversion of conservative gradients to primitive gradients; an Euler flux Jacobian alone is insufficient. DjkD_{jk} differentiates the total convection-minus-viscosity flux and already carries its signs.

∫Ωλ⊤∂jδFj dΩ=∫∂Ωλ⊤njδFj ds−∫Ω(∂jλ)⊤δFj dΩ.\int_\Omega\lambda^{\top}\partial_j\delta F_j\,d\Omega=\int_{\partial\Omega}\lambda^{\top}n_j\delta F_j\,ds-\int_\Omega(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}\delta F_j\,d\Omega.
−∫Ω(∂jλ)⊤Djk∂kδU dΩ=−∫∂Ω(∂jλ)⊤DjknkδU ds+∫Ω∂k(Djk⊤∂jλ)⊤δU dΩ.-\int_\Omega(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}D_{jk}\partial_k\delta U\,d\Omega=-\int_{\partial\Omega}(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}D_{jk}n_k\delta U\,ds+\int_\Omega\partial_k(D_{jk}^{\top}\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}\delta U\,d\Omega.
δWL=∫Ω[fU⊤−Cj⊤∂jλ+∂k(Djk⊤∂jλ)−SU⊤λ]⊤δU dΩ+B+δJ∂Ω,\delta_W\mathscr L=\int_\Omega\left[f_U^{\top}-C_j^{\top}\partial_j\lambda+\partial_k(D_{jk}^{\top}\partial_j\lambda)-S_U^{\top}\lambda\right]^{\top}\delta U\,d\Omega+\mathcal B+\delta J_{\partial\Omega},
B=∫∂Ω[λ⊤δFn−(∂jλ)⊤DjknkδU]ds.\mathcal B=\int_{\partial\Omega}\left[\lambda^{\top}\delta F_n-(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}D_{jk}n_k\delta U\right]ds.

内部扰动可以任意取，因此方括号必须为零。这给出二维连续伴随的紧凑形式。系数依赖基态和空间，故必须保留 ∂k(Djk⊤∂jλ)\partial_k(D_{jk}^{\top}\partial_j\lambda) 的乘积导数；把它直接写成常系数二阶导数会遗漏项。下面进一步展开，使读者无需先构造四个黏性矩阵。

Interior variations are arbitrary, so the bracket must vanish. This is the compact two-dimensional adjoint. Coefficients depend on the base field and position: retain the product derivative ∂k(Djk⊤∂jλ)\partial_k(D_{jk}^{\top}\partial_j\lambda). Replacing it by a constant-coefficient second derivative loses terms. We next expand the equation without requiring the reader to construct all viscous matrices first.

A.5 用原始变量收集系数：伴随应力的来源

A.5 Collect primitive-variable coefficients: the adjoint stress

第一次分部积分后，体积分中与通量有关的项是 −(∂jλ)⊤δFj-(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}\delta F_j。把 A.2 逐项代入。与应力变化相乘的系数，以及与温度梯度变化相乘的系数分别为：

After the first integration by parts, the flux term is −(∂jλ)⊤δFj-(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}\delta F_j. Substitute A.2 term by term. The weights of stress variation and temperature-gradient variation are:

aj=∂jα,Bij=∂jβi,cj=∂jχ,Qij=Bij+uicj,Zij=μ(Qij+Qji−23Qkkδij).a_j=\partial_j\alpha,\quad B_{ij}=\partial_j\beta_i,\quad c_j=\partial_j\chi,\quad Q_{ij}=B_{ij}+u_i c_j,\quad Z_{ij}=\mu\left(Q_{ij}+Q_{ji}-\tfrac23Q_{kk}\delta_{ij}\right).
Qijδτij=Zij∂jδui+μTQijsijδT,−cjδqj=κcj∂jδT+κTcj(∂jT)δT.Q_{ij}\delta\tau_{ij}=Z_{ij}\partial_j\delta u_i+\mu_TQ_{ij}s_{ij}\delta T,\qquad-c_j\delta q_j=\kappa c_j\partial_j\delta T+\kappa_Tc_j(\partial_jT)\delta T.

例如 Qij∂iδujQ_{ij}\partial_i\delta u_j 交换求和下标后成为 Qji∂jδuiQ_{ji}\partial_j\delta u_i，所以出现 Q+Q⊤Q+Q^{\top}；迹项给出 −23tr⁡(Q)I-\tfrac23\operatorname{tr}(Q)I。ZZ 是这次分部积分产生的系数张量，不是原流场的应力。它还包含 ui∂jχu_i\partial_j\chi，这正是黏性功的反向耦合。二维分量为：

For example, swapping summed indices changes Qij∂iδujQ_{ij}\partial_i\delta u_j into Qji∂jδuiQ_{ji}\partial_j\delta u_i, producing Q+Q⊤Q+Q^{\top}. The trace term supplies −23tr⁡(Q)I-\tfrac23\operatorname{tr}(Q)I. Z is an integration-by-parts coefficient tensor, not the primal stress. Its ui∂jχu_i\partial_j\chi term is the reverse coupling from viscous work. In two dimensions:

Z11=μ(43Q11−23Q22),Z22=μ(43Q22−23Q11),Z12=Z21=μ(Q12+Q21).Z_{11}=\mu(\tfrac43Q_{11}-\tfrac23Q_{22}),\quad Z_{22}=\mu(\tfrac43Q_{22}-\tfrac23Q_{11}),\quad Z_{12}=Z_{21}=\mu(Q_{12}+Q_{21}).
∫ΩZij∂jδui=∫∂ΩZijnjδui−∫Ω(∂jZij)δui,\int_\Omega Z_{ij}\partial_j\delta u_i=\int_{\partial\Omega}Z_{ij}n_j\delta u_i-\int_\Omega(\partial_jZ_{ij})\delta u_i,
∫Ωκcj∂jδT=∫∂Ωκ∂nχ δT−∫Ω∂j(κ∂jχ)δT.\int_\Omega\kappa c_j\partial_j\delta T=\int_{\partial\Omega}\kappa\partial_n\chi\,\delta T-\int_\Omega\partial_j(\kappa\partial_j\chi)\delta T.

A.6 The four expanded two-dimensional adjoint equations

记 rz=fz−λ⊤Szr_z=f_z-\lambda^{\top}S_z，其中 zz 是一个原始变量。收集 δρ,δu1,δu2,δT\delta\rho,\delta u_1,\delta u_2,\delta T 的系数，分别置零。密度方程是：

Write rz=fz−λ⊤Szr_z=f_z-\lambda^{\top}S_z for a primitive variable z. Collect and set to zero the coefficients of δρ,δu1,δu2,δT\delta\rho,\delta u_1,\delta u_2,\delta T. The density equation is:

Eρ=rρ−uj∂jα−uiuj∂jβi−T∂iβi−Huj∂jχ=0.\mathcal E_\rho=r_\rho-u_j\partial_j\alpha-u_i u_j\partial_j\beta_i-T\partial_i\beta_i-Hu_j\partial_j\chi=0.

对每个速度分量 i=1,2i=1,2，得到两个方程：

Eui=rui−ρ∂iα−ρuj∂jβi−ρuk∂iβk−ρH∂iχ−ρuiuj∂jχ+τij∂jχ−∂jZij=0.\begin{aligned}\mathcal E_{u_i}={}&r_{u_i}-\rho\partial_i\alpha-\rho u_j\partial_j\beta_i-\rho u_k\partial_i\beta_k\\&-\rho H\partial_i\chi-\rho u_i u_j\partial_j\chi+\tau_{ij}\partial_j\chi-\partial_jZ_{ij}=0.\end{aligned}

温度方程为：

The temperature equation is:

ET=rT−ρ∂iβi−ρcpuj∂jχ+μTQijsij+κT∂jT∂jχ−∂j(κ∂jχ)=0.\mathcal E_T=r_T-\rho\partial_i\beta_i-\rho c_pu_j\partial_j\chi+\mu_TQ_{ij}s_{ij}+\kappa_T\partial_jT\partial_j\chi-\partial_j(\kappa\partial_j\chi)=0.

式中 Q:s=Q11s11+Q12s12+Q21s21+Q22s22Q:s=Q_{11}s_{11}+Q_{12}s_{12}+Q_{21}s_{21}+Q_{22}s_{22}，两个剪切位置都要计入。若 κ\kappa 只随 TT 变化且参数空间均匀，导热的后两项恰好合成 −κΔχ-\kappa\Delta\chi；这不是允许在其他项中冻结变物性。黏度导数项 μTQ:s\mu_TQ:s 仍保留，∂jZij\partial_jZ_{ij} 也仍须对 μ(T)\mu(T) 求空间导数。

The contraction Q:s=Q11s11+Q12s12+Q21s21+Q22s22Q:s=Q_{11}s_{11}+Q_{12}s_{12}+Q_{21}s_{21}+Q_{22}s_{22} includes both shear positions. If conductivity depends only on T and parameters are spatially uniform, its last two terms combine to −κΔχ-\kappa\Delta\chi. This cancellation does not permit freezing transport elsewhere: μTQ:s\mu_TQ:s remains, and ∂jZij\partial_jZ_{ij} still differentiates μ(T)\mu(T) in space.

κT∇T⋅∇χ−∇⋅(κ∇χ)=−κΔχ(κ=κ(T)).\kappa_T\nabla T\cdot\nabla\chi-\nabla\cdot(\kappa\nabla\chi)=-\kappa\Delta\chi\quad(\kappa=\kappa(T)).

这四个方程仍以守恒残差的乘子 λ=(α,β1,β2,χ)\lambda=(\alpha,\beta_1,\beta_2,\chi) 为未知，只是用原始变量扰动收集系数。不是把乘子偷偷换成另一套变量。令 UW=∂U/∂WU_W=\partial U/\partial W，则展开系数 EW=UW⊤EU\mathcal E_W=U_W^{\top}\mathcal E_U；ρ,T>0\rho,T>0 下 UWU_W 可逆，两种形式等价：

The unknowns are still the conservative-residual multipliers λ=(α,β1,β2,χ)\lambda=(\alpha,\beta_1,\beta_2,\chi); only the variation coordinates changed. With UW=∂U/∂WU_W=\partial U/\partial W, the expanded coefficients satisfy EW=UW⊤EU\mathcal E_W=U_W^{\top}\mathcal E_U. The invertible change of variables makes both forms equivalent:

UW=[1000u1ρ00u20ρ0Eρu1ρu2ρcv],det⁡UW=ρ3cv>0.U_W=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&0&0\\u_1&\rho&0&0\\u_2&0&\rho&0\\E&\rho u_1&\rho u_2&\rho c_v\end{bmatrix},\qquad\det U_W=\rho^3c_v>0.

密度对应方程没有独立的二阶扩散项，不能给四个伴随分量一律施加同一种 Dirichlet 条件。黏性并没有把可压缩 N–S 变成四个独立的 Poisson 方程。

The density equation has no independent second-order diffusion term. One cannot impose the same Dirichlet condition on all four adjoint components. Viscosity does not turn compressible N–S into four independent Poisson equations.

A.7 一个通用边界式，决定全部伴随边界条件

A.7 One boundary form determines the adjoint conditions

Fn=[ρunρu1un+t1ρu2un+t2ρEun+uiti+qn],un=ujnj,A=α+βiui+χE.F_n=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\\rho u_1u_n+t_1\\\rho u_2u_n+t_2\\\rho E u_n+u_it_i+q_n\end{bmatrix},\quad u_n=u_jn_j,\quad A=\alpha+\beta_i u_i+\chi E.

固定几何，先把法向总通量改写为边界数据 t,qnt,q_n 的形式，再求变化。定义 b\mathfrak b 为不含目标变化的边界密度，则：

At fixed geometry, rewrite the normal total flux in terms of boundary data t,qnt,q_n before varying it. Let b\mathfrak b denote the boundary density excluding the objective variation:

b=unA δρ+[ρAn+ρun(β+χu)+χt+Zn]⋅δu+[ρcvunχ+κ∂nχ]δT+(β+χu)⋅δt+χδqn.\begin{aligned}\mathfrak b={}&u_nA\,\delta\rho+\left[\rho A n+\rho u_n(\beta+\chi u)+\chi t+Zn\right]\cdot\delta u\\&+\left[\rho c_vu_n\chi+\kappa\partial_n\chi\right]\delta T+(\beta+\chi u)\cdot\delta t+\chi\delta q_n.\end{aligned}
δWL=∫ΩEW⊤δW dΩ+∫∂Ωb ds+∫Γwδg ds.\delta_W\mathscr L=\int_\Omega\mathcal E_W^{\top}\delta W\,d\Omega+\int_{\partial\Omega}\mathfrak b\,ds+\int_{\Gamma_w}\delta g\,ds.

该式是 A.4 边界项的原始变量展开。边界上的 δW,δt,δqn\delta W,\delta t,\delta q_n 不能全部视为互相独立，更不能全部设零；它们必须满足原边界条件的线性化。正确做法是先代入已知为零的变化，再对剩余自由变化令系数消失。边界有目标时，还要先加上 δg\delta g。

This is A.4's boundary term expanded in primitive variables. Boundary variations δW,δt,δqn\delta W,\delta t,\delta q_n are neither all independent nor all zero: they satisfy the linearized primal boundary conditions. Substitute prescribed variations first, then cancel coefficients of the remaining free variations. Include δg\delta g before doing this on an objective boundary.

A.8 入口与总牵引出口

A.8 Inflow and total-traction outflow

入口给定 ρ,u1,u2,T\rho,u_1,u_2,T，固定参数时 δW=0\delta W=0。法向速度梯度、温度梯度仍可改变，所以 δt\delta t 与 δqn\delta q_n 可以非零。若入口没有边界目标，则边界式化为 (β+χu)⋅δt+χδqn(\beta+\chi u)\cdot\delta t+\chi\delta q_n，从而：

Inflow prescribes ρ,u1,u2,T\rho,u_1,u_2,T, so δW=0\delta W=0 at fixed parameters. Normal velocity and temperature gradients may still change, making δt\delta t and δqn\delta q_n nonzero. Without an inlet objective, the boundary form reduces to (β+χu)⋅δt+χδqn(\beta+\chi u)\cdot\delta t+\chi\delta q_n, hence:

Γin:χ=0,β1=β2=0.\Gamma_{\rm in}:\qquad\chi=0,\quad\beta_1=\beta_2=0.

入口不另加 α\alpha 的边界值。

No additional inlet value is imposed for α\alpha.

总牵引出口固定 t=tb,qn=qbt=t_b,q_n=q_b，所以 δt=0,δqn=0\delta t=0,\delta q_n=0，而 δρ,δu,δT\delta\rho,\delta u,\delta T 的边界迹是自由的。无出口目标且 un>0u_n>0 时：

At a total-traction outlet, fixed t=tb,qn=qbt=t_b,q_n=q_b gives δt=0,δqn=0\delta t=0,\delta q_n=0, leaving the boundary traces of δρ,δu,δT\delta\rho,\delta u,\delta T free. With no outlet objective and un>0u_n>0:

A=0,Zn+ρun(β+χu)+χtb=0,κ∂nχ+ρcvunχ=0.A=0,\qquad Zn+\rho u_n(\beta+\chi u)+\chi t_b=0,\qquad\kappa\partial_n\chi+\rho c_vu_n\chi=0.

第一个条件等价于 α=−β⋅u−χE\alpha=-\beta\cdot u-\chi E；第二个是两个耦合的导数条件；第三个是能量伴随的 Robin 条件。它们来自本页“总牵引 + 热流”出口，不能换成“给定压力”出口的伴随条件。若 un=0u_n=0，未约简的条件只有 unA=0u_nA=0，不能除以 unu_n；若发生回流，还必须重新分析原边界问题的信息数和稳定性。当前推导不为这两类退化情形作适定性保证。

The first condition gives α=−β⋅u−χE\alpha=-\beta\cdot u-\chi E; the second is a pair of coupled derivative conditions, and the third is a Robin condition for the energy multiplier. These belong to the implemented total-traction-plus-heat outlet, not a prescribed-pressure outlet. If un=0u_n=0, retain the unreduced unA=0u_nA=0 rather than dividing. Backflow requires a fresh analysis of the primal boundary problem and stability. No well-posedness claim is made for either degeneracy.

A.9 静止壁面：目标函数改变伴随边界值

A.9 Stationary walls: the objective changes adjoint boundary values

静止无滑移壁面有 u=0,δu=0,un=0u=0,\delta u=0,u_n=0，所以即使 δρ\delta\rho 自由，它在边界式中的系数仍为零。力／热流目标变化为 δg=d⋅δt+ζδqn\delta g=d\cdot\delta t+\zeta\delta q_n（此处 d,ζd,\zeta 固定）。代入后只剩：

At a stationary no-slip wall, u=0,δu=0,un=0u=0,\delta u=0,u_n=0. Density may vary but its boundary coefficient vanishes. With fixed dd and ζ\zeta, δg=d⋅δt+ζδqn\delta g=d\cdot\delta t+\zeta\delta q_n. The remaining form is:

b+δg=(β+d)⋅δt+(χ+ζ)δqn+κ∂nχ δT.\mathfrak b+\delta g=(\beta+d)\cdot\delta t+(\chi+\zeta)\delta q_n+\kappa\partial_n\chi\,\delta T.

等温壁固定 T=TwT=T_w，因此 δT=0\delta T=0，热流可以变化。绝热壁固定 qn=0q_n=0，因此 δqn=0\delta q_n=0，温度可以变化。分别消去自由项，得到：

An isothermal wall fixes T=TwT=T_w, giving δT=0\delta T=0 while heat may vary. An adiabatic wall fixes qn=0q_n=0, giving δqn=0\delta q_n=0 while temperature may vary. Cancel the respective free terms:

Γiso:β=−d,χ=−ζ;Γad:β=−d,∂nχ=0.\Gamma_{\rm iso}:\quad\beta=-d,\quad\chi=-\zeta;\qquad\Gamma_{\rm ad}:\quad\beta=-d,\quad\partial_n\chi=0.

这些壁面都不另外指定 α\alpha。绝热热流目标恒为零，在唯一可解的齐次伴随问题中可以取 λ=0\lambda=0；但若把规定热流本身作为参数，允许 δqb≠0\delta q_b\ne0，就不再是同一个“固定绝热”方向。制造解内圈若有力目标，在入口应改成 β=−d,χ=0\beta=-d,\chi=0；热流目标应改成 χ=−ζ,β=−χu\chi=-\zeta,\beta=-\chi u。在固定牵引／热流出口，这两个目标的状态变化为零，但它们仍可有显式参数导数。

No additional alpha condition is imposed at either wall. For a fixed adiabatic heat objective, J is identically zero; the unique homogeneous adjoint, when it exists, is zero. Varying prescribed heat itself with δqb≠0\delta q_b\ne0 is a different design direction. If the MMS inner inlet carries a force objective, use β=−d,χ=0\beta=-d,\chi=0; for heat use χ=−ζ,β=−χu\chi=-\zeta,\beta=-\chi u. At a fixed-traction/fixed-heat outlet these objectives have zero state variation, but may still have explicit parameter derivatives.

A.10 固定域上的参数梯度

A.10 Parameter gradients on a fixed domain

连续伴随消掉未知流场响应后，仍要保留通量、源项、目标和边界数据对参数的显式依赖。先令边界数据与参数无关，并以 Fj,aF_{j,a} 表示固定 W,∇WW,\nabla W 的偏导：

After eliminating the unknown state response, retain explicit parameter dependence of flux, source, objective and boundary data. First suppose boundary data are parameter independent, and let Fj,aF_{j,a} denote a partial derivative at fixed W,∇WW,\nabla W:

δJ^c=∫Ω[faδa−(∂jλ)⊤Fj,aδa−λ⊤Saδa]dΩ+∫∂Ωλ⊤Fn,aδa ds+∫Γwgaδa ds.\delta\widehat J^{\rm c}=\int_\Omega\left[f_a\delta a-(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}F_{j,a}\delta a-\lambda^{\top}S_a\delta a\right]d\Omega+\int_{\partial\Omega}\lambda^{\top}F_{n,a}\delta a\,ds+\int_{\Gamma_w}g_a\delta a\,ds.

这是从尚未代入参数边界变化的 Lagrangian 得到的通式。若原边界算子也依赖物性或规定数据，δW\delta W 的边界变化不再齐次，还必须加回 A.7 对该非齐次变化产生的边界项。下面用总的 δt,δqn\delta t,\delta q_n 消去自由变化，能避免把物性边界项算两次。对空间均匀的物性参数，体积分中的显式输运部分是：

This general formula precedes parameter-dependent boundary substitution. If a primal boundary operator depends on transport or prescribed data, boundary state variations become inhomogeneous and their A.7 contributions must be included. Using total δt,δqn\delta t,\delta q_n to eliminate free variations avoids counting transport boundary terms twice. For spatially uniform transport parameters the explicit volume contribution is:

∫Ω[μa Q:s+κa∇χ⋅∇T−λ⊤Sa+fa]δa dΩ.\int_\Omega\left[\mu_a\,Q:s+\kappa_a\nabla\chi\cdot\nabla T-\lambda^{\top}S_a+f_a\right]\delta a\,d\Omega.
μμref=μ/μref,κμref=κ/μref,μPr=0,κPr=−κ/Pr.\mu_{\mu_{\rm ref}}=\mu/\mu_{\rm ref},\quad\kappa_{\mu_{\rm ref}}=\kappa/\mu_{\rm ref},\quad\mu_{Pr}=0,\quad\kappa_{Pr}=-\kappa/Pr.

实际使用时，将这项体积分与“已代入全部边界条件”的总边界式组合，而不是再叠加一遍 λ⊤Fn,a\lambda^{\top}F_{n,a}。例如没有边界目标的入口，β=χ=0\beta=\chi=0，给定数据变化产生下列贡献；给定牵引／热流的出口也有直接贡献：

In practice combine this volume term with the total boundary form after all boundary conditions are substituted, without adding λ⊤Fn,a\lambda^{\top}F_{n,a} a second time. For example, an inlet without a boundary objective has β=χ=0\beta=\chi=0, and changes in prescribed data contribute as below; outlet traction/heat data also contribute directly:

The main text also provides coordinate derivatives. A continuum counterpart requires a specified continuous deformation, not just a mesh-node index. Let xε=x+εV(x)x_\varepsilon=x+\varepsilon V(x), KV=∇VK_V=\nabla V, and use the pulled-back material variation W˙\dot W. Chain rule, area and normal variations give:

(∇W)⋅=∇W˙−(∇W)KV,(dΩ)⋅=(∇⋅V)dΩ,(ds)⋅=(∇Γ⋅V)ds,(\nabla W)^{\boldsymbol\cdot}=\nabla\dot W-(\nabla W)K_V,\quad (d\Omega)^{\boldsymbol\cdot}=(\nabla\cdot V)d\Omega,\quad (ds)^{\boldsymbol\cdot}=(\nabla_\Gamma\cdot V)ds,
n˙=−(I−nn⊤)KV⊤n,∇Γ⋅V=tr⁡KV−n⊤KVn.\dot n=-(I-nn^{\top})K_V^{\top}n,\qquad\nabla_\Gamma\cdot V=\operatorname{tr}K_V-n^{\top}K_Vn.

A directly implementable expression, not yet reduced to a wall-normal-only shape gradient, follows from a Piola pullback. Define Fj,gF_{j,g} as the flux variation from position, parameters and gradient deformation at fixed material field, with analogous Sg,fgS_g,f_g. Its geometric state-gradient part is −(∇W)KV-(\nabla W)K_V. The pulled-back flux variation is:

Gk=(∇⋅V)Fk−(KV)kjFj+Fk,g,(det⁡Dxε Rε)˙=LWW˙+∂kGk−Sg−(∇⋅V)S.\mathcal G_k=(\nabla\cdot V)F_k-(K_V)_{kj}F_j+F_{k,g},\quad \dot{(\det D x_\varepsilon\,\mathcal R_\varepsilon)}=\mathcal L_W\dot W+\partial_k\mathcal G_k-S_g-(\nabla\cdot V)S.

在已收敛基态，拉回乘子的任意变化乘 R=0\mathcal R=0。利用已经推导的伴随消去材料状态的自由变化后，几何与显式参数贡献为：

At a converged base state, any multiplier variation multiplies R=0\mathcal R=0. Eliminating free material-state variations with the derived adjoint leaves geometry and explicit-parameter contributions:

δJ^c=∫Ω[fg+f∇⋅V−(∂kλ)⊤Gk−λ⊤(Sg+S∇⋅V)]dΩ+∫∂Ωλ⊤Gknk ds+∫Γw(gg+g∇Γ⋅V) ds+Bdata.\begin{aligned}\delta\widehat J^{\rm c}={}&\int_\Omega\left[f_g+f\nabla\cdot V-(\partial_k\lambda)^{\top}\mathcal G_k-\lambda^{\top}(S_g+S\nabla\cdot V)\right]d\Omega\\&+\int_{\partial\Omega}\lambda^{\top}\mathcal G_kn_k\,ds+\int_{\Gamma_w}(g_g+g\nabla_\Gamma\cdot V)\,ds+\mathcal B_{\rm data}.\end{aligned}

Bdata\mathcal B_{\rm data} 是非齐次材料边界变化留下的项，不能省略；ggg_g 包含法向变化。规定的空间温度在移动位置采样时有 T˙b=∇Tb⋅V\dot T_b=\nabla T_b\cdot V；材料固定壁温则 T˙w=0\dot T_w=0。若改用 Eulerian 变化 W′=W˙−∇WVW'=\dot W-\nabla W V，静止无滑移壁上为 u′=−∇uVu'=-\nabla u V，而不是 u′=0u'=0。不同约定必须整套转换。

The term Bdata\mathcal B_{\rm data} contains inhomogeneous material boundary variations and cannot be omitted; ggg_g includes normal changes. Spatially prescribed temperature sampled at a moving position has T˙b=∇Tb⋅V\dot T_b=\nabla T_b\cdot V, whereas material-fixed wall temperature has T˙w=0\dot T_w=0. With an Eulerian variation W′=W˙−∇WVW'=\dot W-\nabla W V, a stationary no-slip wall has u′=−∇uVu'=-\nabla u V, not zero. Transform the entire convention consistently.

为明确 Bdata\mathcal B_{\rm data} 的计算，把牵引／热流总材料变化拆成状态部分与固定材料场的几何部分：t˙=t(W)+tg\dot t=t^{(W)}+t_g、q˙n=qn(W)+qn,g\dot q_n=q_n^{(W)}+q_{n,g}。纯几何方向中 pg=0p_g=0，而：

To make Bdata\mathcal B_{\rm data} explicit, split total material traction/heat variations into state and fixed-field geometric parts: t˙=t(W)+tg\dot t=t^{(W)}+t_g and q˙n=qn(W)+qn,g\dot q_n=q_n^{(W)}+q_{n,g}. For a pure geometry direction, pg=0p_g=0 and:

tg=(pI−τ)n˙−τgn,qn,g=−κ(∇T)g⋅n−κ∇T⋅n˙,(∇u)g=−(∇u)KV,(∇T)g=−(∇T)KV,t_g=(pI-\tau)\dot n-\tau_g n,\quad q_{n,g}=-\kappa(\nabla T)_g\cdot n-\kappa\nabla T\cdot\dot n,\quad (\nabla u)_g=-(\nabla u)K_V,\quad(\nabla T)_g=-(\nabla T)K_V,
τg=μ[(∇u)g+(∇u)g⊤−23tr⁡((∇u)g)I].\tau_g=\mu\left[(\nabla u)_g+(\nabla u)_g^{\top}-\tfrac23\operatorname{tr}((\nabla u)_g)I\right].

于是牵引出口在 A.7 中使用 δt=t˙b−tg,δqn=q˙b−qn,g\delta t=\dot t_b-t_g,\delta q_n=\dot q_b-q_{n,g}；无出口目标时，留下 Bdata,out\mathcal B_{{\rm data,out}} 如下。不能既把总的 t˙b\dot t_b 代入，又遗漏上述几何减项。

Thus use δt=t˙b−tg\delta t=\dot t_b-t_g and δqn=q˙b−qn,g\delta q_n=\dot q_b-q_{n,g} in A.7 at a traction outlet. Without an outlet objective this leaves the contribution below. Substituting total prescribed-data changes without the geometric subtractions would be incorrect.

Bdata,out=∫Γout[(β+χu)⋅(t˙b−tg)+χ(q˙b−qn,g)]ds.\mathcal B_{{\rm data,out}}=\int_{\Gamma_{\rm out}}\left[(\beta+\chi u)\cdot(\dot t_b-t_g)+\chi(\dot q_b-q_{n,g})\right]ds.

例如本页物理出口 tb=nt_b=n，所以 t˙b=n˙\dot t_b=\dot n，并非零。固定材料温度的等温静止壁给 u˙=0,T˙=0\dot u=0,\dot T=0，状态边界项与目标的状态变化互相抵消；绝热静止壁则有 qn(W)=−qn,gq_n^{(W)}=-q_{n,g}，留下 −∫Γad(χ+ζ)qn,g ds-\int_{\Gamma_{\rm ad}}(\chi+\zeta)q_{n,g}\,ds。目标本身的 gg=d⋅tg+ζqn,gg_g=d\cdot t_g+\zeta q_{n,g} 已在上式单独计入。这说明几何法向、热流约束和目标变化必须一起处理。

For the implemented physical outlet tb=nt_b=n, one has t˙b=n˙\dot t_b=\dot n, not zero. A stationary wall with material-fixed temperature has u˙=0,T˙=0\dot u=0,\dot T=0, and its state boundary form cancels the objective state variation. An adiabatic stationary wall instead has qn(W)=−qn,gq_n^{(W)}=-q_{n,g} and leaves −∫Γad(χ+ζ)qn,g ds-\int_{\Gamma_{\rm ad}}(\chi+\zeta)q_{n,g}\,ds. The explicit objective term gg=d⋅tg+ζqn,gg_g=d\cdot t_g+\zeta q_{n,g} is already included separately above. Normal geometry, heat constraints and objective variations must therefore be treated together.

A.13 边界消项交互与适定性边界

A.13 Boundary cancellation and the limits of well-posedness claims

下方使用一个法向倾斜的边界点，代入符合原始边界条件的测试变化，再检查 b+δg\mathfrak b+\delta g。选择力或热流目标时，可比较正确的非齐次伴随条件与“全部伴随值设零”的错误选择。出口演示使用 un>0u_n>0；这里检验边界代数，不求解整个流场。

The panel below uses one oblique boundary point and test variations admissible for the primal condition, checking b+δg\mathfrak b+\delta g.
