This tests boundary algebra, not an entire flow solve.

图 A.4Figure A.4

消去形式边界项是必要步骤，但不是存在性、唯一性或稳定性的证明。还需要原始解所在函数空间、线性化算子的可逆性、足够正则的边界与兼容数据。质量方程的退化结构、出口回流、驻点、角点以及热流／应力目标的边界正则性都可能影响适定性。这里不把离散矩阵可逆或点积测试通过当成连续问题适定的证明。

Canceling the formal boundary form is necessary but does not prove existence, uniqueness or stability. Function spaces, invertibility of the linearized operator, boundary regularity and compatible data remain required. Degenerate mass diffusion, outlet backflow, stagnation, corners and boundary regularity for heat/stress objectives may affect well-posedness. An invertible discrete matrix or a successful dot test does not prove the continuum problem well posed.

Given a smooth primal base W and an explicitly defined objective:
  1. Compute mu, kappa, stress and all physical spatial gradients.
  2. Form Q, Z and the four continuous adjoint equations in A.6.
  3. Derive adjoint boundary data from A.7 for the actual primal boundary.
  4. Discretize this continuous BVP independently; solve and refine it.
  5. Evaluate parameter / geometry formulas with all boundary-data terms.
  6. Compare independently reconverged continuum differences.
The independent solver in A.14-A.15 implements these steps for the
explicitly stated smooth verification family; shape solves are separate.

A.14 真正求解二维连续伴随边值问题

A.14 Solve the two-dimensional continuous-adjoint BVP

这里求解的是 A.6 的四个连续偏微分方程及 A.8–A.9 的边界条件，而不是正文有限体积 Jacobian 的转置。区域完全沿用本页的 O 型多边形：8 个四边形与 16 个三角形，内孔保留。连续乘子 λ=(α,β1,β2,χ)⊤\lambda=(\alpha,\beta_1,\beta_2,\chi)^{\top} 同时依赖 x,yx,y，包括混合导数、剪切应力、黏性功、热传导及 Sutherland 物性的全部导数。格心页与格点页共享这个独立连续参考；连续场的未知数不是正文的单元平均值或节点值。

This solves the four continuous PDEs in A.6 and the boundary conditions in A.8–A.9, not the transpose of the main finite-volume Jacobian. It uses exactly the same O-shaped polygon: eight quadrilaterals and sixteen triangles, retaining the inner hole. All four multipliers depend on x and y, including mixed derivatives, shear, viscous work, heat conduction and all Sutherland derivatives. The cell and node pages share this independent reference; its unknowns are not the main lesson’s averages or nodal states.

为让小型教学程序独立且易于检查，用总次数不超过 ν\nu 的二维 Chebyshev 多项式逼近每个乘子。它在整个区域连续可微，因此不需要再引入跨单元的伴随数值通量。网格单元用来定义区域与求积；增加 ν\nu 增加未知系数，绘图的细分只改善着色。这里的 ν=3,5,7,9\nu=3,5,7,9 是独立连续参考的逼近次数，不是正文的一阶／二阶对流开关。

For a small, inspectable independent solver, approximate each multiplier with two-dimensional Chebyshev polynomials of total degree at most ν\nu. The approximation is differentiable throughout the domain, with no interelement adjoint numerical flux. Mesh cells define the region and quadrature; increasing ν\nu adds unknown coefficients, whereas plotting subdivision only improves colouring. The choices ν=3,5,7,9\nu=3,5,7,9 belong to this independent reference, not the main first/second-order convection switch.

λν,c(x,y)=∑k+ℓ≤νϑc,kℓTk(x/2)Tℓ(y/2),Ndof=4(ν+1)(ν+2)2.\lambda_{\nu,c}(x,y)=\sum_{k+\ell\le \nu}\vartheta_{c,k\ell}T_k(x/2)T_\ell(y/2),\qquad N_{\rm dof}=4\frac{(\nu+1)(\nu+2)}2.

程序存储每个局部量的六个数：值、两个一阶导数、三个二阶导数。乘积法则直接给出导数，既不对空间导数取有限差分，也不调用正文的自动微分残差。把基函数逐一代入展开方程，就得到矩形矩阵 AΩ\mathbb A_\Omega；逐一代入入口、牵引出口或壁面条件，得到 AΓ\mathbb A_\Gamma。例如等温壁施加三个伴随值，绝热壁施加两个动量乘子和一个热学法向导数，不能给 α\alpha 任意追加壁值。

Every local quantity carries six numbers: its value, two first derivatives and three second derivatives. Product rules propagate these directly, without spatial finite differences or the main residual’s AD tape. Evaluating each basis function in the expanded PDE forms a rectangular matrix MΩ; evaluating the inlet, traction-outlet or wall conditions forms MΓ. An isothermal wall specifies three adjoint values; an adiabatic wall specifies two momentum multipliers and one thermal normal derivative. Do not add an arbitrary wall value for alpha.

ϑν=arg⁡min⁡ϑ{∑q∈Ωwq∣(AΩϑ−b)q∣2+wb∑q∈Γwq∣(AΓϑ−d)q∣2},wb=10.\boldsymbol\vartheta_\nu=\arg\min_{\boldsymbol\vartheta}\left\{\sum_{q\in\Omega}w_q\left|(\mathbb A_\Omega\boldsymbol\vartheta-b)_q\right|^2+w_b\sum_{q\in\Gamma}w_q\left|(\mathbb A_\Gamma\boldsymbol\vartheta-d)_q\right|^2\right\},\qquad w_b=10.

每个多边形先剖成三角形，三角形内用 Duffy 变换和 Gauss 求积，边上用一维 Gauss 求积；边法向始终指向流体外。每向装配点数为 nq=max⁡(4,⌈(ν+2)/2⌉)n_q=\max(4,\lceil(\nu+2)/2\rceil)，验算改用 nq+2n_q+2，防止只在装配点上“看起来精确”。先按列范数缩放矩阵，再采用带列主元的 Householder QR 求超定最小二乘，不构造 A⊤A\mathbb A^{\top}\mathbb A。后者会平方条件数；这里的矩阵也不是正文附录 C 用 LU 求解的离散方阵。缺秩、非正物性或错误的入出流分区必须报错。QR 求出了最小残差系数，并不意味着 PDE 残差已经为零。

Split polygons into triangles and use a Duffy transform with Gaussian volume quadrature, plus Gaussian edge quadrature. Normals always point out of the fluid. Assembly uses nq=max⁡(4,⌈(ν+2)/2⌉)n_q=\max(4,\lceil(\nu+2)/2\rceil) points per direction; validation uses nq+2 to avoid accepting accuracy only at assembly points. Scale columns and solve the overdetermined system using column-pivoted Householder QR, without forming A⊤A\mathbb A^{\top}\mathbb A, which squares the condition number. This is also distinct from the discrete square LU system in Appendix C. Rank loss, nonpositive transport or an invalid inflow/outflow partition must fail explicitly. Finding least-squares coefficients does not imply zero PDE residual.

for every boundary sample xb:
    form the actual inlet / traction / thermal-wall condition
scale rows by sqrt(quadrature weight), then scale columns
c = pivoted_householder_QR(M, b)
validate PDE and boundary residuals using a different quadrature
repeat with higher p; do not confuse fit completion with accuracy

Relative field error is measured afterwards. The inhomogeneous boundary data belong to the manufactured objective, not the homogeneous tracking objective.

壁面验证另构造满足真实无滑移条件的制造基态：保留解析密度，把两个速度乘以 ss，把温度改成 1+s(T0−1)1+s(T_0-1)，其中 s=[max⁡(0,(x2+y2−0.852)/(1.92−0.852))]3s=[\max(0,(x^2+y^2-0.85^2)/(1.9^2-0.85^2))]^3。整个内壁均落在 s=0s=0 的区域，故 u=v=0,T=1,qn=0u=v=0,T=1,q_n=0，可分别检验等温和绝热闭合。这是带制造源项的二维黏性边值问题，不是无源绕流的替代解；径向截断仅为 C2C^2，不把它称为解析光滑基态。这个基态在壁面附近整片静止；第 14 节的离散无滑移制造解则让壁面剪切和热流都不为零。

For wall verification, construct a manufactured base satisfying actual no-slip conditions: retain analytic density, multiply both velocities by s, and replace temperature by 1+s(T₀−1), with s=[max(0,(x²+y²−0.85²)/(1.9²−0.85²))]³. The entire inner wall lies where s=0, hence u=v=0, T=1 and qn=0, allowing separate isothermal and adiabatic checks. This is a forced two-dimensional viscous BVP, not a replacement solution for unforced flow around the body. The radial cutoff is C², not analytic. This base is at rest in a whole neighbourhood of the wall; the discrete no-slip manufactured solution of Section 14 instead has nonzero wall shear and heat flux.

A small update means stationarity within the current space; a separate holdout primal residual is reported.

A.16 温度跟踪：弱形式与局部加密

A.16 Temperature tracking: weak form and local refinement

为什么全局多项式参考不够准确

Why a global polynomial reference is inaccurate

温度基态光滑，并不保证伴随在带孔多边形上同样光滑。伴随的驱动来自目标导数，且入口与出口施加不同的条件；角点附近可能出现较大的梯度及较低的正则性。一个覆盖全域的低次多项式必须同时拟合这些局部变化。制造伴随是我们预先选定的光滑函数，它验证算子实现，却没有考验这种逼近困难。因此，不能用 A.14 的制造场误差替代真实温度目标的收敛证据。

A smooth temperature base does not guarantee an equally smooth adjoint on a polygon with a hole. The objective derivative drives the adjoint, while inflow and outflow impose different conditions; corners can produce large gradients and reduced regularity. One low-degree global polynomial must fit all these local variations. A manufactured adjoint is a deliberately chosen smooth function: it checks the operator but does not test this approximation difficulty. Its small error in A.14 cannot replace convergence evidence for the actual tracking objective.

实际诊断也排除了“只需把边界权重调大”的解释。在 Sutherland 物性、七次全局逼近下，把边界权重从 1、10 增至 100，边界 L2L^2 残差从 0.01734、0.00893 降至 0.00331，但温度方程的体内残差从 0.00634、0.02168 增至 0.04717。QR 只是求出了当前空间的最小二乘折中。局部弱形式的 128 三角形初始网格中，最大的 10 个单元承载约 60% 的局部残差指标，提示应增加局部分辨率。这不是对完整 N–S 角点奇异指数的证明。

Measurements also rule out simply increasing the boundary weight. For Sutherland transport and global degree seven, weights 1, 10 and 100 reduce the boundary L² residual from 0.01734 to 0.00893 to 0.00331, while the interior temperature-equation residual grows from 0.00634 to 0.02168 to 0.04717. QR finds a compromise in the chosen space. On the initial 128-triangle mesh of the local weak form, ten cells carry about 60% of the local residual indicator, suggesting local resolution. This does not prove a corner-singularity exponent for the full N–S system.

从强方程到只含一阶导数的弱形式

From strong equations to a first-derivative weak form

仍使用 A.1–A.9 的同一连续方程和边界条件，固定开口内圈的制造基态 W0W_0。令 w=(wρ,w1,w2,wT)w=(w_\rho,w_1,w_2,w_T) 是原始场的任意允许变化。入口速度和温度固定，故 w1=w2=wT=0w_1=w_2=w_T=0；密度数据通过质量流入通量弱施加，因此不在离散入口删去密度试验函数。入口伴随取 β=0,χ=0\beta=0,\chi=0，α\alpha 不额外指定。出口固定牵引 tb=pn−τnt_b=pn-\tau n 与热流 qbq_b。

Keep exactly the continuous equations and boundary conditions in A.1–A.9 and the manufactured base W₀ with an open inner boundary. Let w=(wρ,w₁,w₂,wT) be an admissible primal variation. Inlet velocity and temperature are fixed, so w₁=w₂=wT=0. Density data enter weakly through prescribed mass inflow, rather than by deleting the discrete inlet density test function. Set β=0 and χ=0 at adjoint inflow, with no extra alpha value. Outlet traction tb=pn−τn and heat flux qb are prescribed.

δ ⁣∫Ωλ⊤(∂jFj−S) dΩ=−∫Ω(∂jλ)⊤δFj(W0;w) dΩ+∫Γλ⊤δFn ds,SW=0.\delta\!\int_\Omega\lambda^{\top}(\partial_jF_j-S)\,d\Omega=-\int_\Omega(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}\delta F_j(W_0;w)\,d\Omega+\int_\Gamma\lambda^{\top}\delta F_n\,ds,\qquad S_W=0.

δFj\delta F_j 完整采用 A.2 的通量线性化，包括 μT,κT\mu_T,\kappa_T，只含 ww 及其一阶导数。入口质量通量固定，其他乘子为零，入口积分因而消失。出口将 Fn=(ρun,ρuun+tb,ρEun+u⋅tb+qb)F_n=(\rho u_n,\rho u u_n+t_b,\rho E u_n+u\cdot t_b+q_b) 对 WW 求导；固定 tb,qbt_b,q_b 后，留下下面的边界系数。它们不含 ZnZn 或 κ∂nχ\kappa\partial_n\chi，因为扩散项尚保留在体内弱积分中。再分部积分一次才恢复 A.8 的强出口条件。

Use the full flux linearization of A.2, including μT and κT; δFj contains only w and its first derivatives. At inflow the mass flux is fixed and the other multipliers vanish, so that boundary contribution disappears. At outflow differentiate Fn=(ρun,ρu un+tb,ρE un+u·tb+qb), keeping tb and qb fixed. The resulting coefficients below do not include Zn or κ∂nχ: diffusion remains in the volume weak integral. Integrating it by parts again recovers the strong outlet conditions in A.8.

A=α+β⋅u+χE,cout=[unAρAn+ρun(β+χu)+χtbρcvunχ].A=\alpha+\beta\cdot u+\chi E,\qquad c_{\rm out}=\begin{bmatrix}u_nA\\ \rho A n+\rho u_n(\beta+\chi u)+\chi t_b\\ \rho c_vu_n\chi\end{bmatrix}.
a(w,λ)=−∫Ω(∂jλ)⊤δFj(W0;w) dΩ+∫Γoutcout(λ,W0)⋅w ds=−∫Ω(T0−Td)wT dΩ.a(w,\lambda)=-\int_\Omega(\partial_j\lambda)^{\top}\delta F_j(W_0;w)\,d\Omega+\int_{\Gamma_{\rm out}}c_{\rm out}(\lambda,W_0)\cdot w\,ds=-\int_\Omega(T_0-T_d)w_T\,d\Omega.

这里的 AA 是标量边界组合，不是正文离散 Jacobian。弱形式的意思是：对空间中每一个允许的 ww，上式都成立。选定一组局部基函数后，依次让 ww 等于各基函数，就产生一行线性方程。连续推导先于有限元装配；程序没有调用正文的有限体积残差或自动微分转置。

Here A is a scalar boundary combination, not the main discrete Jacobian. A weak solution satisfies this identity for every admissible w. After choosing local basis functions, using each one as w produces one matrix row. The continuous derivation precedes finite-element assembly; the implementation never calls the main finite-volume residual or its AD transpose.

局部 P₁／P₂ 空间与稳定化

Local P₁/P₂ spaces and stabilization

把原四边形各分成两个三角形，保留原孔洞与外边界。每个三角形的三个重心坐标记为 L1,L2,L3L_1,L_2,L_3。密度变化和质量乘子 α\alpha 用连续分片一次函数；速度、温度及其乘子用连续分片二次函数，后者在顶点和边中点各有一个自由度。不同单元共享这些值，但法向导数可以跳变，因此不强求全域二阶可微。

Split each original quadrilateral into two triangles, preserving the hole and outer polygon. Denote a triangle’s barycentric coordinates by L₁,L₂,L₃. Use continuous piecewise linear functions for density variations and alpha, and continuous piecewise quadratics for velocity, temperature and their multipliers. Quadratic DOFs lie at vertices and edge midpoints. Adjacent cells share values but may have different normal derivatives; global twice differentiability is not required.

P1:Ni=Li;P2:Ni=Li(2Li−1),Nij=4LiLj (i<j).P_1:\quad N_i=L_i;\qquad P_2:\quad N_i=L_i(2L_i-1),\quad N_{ij}=4L_iL_j\ (i<j).

连续性方程没有密度扩散。为了抑制这个混合离散中的网格尺度振荡，加入一致的内边惩罚（CIP），只作用于密度试验函数和 α\alpha 的法向导数跳量。令 [∂nz]=∇z∣K⋅n−∇z∣K′⋅n[\partial_n z]=\nabla z|_K\cdot n-\nabla z|_{K'}\cdot n，两侧使用同一法向；heh_e 是边长，u0u_0 取固定参考场在边中点的速度。

Continuity has no density diffusion. To suppress mesh-scale oscillations in this mixed discretization, add consistent interior penalty (CIP) only to the normal-derivative jumps of the density test and alpha. Define [∂nz]=∇z|K·n−∇z|K′·n with the same normal on both sides. Let he be the edge length and u₀ the fixed reference velocity at its midpoint.

sh(wρ,α)=∑e interiorγCIPhe2∣u0∣∫e[∂nwρ][∂nα]ds,γCIP=0.02,a(wh,λh)+sh(wρ,h,αh)=−JT′[wh].s_h(w_\rho,\alpha)=\sum_{e\ \rm interior}\gamma_{\rm CIP} h_e^2|u_0|\int_e[\partial_nw_\rho][\partial_n\alpha]ds,\quad\gamma_{\rm CIP}=0.02,\qquad a(w_h,\lambda_h)+s_h(w_{\rho,h},\alpha_h)=-J_T'[w_h].

光滑精确场的导数跨人工内边连续，故这一项为零；它不是给物理方程增加黏性。P₁ 的导数在单元内为常数，代码里的系数因此是 γCIPhe3∣u0∣\gamma_{\rm CIP} h_e^3|u_0|。独立原始弱求解对密度使用相同双线性项；系数不随热源扰动改变，不能漏掉其状态导数。有限网格结果仍依赖 γCIP\gamma_{\rm CIP}，所以必须检查减半／加倍后的变化，不能仅以小线性残差宣称稳定化无影响。稀疏线性系统采用 ILU(0) 预处理的重启 GMRES，并重新计算未预处理残差。正文原有 GS 方法不受影响。

A smooth exact field has no derivative jump across an artificial interior edge, so this term vanishes; it adds no physical viscosity to the PDE. P₁ derivatives are constant per cell, giving the code’s coefficient γhe³|u₀|. The independent primal weak solve uses the same bilinear term for density. Its coefficient stays fixed under heating perturbations, while its state derivative is retained. Finite-mesh results still depend on gamma, requiring half/double checks. A small linear residual cannot establish that stabilization has negligible effect. Restarted GMRES uses ILU(0), checking the unpreconditioned residual afterwards. The main lesson’s GS method is unchanged.

怎样决定加密哪里

Where to refine

只看单元内部强残差会漏掉跨边导数跳变。设 rK=L∗λh−br_K=\mathcal L^*\lambda_h-b，内边跳量 je=([Zn],[κ∇χ⋅n])j_e=([Zn],[\kappa\nabla\chi\cdot n])，beb_e 是 A.8–A.9 实际边界条件的残差。采用下面的量指导加密；内部边贡献的一半分配给每侧单元。各分量已经无量纲化，但本实现没有证明这个混合可压缩系统的严格可靠性常数，因此 I\mathcal I 是诊断和标记指标，不是误差上界。

Interior strong residuals alone miss derivative jumps across edges. Define rK=L*λh−b, the interior jump je=([Zn],[κ∇χ·n]), and be as the residual of the actual boundary conditions in A.8–A.9. Use the following refinement indicator, assigning half an interior-edge contribution to each neighbour. Components are nondimensional, but no rigorous reliability constant is established for this mixed compressible system. Eta is a diagnostic and marking indicator, not an error bound.

IK2=hK2∥rK∥L2(K)2+12∑e⊂∂K∩Ωhe∥je∥L2(e)2+∑e⊂∂K∩Γhe∥be∥L2(e)2,hK=2∣K∣,I2=∑KIK2.\mathcal I_K^2=h_K^2\|r_K\|_{L^2(K)}^2+\frac12\sum_{e\subset\partial K\cap\Omega}h_e\|j_e\|_{L^2(e)}^2+\sum_{e\subset\partial K\cap\Gamma}h_e\|b_e\|_{L^2(e)}^2,\quad h_K=\sqrt{2|K|},\quad\mathcal I^2=\sum_K\mathcal I_K^2.

把单元按 IK2\mathcal I_K^2 从大到小排序，标记累计达到总量 45% 的单元；分裂其边，再补分相邻单元以消除悬挂节点。重新装配、求解，并比较相邻网格的场和热源梯度。所有边仍位于同一个多边形上，避免把几何变化误当作离散收敛。指标验算比装配多用一个 Gauss 点，另行比较每向 4 与 5 点的装配。界面和体内指标必须一起看；弱解不要求分片强残差逐点为零。

Sort cells by ηK² and mark enough to carry 45% of the total. Split their edges and subdivide neighbours to remove hanging nodes. Reassemble, solve and compare fields and heating gradients between meshes. All boundary edges remain on the same polygon, separating approximation from geometry change. Diagnostic quadrature uses one more Gauss point than assembly; also compare assemblies with four and five points per direction. Inspect interface and volume indicators together: a weak solution need not have a pointwise zero broken strong residual.

triangulate the original polygon; keep its inner hole
for each refinement cycle:
    assemble the continuous weak operator + outlet terms + CIP
    solve with ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES
    recompute the true linear residual
    integrate cell residuals, interior jumps and boundary residuals
    compare the field and heating gradient with the previous mesh
    mark cells carrying 45% of the total indicator
    subdivide marked edges and close neighbouring triangles
freeze this mesh, source baseline, boundary data and CIP coefficient
solve nonlinear primal at a = 0, +h, -h
compare the weak-adjoint gradient with the central difference

真实温度目标与独立原始重算

Actual tracking objective and independent primal reruns

S(x,a)=S0(x)+a[000sin⁡2(0.7x+0.5y)],JT(W)=12∫Ω[T−(1+0.02cos⁡x)]2dΩ,ga=−∫Ωχsin⁡2(0.7x+0.5y)dΩ.S(x,a)=S_0(x)+a\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\0\\\sin^2(0.7x+0.5y)\end{bmatrix},\quad J_T(W)=\frac12\int_\Omega[T-(1+0.02\cos x)]^2d\Omega,\quad g_a=-\int_\Omega\chi\sin^2(0.7x+0.5y)d\Omega.

这里与 A.15 的制造参数族不同：只改变外加热源，S0S_0、入口和出口数据全部固定，不重新制造源项。先在选定网格上用 Newton 与线搜索独立收敛原始弱问题，再以这个数值基态重装伴随，最后求解 +h,−h+h,-h 两个非线性问题。差分用真实温度目标，不使用预先知道的伴随场。原始残差、目标、伴随右端与热源梯度采用相匹配的求积规则；额外求积点用于验算，不能偷偷改变差分目标。

Unlike the manufactured family in A.15, only added heating changes: S₀ and all inlet/outlet data stay fixed. On the selected mesh, independently converge the nonlinear weak primal with Newton and line search, reassemble the adjoint about that numerical base, then solve the +h and −h nonlinear problems. Differences use the actual temperature objective, with no prescribed exact adjoint. The primal residual, objective, adjoint RHS and heating gradient use matching quadrature; extra diagnostic points must not silently redefine the FD objective.

gFD(h)=JT(W+h)−JT(W−h)2h,εFD=∣ga−gFD∣∣gFD∣.g_{\rm FD}(h)=\frac{J_T(W_{+h})-J_T(W_{-h})}{2h},\qquad \varepsilon_{\rm FD}=\frac{|g_a-g_{\rm FD}|}{|g_{\rm FD}|}.

需要区分两种基态。加密图以解析制造基态 W0W_0 装配，隔离伴随逼近误差；“重算 ±h”则以独立收敛的数值原始基态装配，因而梯度略有差别。弱形式在同一有限元空间上具有离散对偶性，原始与伴随虽然分别按物理公式装配，其矩阵仍应互为转置。差分吻合验证这种实现和总导数，但不能单独证明连续精度；它也不是原正文有限体积的离散伴随测试。

Distinguish the two base states. Refinement uses the analytic manufactured W₀ to isolate adjoint approximation error. Rerun ±h uses an independently converged numerical primal base, giving a slightly different gradient. The weak forms have discrete duality in the same finite-element space: although assembled separately from physical formulas, their matrices should transpose. FD agreement checks this implementation and total derivative, but cannot alone prove continuum accuracy. It is also separate from the main finite-volume discrete-adjoint test.

已取得的精度，以及还不能声称的结论

Measured accuracy and its limits

固定 Sutherland 默认参数的局部加密，三角形数从 128 增至 2653：I\mathcal I 从 0.04522 降至 0.004376，热源梯度从 −0.0037587-0.0037587 变为 −0.0042562-0.0042562。末三张网格（1361、1843、2653 个三角形）的梯度为 −0.00424914,−0.00425380,−0.00425620-0.00424914,-0.00425380,-0.00425620，最后两次相对变化约 0.109% 和 0.056%。在 1843 三角形网格上把每向装配求积从 4 点提高到 5 点，梯度相对变化约 1.1×10−111.1\times10^{-11}，说明该网格的主要误差不来自求积。中途相对变化曾短暂低于 0.06%，随后又达到 0.32%，所以不能遇到一次小变化就停止并宣布收敛。

With the default Sutherland parameters, local refinement increases triangles from 128 to 2653: eta falls from 0.04522 to 0.004376 and the heating gradient changes from −0.0037587 to −0.0042562. The last three meshes (1361, 1843, 2653 triangles) give −0.00424914, −0.00425380 and −0.00425620; the last two relative changes are about 0.109% and 0.056%. Increasing assembly quadrature from four to five points per direction on the 1843-triangle mesh changes the gradient by about 1.1×10⁻¹¹ relative, excluding quadrature as the dominant error there. Earlier, a change briefly fell below 0.06% before rising to 0.32%. One small change is not a convergence certificate.

在 1843 三角形网格上，γCIP=0.01,0.02,0.04\gamma_{\rm CIP}=0.01,0.02,0.04 的梯度分别为 −0.00425264,−0.00425380,−0.00425572-0.00425264,-0.00425380,-0.00425572，总跨度约 0.072%。同网格数值原始基态的伴随梯度约 −0.00425276-0.00425276，与 h=10−4h=10^{-4} 的独立原始重算中心差分相差约 2.5×10−82.5\times10^{-8}（相对）。这两个精度数字的含义不同：本算例的连续梯度目前得到约 10−310^{-3} 相对量级的网格／稳定化一致性支持，而不是 10−810^{-8} 的连续误差保证。常物性和 Sutherland 的制造场另在三层均匀网格上检验；混合场相对误差约为 7.0×10−3,1.6×10−3,3.6×10−47.0\times10^{-3},1.6\times10^{-3},3.6\times10^{-4}。

On the 1843-triangle mesh, gamma=0.01,0.02,0.04 gives gradients −0.00425264, −0.00425380 and −0.00425572, a spread of about 0.072%. With a numerical primal base on that mesh, the adjoint gradient is about −0.00425276 and agrees with independently reconverged central differences at h=10⁻⁴ to about 2.5×10⁻⁸ relative. These numbers mean different things: this case has roughly 10⁻³ relative mesh/stabilization consistency evidence, not a 10⁻⁸ continuum-error guarantee. Manufactured fields for constant and Sutherland transport are separately checked on three uniform meshes, with mixed-field relative errors about 7.0×10⁻³, 1.6×10⁻³ and 3.6×10⁻⁴.

本节的局部方法覆盖开口内圈、固定边界的光滑二维温度跟踪与热源导数。壁面热流、壁面力、几何导数和一般层流绕流的连续参考仍需各自验证，不能借用这里的精度数字。A.14 的全局方法适合展示光滑制造解，也可与局部加密对照。教学重点仍是正文离散伴随；本节说明为什么独立连续参考本身也必须求解、加密和验证。

This local method covers smooth 2D tracking and heating sensitivities with an open inner boundary and fixed boundary data. Wall heat, wall force, geometry sensitivities and general laminar body-flow references still require their own validation. The global method of A.14 suits smooth manufactured solutions and serves as a contrast to local refinement. The main lesson remains discrete adjoints; this section shows why an independent continuous reference must itself be solved, refined and verified.

A.17 独立的一维限制问题

A.17 An independent one-dimensional restricted problem

下面单独求解单位宽度、无横向变化的平面一维加热问题，使用已有的四变量空间 ODE 射击和连续 ODE 伴随。入口质量流率固定，出口给总应力与零热流；这与本页 O 型域不是同一个边值问题。我们将其三分量守恒状态嵌入四分量 (ρ,ρu,0,ρE)(\rho,\rho u,0,\rho E)，检查二维通量在 n=(1,0)n=(1,0) 下恢复同一通量，并用独立重算差分检查 ODE 梯度。

Solve a separate unit-width plane-1D heated problem using the existing four-variable spatial shooting ODE and continuous ODE adjoint. Fixed inlet mass flow and prescribed outlet total stress/zero heat define a different BVP from the O-domain. Embed its state as (ρ,ρu,0,ρE)(\rho,\rho u,0,\rho E), verify that 2D flux with n=(1,0)n=(1,0) reduces to the same flux, and check the ODE gradient with independently reconverged differences.

此限制问题固定 m=ρu=0.35m=\rho u=0.35，u(0)=m, T(0)=Tin=1u(0)=m,\ T(0)=T_{\rm in}=1；源项只有能量分量 sE=a0sin⁡2(πx)+a1sin⁡2(2πx)s_E=a_0\sin^2(\pi x)+a_1\sin^2(2\pi x)，默认 a0=0.03,a1=0a_0=0.03,a_1=0。定义轴向应力和净能量通量后可将二阶方程改写为四个一阶方程：

The restricted problem fixes m=ρu=0.35m=\rho u=0.35, u(0)=m, T(0)=Tin=1u(0)=m,\ T(0)=T_{\rm in}=1. Only energy is forced: sE=a0sin⁡2(πx)+a1sin⁡2(2πx)s_E=a_0\sin^2(\pi x)+a_1\sin^2(2\pi x), with defaults a0=0.03,a1=0a_0=0.03,a_1=0. Define axial stress and net energy flux to rewrite the second-order problem as four first-order equations:

g1(z(1),a)=[Π(1)−mu(1)−pbq(1)]=0,pb=1,Jc=12∫01[T−(1+0.04sin⁡πx)]2dx.g_1(z(1),a)=\begin{bmatrix}\Pi(1)-mu(1)-p_b\\q(1)\end{bmatrix}=0,\quad p_b=1,\quad J^{\rm c}=\frac12\int_0^1[T-(1+0.04\sin\pi x)]^2dx.

未知初值是 Π(0),H(0)\Pi(0),H(0)。对这两个初值积分 Y′=fzYY'=f_zY，用终点 g1,zYg_{1,z}Y 的 2×22\times2 系统做 Newton 射击，再以 RK4 积分连续伴随。初端 u,Tu,T 固定而 Π,H\Pi,H 自由，因此在这个无端点目标的例子中，λΠc(0)=λHc(0)=0\lambda^{\rm c}_{\Pi}(0)=\lambda^{\rm c}_H(0)=0；末端乘子由这两条条件确定。积分步数可切换，并须分别检查射击残差和伴随端点残差。

The unknown initial values are Π(0),H(0)\Pi(0),H(0). Integrate Y′=fzYY'=f_zY for these seeds, use the endpoint 2×22\times2 matrix g1,zYg_{1,z}Y in Newton shooting, and integrate the continuous adjoint with RK4. At the inlet, u,Tu,T are fixed while Π,H\Pi,H are free, so this example without endpoint objectives requires λΠc(0)=λHc(0)=0\lambda^{\rm c}_{\Pi}(0)=\lambda^{\rm c}_H(0)=0; these determine the terminal multipliers. Select integration resolution and inspect both shooting and adjoint endpoint residuals.

z=(u,T,Π,H)⊤,z′=f(z,a),(λc)′=−fz⊤λc−ℓz⊤.z=(u,T,\Pi,H)^{\top},\quad z'=f(z,a),\quad (\lambda^{\rm c})'=-f_z^{\top}\lambda^{\rm c}-\ell_z^{\top}.

For the reduced Lagrangian ∫[ℓ+(λc)⊤(f−z′)]dx+ϕ0+ϕ1+Λ0⊤g0+Λ1⊤g1\int[\ell+(\lambda^{\rm c})^{\top}(f-z')]dx+\phi_0+\phi_1+\Lambda_0^{\top}g_0+\Lambda_1^{\top}g_1, endpoint conditions and gradient are:

λc(0)+ϕ0,z⊤+g0,z⊤Λ0=0,−λc(1)+ϕ1,z⊤+g1,z⊤Λ1=0,\lambda^{\rm c}(0)+\phi_{0,z}^{\top}+g_{0,z}^{\top}\Lambda_0=0,\quad-\lambda^{\rm c}(1)+\phi_{1,z}^{\top}+g_{1,z}^{\top}\Lambda_1=0,
gc=ϕ0,a⊤+ϕ1,a⊤+∫01(ℓa⊤+fa⊤λc)dx+g0,a⊤Λ0+g1,a⊤Λ1.g^{\rm c}=\phi_{0,a}^{\top}+\phi_{1,a}^{\top}+\int_0^1(\ell_a^{\top}+f_a^{\top}\lambda^{\rm c})dx+g_{0,a}^{\top}\Lambda_0+g_{1,a}^{\top}\Lambda_1.

连续 ODE 伴随先推导再积分，不是 RK4 算法的离散转置。这里的验证只支持这个限制问题与通量降维，不把它标为完整二维连续伴随已验证。

The continuous ODE adjoint is derived before integration, not obtained by transposing RK4. This validates only the restricted problem and flux reduction, not a complete 2D continuous adjoint.

Saved result (256 RK4 steps, constant transport): shooting boundary residual 8.8×10−158.8\times10^{-15}, continuous-adjoint endpoint residual 2.5×10−182.5\times10^{-18}, and a largest 2D-versus-1D flux difference of 4.4×10−164.4\times10^{-16} for n=(1,0)n=(1,0). The continuous gradient −3.2383980×10−3-3.2383980\times10^{-3} and the independently reconverged difference −3.2383981×10−3-3.2383981\times10^{-3} differ by 1.8×10−121.8\times10^{-12}.

A.18 两套伴随是否趋于同一个梯度？

A.18 Do the two adjoints approach the same gradient?

单独通过差分检查，只能说明某套伴随正确求导了它自己的离散目标。这里增加直接的跨方法对比：正文有限体积离散伴随与 A.16 独立连续弱形式，必须先描述同一个物理问题，再各自加密。比较对象是热源幅度 aa 的总梯度，不直接相减维数、位置和尺度不同的伴随系数。

Passing a finite-difference check alone shows that an adjoint differentiates its own discrete objective correctly. This appendix compares the main finite-volume discrete adjoint directly with the independent continuous weak form of A.16. Both must describe the same physical problem before their meshes are refined. Compare the total derivative with respect to heating amplitude a, not coefficient vectors with different dimensions, locations and scaling.

R(U,a)=∇ ⁣⋅(Fc−Fv)−S0−a[000s(x,y)]⊤=0,s=sin⁡2(0.7x+0.5y),R(U,a)=\nabla\!\cdot(F^c-F^v)-S_0-a\begin{bmatrix}0&0&0&s(x,y)\end{bmatrix}^{\top}=0,\qquad s=\sin^2(0.7x+0.5y),
J=12∫Ω[T−(1+0.02cos⁡x)]2 dΩ,μref=0.2,Pr=0.72,a=0.J=\frac12\int_\Omega[T-(1+0.02\cos x)]^2\,d\Omega,\qquad \mu_{\rm ref}=0.2,\quad Pr=0.72,\quad a=0.

区域始终是原始网格的同一多边形，内圈是开口边界。基态采用第 14 节的光滑制造场；S0S_0 由该场的物理通量求散度。入口状态和出口牵引／热流在热源扰动时固定。常物性与 Sutherland 分开比较；顶部“真实绕流”、壁面温度或黏度参数的梯度不属于这项实验。独立检查逐点核对双方基态、制造源项与热源函数，防止比较了两个不同的问题。

Keep exactly the original polygonal domain, with an open inner boundary. Use the smooth manufactured base of Section 14, obtaining S₀ from its physical flux divergence. Hold inlet data and outlet traction/heat flux fixed while perturbing heating. Compare constant and Sutherland transport separately. Physical body flow, wall temperature and viscosity derivatives from the main controls are outside this experiment. Independent pointwise checks match the two bases, manufactured sources and heating functions before comparing gradients.

Ah⊤ψh=−jU,h,ghFV=ja,h+Rh,a⊤ψh;gHCA=−∫ΩχHs dΩ.A_h^{\top}\psi_h=-j_{U,h},\quad g_h^{\rm FV}=j_{a,h}+R_{h,a}^{\top}\psi_h;\qquad g_H^{\rm CA}=-\int_\Omega\chi_Hs\,d\Omega.

沿用正文的列梯度约定，jU,h∈R4Nj_{U,h}\in\mathbb R^{4N}。为什么比较这两个量？先将离散平衡 Rh(Uh(a),a)=0R_h(U_h(a),a)=0 对 aa 求导，再用伴随方程消去未知的流场变化 dUh/dadU_h/da：

Keep the main text’s column-gradient convention, jU,h∈R4Nj_{U,h}\in\mathbb R^{4N}. Why compare these quantities? Differentiate the discrete balance Rₕ(Uₕ(a),a)=0 with respect to a, then eliminate the unknown state change dUₕ/da with the adjoint equation:

AhdUhda+Rh,a=0,dJhda=jU,h⊤dUhda+ja,h=−ψh⊤AhdUhda+ja,h=ψh⊤Rh,a+ja,h.A_h\frac{dU_h}{da}+R_{h,a}=0,\qquad \frac{dJ_h}{da}=j_{U,h}^{\top}\frac{dU_h}{da}+j_{a,h}=-\psi_h^{\top}A_h\frac{dU_h}{da}+j_{a,h}=\psi_h^{\top}R_{h,a}+j_{a,h}.

本目标没有对 aa 的显式依赖，所以 ja,h=0j_{a,h}=0。体热源仅进入能量残差，保留能量平衡的行有 Ra,h,i,E=−∫Ωis dΩR_{a,h,i,E}=-\int_{\Omega_i}s\,d\Omega；纯入口中被强条件覆盖的行对该热源参数的导数是零。因此不能把所有“边界约束乘子”直接当作连续能量伴随的节点值。程序直接使用实际残差的参数导数，自动保留这种区别。

The objective has no explicit dependence on a, so jₐ,ₕ=0. Heating enters only energy-balance rows, where Rₐ,ₕ,i,E is minus the integral of s over the control volume. Pure-inlet rows replaced by prescribed conditions have zero derivative with respect to this heating parameter. Their boundary-constraint multipliers cannot simply be treated as nodal values of the continuous energy adjoint. Differentiating the actual residual preserves this distinction.

L=J+∫Ωλ⊤R dΩ,δUL=0⟹dJda=Ja+∫Ωλ⊤Ra dΩ=−∫Ωχs dΩ.\mathcal L=J+\int_\Omega\lambda^{\top}R\,d\Omega,\qquad \delta_U\mathcal L=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \frac{dJ}{da}=J_a+\int_\Omega\lambda^{\top}R_a\,d\Omega=-\int_\Omega\chi s\,d\Omega.

连续式的边界项由 A.8 的入口／出口伴随条件抵消，且本实验的边界数据不随 aa 改变。这一步正是两条路线可比较的前提；若扰动的是入口或出口数据，就必须重新加入相应的边界梯度，不能沿用这里的纯体积分。

The inflow/outflow adjoint conditions of A.8 cancel the state-variation boundary terms, and boundary data do not vary with a in this experiment. This is essential for comparing the routes. Perturbing inlet or outlet data would require the corresponding boundary-gradient terms; the volume-only formula would no longer suffice.

有限体积每一级先收敛实际非线性流场，再求该流场上的精确离散伴随。连续参考在解析基态上独立装配，以隔离伴随空间逼近误差。因此有限体积比较中同时含有原始场误差；表中另外列出守恒量相对误差。只有这些误差都减小时，才有依据讨论共同极限。连续参考也只是有限网格的数值解，不是已知精确梯度。

On each finite-volume mesh, first converge the actual nonlinear primal, then solve its exact discrete adjoint. Assemble the independent continuous reference about the analytic base to isolate adjoint approximation error. The FV comparison therefore also includes primal error; the table reports a relative conservative-state error. A common limit can only be assessed as both errors decrease. The continuous reference is itself a numerical approximation, not a known exact gradient.

Eh=∣ghFV−gH∗CA∣∣gH∗CA∣,h=max⁡i∣Ωi∣,εU=[∑i∣Ωi∣∥Uh,i−U∗,i∥2∑i∣Ωi∣∥U∗,i∥2]1/2.E_h=\frac{|g_h^{\rm FV}-g_{H_*}^{\rm CA}|}{|g_{H_*}^{\rm CA}|},\qquad h=\max_i\sqrt{|\Omega_i|},\qquad \varepsilon_U=\left[\frac{\sum_i|\Omega_i|\|U_{h,i}-U_{*,i}\|^2}{\sum_i|\Omega_i|\|U_{*,i}\|^2}\right]^{1/2}.

格心 U∗,iU_{*,i} 是解析守恒量的单元平均，格点则取解析节点值；两种格式的 hh 按各自控制体计算。图中的参考水平线来自实际求解。必须同时看连续参考最近几次加密的变化，不把 EhE_h 当作精确误差，也不根据单次下降宣称收敛。粗网格可能给出错误的梯度符号；二阶原始重构也不保证这个带角点伴随问题的目标梯度立即呈二阶收敛。

For cells, U* is the analytic conservative cell average; for nodes it is the analytic nodal value. Each scheme uses its own control-volume h. The reference line is computed by an actual solve. Inspect recent continuous-reference changes as well: Eh is a difference from a numerical reference, not an exact error, and one decrease is not a convergence certificate. A coarse mesh can even give the wrong gradient sign. Second-order primal reconstruction does not guarantee immediate second-order goal-gradient convergence in this cornered adjoint problem.

fix domain, base forcing, boundary data, transport and heating direction
for each FV scheme, order and refinement level:
    converge the unchanged nonlinear FV residual
    assemble its exact sparse Jacobian using disjoint derivative seeds
    solve the transposed system; check against the original reverse product
    g_FV = j_a + R_ha^⊤ psi
independently refine the continuous weak adjoint
g_CA = -integral(chi * heating)
compare signed gradients, relative differences and primal errors
optionally reconverge FV primal at +h and -h for a same-mesh FD check

这一加密实验为了速度显式组装稀疏精确 Jacobian，用 ILU(0) 预处理 GMRES 求解。它不改变正文的通量、重构、边界或目标，也不把一阶近似当作精确导数。按残差依赖关系为互不重叠的列分组，一次前向传播得到多列，再恢复各行。测试将装配后的矩阵乘积、转置乘积和最终梯度与正文 matrix-free 实现逐项比较。正文原有 GS 教学与 matrix-free 实现继续保留。

For affordable refinement this experiment explicitly assembles the exact sparse Jacobian and uses ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES. It changes neither the lesson’s fluxes, reconstruction, boundary closure nor objective, and does not substitute a first-order approximation for the exact derivative. Group columns whose residual dependencies do not overlap, propagate one combined seed, then recover each row. Tests compare assembled forward/transpose products and final gradients with the main matrix-free implementation. The main GS lesson and matrix-free solver remain available.

细网格上的 GMRES 使用更大的 Krylov 子空间：此面板默认最多保留 1000 个向量，也可降低到 100／300／500，或增加到 1500。实际向量数不超过系统维数。重启太早可能反复丢失对收敛重要的方向；增大子空间会增加内存和正交化计算，但不改变待求方程。表中显示该结果实际采用的向量上限；未通过真实残差检查的计算不会加入梯度曲线。

Use a larger Krylov space on refined meshes: this panel defaults to at most 1000 vectors, with 100/300/500 and 1500 also available. The actual limit does not exceed the system dimension. Restarting too early can repeatedly discard directions important to convergence. A larger space costs memory and orthogonalization work without changing the equations. The result table identifies the vector limit actually used; solves failing the true-residual check are excluded from the gradient curves.

图 A.9Figure A.9

随页记录含有基网格（24 个控制体）上的有限差分核对：8 个记录覆盖格心／格点、一阶／二阶与两种物性，伴随梯度与重新收敛的中心差分（步长 1×10−41\times10^{-4}）的相对差在 2.5×10−102.5\times10^{-10} 到 3.5×10−73.5\times10^{-7} 之间。这只说明每个离散梯度对它自己的离散目标是精确的；它们是否趋向同一极限，要看下面的加密比较。

The saved records include finite-difference checks on the base mesh (24 volumes): 8 records covering cells/nodes, first/second order and both transport laws, where the adjoint gradient and reconverged central differences (step 1×10−41\times10^{-4}) differ by 2.5×10−102.5\times10^{-10} to 3.5×10−73.5\times10^{-7} relative. This shows only that each discrete gradient is exact for its own discrete objective; whether the gradients approach a common limit is the refinement comparison below.

如何读随页结果：6144 个控制体的格心二阶，在常物性／Sutherland 下与连续参考分别相差约 0.103%／0.0463%；连续参考最近一次加密自身变化约 0.0331%／0.0564%。格点二阶在 4224 个控制体时相差约 0.268%／0.299%；格点在入口／出口交界节点保留能量平衡（格点页第 3 节）。

Reading the saved results: at 6144 control volumes, second-order cells differ from the continuous reference by about 0.103% / 0.0463% for constant / Sutherland transport; the reference's latest refinement changes it by about 0.0331% / 0.0564%. Second-order nodes at 4224 volumes differ by about 0.268% / 0.299%; nodes keep the energy balance at inlet/outlet junction nodes (Section 3 of the node page).

这不是严格误差上界或共同极限的证明。格点二阶在 1088 个控制体时的差距约为 0.148%／0.187%，反而小于最细层，显示不同误差项可能抵消。应同时看有符号梯度、相邻层变化和原始误差，不能挑选最接近参考的一层宣布收敛，也不能用差分吻合或原始场精度替代目标梯度的网格收敛。一阶也不能省略：最细层上，格心一阶相差约 12.5%／5.17%，格点一阶约 6.91%／1.30%。参考本身仍有有限元、稳定化及局部加密误差。

These differences are neither strict error bounds nor proof of a common limit. At 1088 control volumes, second-order nodal differences are about 0.148% / 0.187%, smaller than on the finest mesh, indicating possible cancellation among error terms. Inspect signed gradients, successive-level changes and primal errors together; do not declare convergence by selecting the closest level. FD agreement and primal accuracy cannot replace goal-gradient refinement. First order matters too: on the finest level, first-order cells differ by about 12.5% / 5.17% and first-order nodes by about 6.91% / 1.30%. The reference also retains finite-element, stabilization and local-refinement errors.

格点一阶常物性曲线在 80、288、1088 个控制体上几乎不动（相对差 11.6%、12.5%、10.6%，这里用再加密到 14842 个三角形的连续参考），看上去像停滞。离线的更细网格（refinement_level6_summary.json，同一残差、同一目标）说明它没有停住：4224、16640、66048 个控制体的差距依次为 6.90%、4.15%、2.52%，最后两层的表观阶约 0.72，原始场的表观阶约 0.85。1–3 级几乎不变，可能是粗网格上几种误差项部分抵消（这里没有分解验证）；更细的网格才显示单调下降，而表观阶仍小于 1，说明尚未进入渐近区。Sutherland 的一阶格点在同样的网格上是 1.29%、0.786%、0.260%（最后两层表观阶约 1.60）。

The constant-transport first-order nodal curve barely moves at 80, 288, 1088 volumes (relative differences 11.6%, 12.5%, 10.6%, against the reference refined to 14842 triangles) and looks stalled. Finer offline meshes (refinement_level6_summary.json, same residual and objective) show that it is not: at 4224, 16640, 66048 volumes the differences are 6.90%, 4.15%, 2.52%, with an apparent order of about 0.72 over the last two levels (primal field about 0.85). Levels 1–3 hardly change, possibly because several error terms partly cancel on coarse meshes (not decomposed here); only finer meshes show a monotone decrease, and the apparent order is still below 1, so the asymptotic range has not been reached. Sutherland first-order nodes on the same meshes give 1.29%, 0.786%, 0.260% (apparent order about 1.60 over the last two levels).

“重新计算曲线”与“重算连续参考”均在本机后台实际求解；停止保留已完成级别。切换物性时不会混用结果。差分按钮只检验选中有限体积网格的总导数；它不能代替跨网格对比。若参考随加密仍显著变化，或某条离散曲线停滞，页面如实保留结果，不标记为“已验证共同极限”。

Recompute curve and Recompute reference perform real local background solves; Stop retains completed levels. Results from different transport laws are kept separate. The FD button only verifies the selected finite-volume mesh’s total derivative and cannot replace refinement. If the reference still changes or a discrete curve stagnates, retain that evidence without labelling a common limit as verified.

一维限制问题只验证其自身的连续 ODE 梯度和二维通量的降维关系。A.12–A.13 的二维 Green 恒等式与边界消项检查验证推导本身，并由 A.14–A.18 的独立二维边值求解和梯度检查补充。正文离散伴随的验证继续使用精确转置、全重算差分、复数步长与网格加密。

The restricted problem validates its own continuous ODE gradients and flux reduction. The 2D Green identity and boundary-cancellation checks of A.12–A.13 verify the derivation itself, and are supplemented by the independent 2D BVP solves and gradient checks in A.14–A.18. Discrete-adjoint verification continues to use exact transpose products, reconverged differences, complex steps and mesh refinement.

B.2 绝热与常物性不能删错路径

B.2 Do not erase the wrong derivative paths

常物性只删除 μT\mu_T，不删除对参考黏度的导数。绝热壁将法向热流目标严格置零，但速度梯度、剪应力、压力及内域导热仍存在。对一个被覆盖行的零种子，也不能误认为该节点对所有邻域通量都没有贡献。

Constant transport removes μT\mu_T, not reference-viscosity derivatives. An adiabatic wall has exactly zero normal heat flux but still has velocity gradients, shear, pressure and interior conduction. Zero seed on an overwritten row does not remove that node's contributions to neighbouring fluxes.

用基网格层流绕流（格心、二阶、常物性、x 合力目标）核对：绝热壁时，壁温参数不进入任何残差或目标，dFx/dTw=0dF_x/dT_w=0，恰好为零；常物性只去掉 μT\mu_T，对参考黏度的导数仍是 dFx/dμref=1.953dF_x/d\mu_{\rm ref}=1.953。换成等温壁，dFx/dTw=2.774×10−1dF_x/dT_w=2.774\times10^{-1}：壁温直接进入壁面压力 pb=ρbTwp_b=\rho_bT_w 和温度梯度惩罚，并经流场响应影响合力。绝热壁上的热流目标恒为 Q=0Q=0，其全部参数与坐标梯度的最大绝对值为 00。

Check with the base-mesh laminar flow (cells, second order, constant transport, x-force objective): at an adiabatic wall the wall-temperature parameter enters no residual or objective, so dFx/dTw=0dF_x/dT_w=0 exactly; constant transport removes only μT\mu_T, and dFx/dμref=1.953dF_x/d\mu_{\rm ref}=1.953 remains. With an isothermal wall dFx/dTw=2.774×10−1dF_x/dT_w=2.774\times10^{-1}: the wall temperature enters the wall pressure pb=ρbTwp_b=\rho_bT_w and the temperature-gradient penalty directly, and the force through the flow response. The heat objective on an adiabatic wall is identically Q=0Q=0, and the largest absolute value of all its parameter and coordinate gradients is 00.

The page's reverse graph completes this for both Gauss points: this face writes reverse contributions into 19 states (the union of the left and right volumes and their stencils), the largest in magnitude being states 0, 1, 23. Appendix C: complete matrix and LU

C.1 基网格可以把整个矩阵看清楚

C.1 Inspect the complete base-grid matrix

A:,j=Ahej,PpivAh⊤=LLUULU,LLUy=Ppiv(−jU),ULUψh=y.A_{:,j}=A_he_j,\quad\mathsf P_{\rm piv}A_h^{\top}=L_{\rm LU}U_{\rm LU},\quad L_{\rm LU}y=\mathsf P_{\rm piv}(-j_U),\quad U_{\rm LU}\psi_h=y.

逐个单位状态种子形成精确矩阵的列，随后对完整转置作部分主元 LU。这里明确存储矩阵，不是 matrix-free。主元置换与 GS 预处理矩阵不同；上三角因子与守恒状态向量也不是同一个 U。

Unit state seeds form exact matrix columns, then partial-pivot LU factors the full transpose. This explicitly stores a matrix and is not matrix-free. Pivot permutation differs from the GS preconditioner, and the upper factor is not the conservative state vector.

for j in state slots: A[:,j] = exact_JVP(unit(j))
M = transpose(A)
for k: choose pivot, swap complete rows, store elimination multipliers
y = forward_solve(L, permute(-jU))
psi = back_solve(U, y)
check norm(exact_VJP(psi) + jU)

滑块显示当前消元矩阵；解向量表显示完整求解的最终结果。重构使非零块超过最近邻。小网格可用这个方法交叉检查 GMRES，但稠密存储与立方运算量不适合据此推广到大规模 RANS。

The slider shows the elimination matrix at a stage; solution tables show the completed solve. Reconstruction extends nonzero blocks beyond nearest neighbours. This cross-checks GMRES on small meshes but dense storage and cubic work do not scale to large RANS.

随页保存的结果：默认基准的 96 × 96 转置矩阵中，576 个 4 × 4 块有 432 个非零；部分主元消元交换了 40 行。LU 解的真残差 ∥Ah⊤ψh+jU∥=2.4×10−16\|A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U\|=2.4\times10^{-16}（右端范数 6.41×10−26.41\times10^{-2}），与第 16 节 FGMRES 解的最大分量差为 5.5×10−115.5\times10^{-11}，而 max⁡∣ψh∣=3.80×10−2\max|\psi_h|=3.80\times10^{-2}：两者在迭代容差内一致。

Saved result: in the 96 × 96 transposed matrix of the default baseline, 432 of the 576 4 × 4 blocks are nonzero; partial pivoting swaps 40 rows. The LU solution has true residual ∥Ah⊤ψh+jU∥=2.4×10−16\|A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U\|=2.4\times10^{-16} (right-hand-side norm 6.41×10−26.41\times10^{-2}) and differs from the Section 16 FGMRES solution by at most 5.5×10−115.5\times10^{-11} per component, with max⁡∣ψh∣=3.80×10−2\max|\psi_h|=3.80\times10^{-2}: the two agree within the iterative tolerance.

C.2 从消元操作理解 LU

C.2 Understand LU through elimination

继续使用两未知量例子。第二行加第一行的一半，消掉左下角的 -1；消元倍率是 -1/2，因为标准公式写成“第二行减去倍率乘第一行”。上三角方程先解第二个未知量，再回代第一个：

Continue the two-unknown example. Add half the first row to the second to eliminate -1. The stored multiplier is -1/2 because elimination subtracts the multiplier times the pivot row. Solve the second unknown, then substitute backward:

[2−1−12]=[10−1/21][2−103/2].\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\-1/2&1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\0&3/2\end{bmatrix}.

一般矩阵需要换行选择较大的主元，以避免除以零或很小的数。置换同时作用于右端；对于已经存储的消元倍率，也必须保持相同行置换。完整矩阵的第 j 列由单位向量 eje_j 的 JVP 得到，这里 eje_j 表示基向量，不是能量密度 e。

General matrices use row pivoting to avoid zero or small divisors. Apply the permutation to the right-hand side and consistently to stored elimination multipliers. A JVP on unit basis vector eje_j forms column j; this eje_j is not energy density e.

Lii=1:yi=bi′−∑j<iLijyj,ψi=yi−∑j>iUijψjUii,b′=Ppiv(−jU).L_{ii}=1:\quad y_i=b'_i-\sum_{j<i}L_{ij}y_j,\qquad \psi_i=\frac{y_i-\sum_{j>i}U_{ij}\psi_j}{U_{ii}},\quad b'=\mathsf P_{\rm piv}(-j_U).

前代、回代完成后仍要把解代回原始伴随算子，检查 ∥Ah⊤ψh+jU∥\|A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U\|。这样才能发现置换、转置或装配错误，而不是只确认“分解函数返回了一个数组”。

After both substitutions, evaluate the original adjoint residual ∥Ah⊤ψh+jU∥\|A_h^{\top}\psi_h+j_U\|. This checks permutation, transposition and assembly, rather than merely that factorization returned an array.
